    layout: Mapping[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


class _SafeFormatDict(dict):
    def __missing__(self, key: str) -> str:
        return "{" + key + "}"


class DiplomaRenderer:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        assets = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "assets" / "diploma"
        self.backgrounds = {
            "diploma": assets / "kirzhach_diploma_blank.png",
            "appendix_front": assets / "kirzhach_diploma_appendix_front.png",
            "appendix_back": assets / "kirzhach_diploma_appendix_back.png",
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _image(path: Path, size: tuple[float, float], include_background: bool) -> QImage:
        """Create a page canvas with an explicit physical resolution.

        QFont point sizes are converted to pixels using the paint device DPI.
        A newly created QImage otherwise defaults to the screen resolution
        (normally about 96 DPI), even though its pixel dimensions are sized for
        300 DPI.  When that image is later stretched over a 300-DPI printer
        page, all program-drawn text becomes roughly three times too small.
        Keep the canvas at 300 DPI in both background and blank-paper modes.
        """
        image = QImage()
        if include_background:
            loaded = QImage(str(path))
            if not loaded.isNull():
                image = loaded.convertToFormat(QImage.Format.Format_ARGB32)

        if image.isNull():
            width = round(size[0] / 25.4 * PRINT_DPI)
            height = round(size[1] / 25.4 * PRINT_DPI)
            image = QImage(width, height, QImage.Format.Format_ARGB32)
            image.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.white)

        # Set this after loading/conversion or creation because format
        # conversion may not preserve the source image resolution metadata.
        image.setDotsPerMeterX(PRINT_DOTS_PER_METER)
        image.setDotsPerMeterY(PRINT_DOTS_PER_METER)
        return image

    @staticmethod
    def _wrapped_lines(
        text: str,
        metrics: QFontMetricsF,
        width: float,
    ) -> list[tuple[str, bool]]:
        """Return wrapped lines and whether each line may be justified."""
        result: list[tuple[str, bool]] = []
        for paragraph in str(text or "").split("\n"):
            if not paragraph:
                result.append(("", False))
                continue
            words = paragraph.split()
            if not words:
                result.append(("", False))
                continue
            paragraph_lines: list[str] = []
            current = words[0]
            for word in words[1:]:
                candidate = f"{current} {word}"
                if metrics.horizontalAdvance(candidate) <= width:
                    current = candidate
                else:
                    paragraph_lines.append(current)
                    current = word
            paragraph_lines.append(current)
            for index, line in enumerate(paragraph_lines):
                result.append((line, index < len(paragraph_lines) - 1))
        return result or [("", False)]

    @classmethod
    def _curriculum_row_geometry(
        cls,
        image: QImage,
        page_size: tuple[float, float],
        name_style: Mapping[str, Any],
        text: str,
        between_rows_spacing: float = 1.50,
    ) -> tuple[float, float]:
        """Return content height and advance for one curriculum record.

        One discipline is one logical table row.  Wrapped lines inside the
        discipline cell use single spacing.  The first text line of the next
        discipline begins at the template-configured spacing after the final
        line of the current discipline.  The same top coordinate is used for the row
        number, hours and grade, so those values align with the first line of
        the discipline even when its title wraps to several lines.
        """

        font = QFont(str(name_style.get("family", APPENDIX_DEFAULT_FONT)))
        font.setPointSizeF(float(name_style.get("size", 9.0) or 9.0))
        font.setBold(bool(name_style.get("bold", False)))
        font.setItalic(bool(name_style.get("italic", False)))
        metrics = QFontMetricsF(font, image)
        sx = image.width() / page_size[0]
        sy = image.height() / page_size[1]
        width_px = max(1.0, float(name_style.get("w", 0.0) or 0.0) * sx)
        line_count = max(1, len(cls._wrapped_lines(text, metrics, width_px)))
        line_step_mm = max(1.0, metrics.lineSpacing()) / sy
        line_height_mm = max(1.0, metrics.height()) / sy
        content_height_mm = line_height_mm + (line_count - 1) * line_step_mm
        row_advance_mm = (
            line_count - 1 + float(between_rows_spacing)
        ) * line_step_mm
        return content_height_mm, row_advance_mm

    @staticmethod
    def _apply_appendix_skew(
        painter: QPainter,
        data: DiplomaPrintData,
        page: str,
    ) -> float:
        """Shear only program-drawn appendix content to counter paper skew.

        The background has already been loaded into the image before the
        painter is transformed, so the typographic blank remains untouched.
        At x=0 the vertical movement is zero; at the right edge it equals the
        saved correction in millimetres.  A negative value raises the right
        edge and a positive value lowers it.
        """

        right_edge_offset_mm = appendix_right_edge_offset(data.layout, page)
        if abs(right_edge_offset_mm) < 0.0001:
            return 0.0
        painter.shear(0.0, right_edge_offset_mm / APPENDIX_SIZE[0])
        return right_edge_offset_mm

    @staticmethod
    def _horizontal_alignment_flag(alignment: str) -> Qt.AlignmentFlag:
        if alignment == "left" or alignment == "justify":
            return Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft
        if alignment == "right":
            return Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight
        return Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignHCenter

    @staticmethod
    def _draw_justified_line(
        painter: QPainter,
        metrics: QFontMetricsF,
        rect: QRectF,
        baseline: float,
        text: str,
    ) -> None:
        words = text.split()
        if len(words) < 2:
            painter.drawText(QPointF(rect.left(), baseline), text)
            return
        words_width = sum(metrics.horizontalAdvance(word) for word in words)
        gap = max(0.0, (rect.width() - words_width) / (len(words) - 1))
        x = rect.left()
        for word in words:
            painter.drawText(QPointF(x, baseline), word)
            x += metrics.horizontalAdvance(word) + gap

    @classmethod
    def _draw(
        cls,
        painter: QPainter,
        image: QImage,
        page_size: tuple[float, float],
        text: str,
        x: float,
        y: float,
        w: float,
        h: float,
        *,
        family: str = "Times New Roman",
        size: float = 12.0,
        bold: bool = False,
        italic: bool = False,
        alignment: str = "center",
        line_spacing: float = 1.0,
        vertical_alignment: str = "center",
        text_vertical_offset_mm: float = 0.0,
        word_wrap: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        font = QFont(family)
        font.setPointSizeF(size)
        font.setBold(bold)
        font.setItalic(italic)
        painter.setFont(font)

        alignment = str(alignment or "center").lower()
        if alignment not in {"left", "center", "right", "justify"}:
            alignment = "center"
        line_spacing = max(0.50, min(3.00, float(line_spacing or 1.0)))
        vertical_alignment = str(vertical_alignment or "center").lower()
        if vertical_alignment not in {"top", "center", "bottom"}:
            vertical_alignment = "center"
        text_vertical_offset_mm = max(
            -10.0, min(10.0, float(text_vertical_offset_mm or 0.0))
        )

        sx, sy = image.width() / page_size[0], image.height() / page_size[1]
        rect = QRectF(x * sx, y * sy, w * sx, h * sy)
        text_offset_px = text_vertical_offset_mm * sy
        metrics = QFontMetricsF(font, image)
        if word_wrap:
            lines = cls._wrapped_lines(str(text or ""), metrics, rect.width())
        else:
            lines = [(str(text or ""), False)]

        painter.save()
        painter.setClipRect(rect)
        try:
            if len(lines) <= 1:
                horizontal_flag = cls._horizontal_alignment_flag(alignment)
                if vertical_alignment == "center":
                    # Preserve the legacy/default drawing path exactly when the
                    # offset is zero. A translated rectangle moves only the text
                    # while clipping remains tied to the calibrated field.
                    text_rect = QRectF(rect)
                    text_rect.translate(0.0, text_offset_px)
                else:
                    line_height = metrics.height()
                    line_top = (
                        rect.top()
                        if vertical_alignment == "top"
                        else rect.bottom() - line_height
                    ) + text_offset_px
                    text_rect = QRectF(
                        rect.left(), line_top, rect.width(), line_height
                    )
                painter.drawText(
                    text_rect,
                    int(horizontal_flag | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
                    lines[0][0],
                )
                return

            line_step = max(1.0, metrics.lineSpacing() * line_spacing)
            line_height = metrics.height()
            block_height = line_height + (len(lines) - 1) * line_step
            if vertical_alignment == "top":
                top = rect.top()
            elif vertical_alignment == "bottom":
                top = rect.bottom() - block_height
            else:
                top = rect.center().y() - block_height / 2.0
            top += text_offset_px
            horizontal_flag = cls._horizontal_alignment_flag(alignment)
            for index, (line, may_justify) in enumerate(lines):
                line_top = top + index * line_step
                line_rect = QRectF(rect.left(), line_top, rect.width(), line_height)
                if alignment == "justify" and may_justify and line.strip():
                    baseline = line_top + metrics.ascent()
                    cls._draw_justified_line(
                        painter,
                        metrics,
                        line_rect,
                        baseline,
                        line,
                    )
                else:
                    painter.drawText(
                        line_rect,
                        int(horizontal_flag | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
                        line,
                    )
        finally:
            painter.restore()

    def _diploma_full_name_for_field(
        self,
        image: QImage,
        data: DiplomaPrintData,
    ) -> str:
        """Split a long diploma F.I.O. after the surname, as on certificates."""
        normalized = " ".join(str(data.full_name or "").split())
        parts = normalized.split()
        if len(parts) < 2:
            return normalized
        style = self._layout(data, "diploma_full_name")
        font = QFont(str(style.get("family", "Times New Roman") or "Times New Roman"))
        font.setPointSizeF(float(style.get("size", 12.0) or 12.0))
        font.setBold(bool(style.get("bold", False)))
        font.setItalic(bool(style.get("italic", False)))
        metrics = QFontMetricsF(font, image)
        width_px = max(
            1.0,
            float(style.get("w", 0.0) or 0.0) * image.width() / DIPLOMA_SIZE[0],
        )
        if metrics.horizontalAdvance(normalized) <= max(1.0, width_px - 2.0):
            return normalized
        return f"{parts[0]}\n{' '.join(parts[1:])}"

    @staticmethod
    def _normalized_qualification(value: Any) -> str:
        # Kept as a compatibility wrapper for older callers and tests.
        return normalize_qualification(value)

    def _layout(self, data: DiplomaPrintData, key: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        # Every diploma uses the sole common calibration profile.
        result = merged_field_layout(
            DEFAULT_LAYOUT[key],
            data.layout,
            key,
        )
        if key == "appendix_education_level":
            # Compatibility adjustment for earlier template versions where the
            # field width was too narrow and wrapped "высшем/среднем
            # профессиональном" to two lines.
            width = float(result.get("w", 0.0) or 0.0)
            x = float(result.get("x", 0.0) or 0.0)
            if width < 62.0:
                right_edge = x + width if width > 0 else 137.0
                right_edge = max(right_edge, 137.0)
                result["w"] = 62.0
                result["x"] = right_edge - 62.0
            size = float(result.get("size", 0.0) or 0.0)
            if abs(size - 9.5) < 0.001:
                result["size"] = 10.5
        if key == "appendix_organization":
            width = float(result.get("w", 0.0) or 0.0)
            x = float(result.get("x", 0.0) or 0.0)
            if abs(width - 86.0) < 0.2 and abs(x - 46.0) < 0.2:
                result["x"] = round((APPENDIX_SIZE[0] - width) / 2.0, 1)
        return result

    def effective_field_layout(
        self,
        data: DiplomaPrintData,
        key: str,
        *,
        emulate_physical_print: bool = False,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return the exact calibrated field rectangle used by every output.

        ``emulate_physical_print`` remains as a backward-compatible keyword for
        callers from older update overlays, but it no longer changes geometry.
        Preview, calibration, PDF and printer rendering all read the same saved
        x/y/w/h values from the selected calibration template.
        """

        result = self._layout(data, key)
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def _compose_organization_with_license(data: DiplomaPrintData) -> str:
        organization = str(data.organization_name or "")
        license_number = str(data.license_number or "")
        license_date = normalize_document_date(data.license_date)
        if license_number:
            organization += f"\nЛицензия № {license_number}"
            if license_date:
                organization += f" от {license_date}"
        return organization.strip()

    @classmethod
    def _format_template(cls, template: str, context: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
        try:
            return str(template or "").format_map(_SafeFormatDict(context))
        except Exception:
            return str(template or "")

    def _build_context(
        self,
        data: DiplomaPrintData,
        extra: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        appendix_number = str(data.appendix_number or "")
        blank_number = str(data.blank_number or "")
        context: dict[str, Any] = {
            "full_name": str(data.full_name or ""),
            "last_name": str(data.last_name or ""),
            "first_name": str(data.first_name or ""),
            "middle_name": str(data.middle_name or ""),
            "first_middle_name": " ".join(part for part in (str(data.first_name or ""), str(data.middle_name or "")) if part).strip(),
            "blank_number": blank_number,
            "registration_number": str(data.registration_number or ""),
            "issue_city": str(data.issue_city or ""),
            "issue_date": str(data.issue_date or ""),
            "organization_name": str(data.organization_name or ""),
            "license_number": str(data.license_number or ""),
            "license_date": normalize_document_date(data.license_date),
            "organization_with_license": self._compose_organization_with_license(data),
            "decision_date": str(data.decision_date or data.issue_date or ""),
            "qualification": str(data.qualification or ""),
            "professional_area": str(data.professional_area or ""),
            "chairman_name": str(data.chairman_name or ""),
            "director_name": str(data.director_name or ""),
            "secretary_name": str(data.secretary_name or ""),
            "appendix_number": appendix_number,
            "appendix_number_or_blank": appendix_number or blank_number,
            "appendix_sheet_number": int(data.appendix_sheet_number or 1),
            "appendix_sheet_count": int(data.appendix_sheet_count or 1),
            "appendix_sheet_label": (
                f"Лист № {int(data.appendix_sheet_number or 1)}"
                if int(data.appendix_sheet_count or 1) > 1
                else ""
            ),
            "education_level": str(data.education_level or ""),
            "study_start_day": str(data.study_start_day or ""),
            "study_start_month": str(data.study_start_month or ""),
            "study_start_year": str(data.study_start_year or ""),
            "study_end_day": str(data.study_end_day or ""),
            "study_end_month": str(data.study_end_month or ""),
            "study_end_year": str(data.study_end_year or ""),
            "program_name": str(data.program_name or ""),
            "internship": str(data.internship or ""),
            "thesis": str(data.thesis or ""),
            "total_hours": int(data.total_hours or 0),
            "hours_word": hours_word(int(data.total_hours or 0)),
        }
        if extra:
            context.update({key: value for key, value in extra.items()})
        return context

    def _resolve_text(
        self,
        data: DiplomaPrintData,
        key: str,
        fallback: str,
        *,
        extra: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        style = self._layout(data, key)
        template = str(style.get("text_template", "") or "")
        if not template:
            template = DIPLOMA_TEXT_TEMPLATE_DEFAULTS.get(key, "")
        # Compatibility with layouts saved by earlier releases.  The old
        # appendix total template hard-coded «часов».  Preserve the user's
        # template while making that standard fragment grammatically dynamic.
        if key == "appendix_total":
            template = template.replace(
                "{total_hours} часов",
                "{total_hours} {hours_word}",
            )
        if template:
            return self._format_template(template, self._build_context(data, extra))
        return str(fallback or "")

    def _split_appendix_program_name(
        self,
        image: QImage,
        data: DiplomaPrintData,
    ) -> tuple[str, str]:
        """Measure line 1 using its real calibrated font/width and auto-flow."""

        first_style = self._layout(data, "appendix_program_1")
        font = QFont(str(first_style.get("family", APPENDIX_DEFAULT_FONT)))
        font.setPointSizeF(float(first_style.get("size", 13.0) or 13.0))
        font.setBold(bool(first_style.get("bold", False)))
        font.setItalic(bool(first_style.get("italic", False)))
        metrics = QFontMetricsF(font, image)
        sx = image.width() / APPENDIX_SIZE[0]
        first_width_px = max(1.0, float(first_style.get("w", 0.0) or 0.0) * sx)
        return split_appendix_program_text(
            data.program_name,
            lambda candidate: metrics.horizontalAdvance(candidate) <= first_width_px,
        )

    def _draw_key(
        self,
        painter: QPainter,
        image: QImage,
        page_size: tuple[float, float],
        data: DiplomaPrintData,
        key: str,
        text: str,
        **overrides: Any,
    ) -> None:
        style = self._layout(data, key)
        style.update(overrides)
        if not bool(style.get("visible", True)):
            return
        self._draw(
            painter,
            image,
            page_size,
            text,
            x=float(style["x"]),
            y=float(style["y"]),
            w=float(style["w"]),
            h=float(style["h"]),
            family=str(style.get("family", "Times New Roman") or "Times New Roman"),
            size=float(style.get("size", 12.0) or 12.0),
            bold=bool(style.get("bold", False)),
            italic=bool(style.get("italic", False)),
            alignment=str(style.get("alignment", "center") or "center"),
            line_spacing=float(style.get("line_spacing", 1.0) or 1.0),
            vertical_alignment=str(
                style.get("vertical_alignment", "center") or "center"
            ),
            text_vertical_offset_mm=float(
                style.get("text_vertical_offset_mm", 0.0) or 0.0
            ),
            word_wrap=bool(style.get("word_wrap", True)),
        )

    def render_diploma(
        self,
        data: DiplomaPrintData,
        include_background: bool = True,
        *,
        field_x_offsets_mm: Mapping[str, float] | None = None,
        field_y_offsets_mm: Mapping[str, float] | None = None,
    ) -> QImage:
        """Render the diploma from saved calibration coordinates.

        ``field_x_offsets_mm`` and ``field_y_offsets_mm`` are reserved for
        final physical-printer compensation of explicitly named fields.
        Normal preview, PDF and calibration callers omit them and therefore
        receive the unchanged calibrated document.
        """

        image = self._image(
            self.backgrounds["diploma"], DIPLOMA_SIZE, include_background
        )
        painter = QPainter(image)
        if not painter.isActive():
            raise RuntimeError("Не удалось начать отрисовку документа.")
        x_offsets = field_x_offsets_mm or {}
        y_offsets = field_y_offsets_mm or {}

        def draw_field(key: str, value: str) -> None:
            offset_x = float(x_offsets.get(key, 0.0) or 0.0)
            offset_y = float(y_offsets.get(key, 0.0) or 0.0)
            overrides: dict[str, Any] = {}
            if offset_x or offset_y:
                calibrated = self._layout(data, key)
                if offset_x:
                    overrides["x"] = float(calibrated["x"]) + offset_x
                if offset_y:
                    overrides["y"] = float(calibrated["y"]) + offset_y
            self._draw_key(
                painter,
                image,
                DIPLOMA_SIZE,
                data,
                key,
                value,
                **overrides,
            )

        try:
            # Saved calibration coordinates remain authoritative.  Only the
            # explicitly supplied field offsets can alter the physical-print
            # raster, and no other field geometry is touched.
            if data.is_duplicate:
                self._draw(
                    painter, image, DIPLOMA_SIZE, "ДУБЛИКАТ",
                    224.0, 8.5, 42.0, 8.0,
                    family="Times New Roman", size=12.0, bold=True,
                    alignment="right",
                )
            draw_field(
                "diploma_registration_number",
                self._resolve_text(
                    data,
                    "diploma_registration_number",
                    data.registration_number,
                ),
            )
            draw_field(
                "diploma_issue_city",
                self._resolve_text(data, "diploma_issue_city", data.issue_city),
            )
            draw_field(
                "diploma_issue_date",
                self._resolve_text(data, "diploma_issue_date", data.issue_date),
            )
            diploma_name_style = self._layout(data, "diploma_full_name")
            diploma_name_template = str(
                diploma_name_style.get("text_template", "")
                or DIPLOMA_TEXT_TEMPLATE_DEFAULTS.get("diploma_full_name", "{full_name}")
            ).strip()
            diploma_name_text = self._resolve_text(
                data, "diploma_full_name", data.full_name
            )
            if diploma_name_template == "{full_name}":
                diploma_name_text = self._diploma_full_name_for_field(image, data)
            draw_field(
                "diploma_full_name",
                diploma_name_text,
            )
            draw_field(
                "diploma_organization",
                self._resolve_text(
                    data,
                    "diploma_organization",
                    self._compose_organization_with_license(data),
                ),
            )
            draw_field(
                "diploma_decision_date",
                self._resolve_text(
                    data,
                    "diploma_decision_date",
                    data.decision_date or data.issue_date,
                ),
            )
            draw_field(
                "diploma_qualification",
                self._resolve_text(
                    data, "diploma_qualification", data.qualification
                ),
            )
            draw_field(
                "diploma_professional_area",
                self._resolve_text(
                    data,
                    "diploma_professional_area",
                    data.professional_area,
                ),
            )
            draw_field(
                "diploma_chairman",
                self._resolve_text(data, "diploma_chairman", data.chairman_name),
            )
            draw_field(
                "diploma_director",
                self._resolve_text(data, "diploma_director", data.director_name),
            )
            draw_field(
                "diploma_secretary",
                self._resolve_text(data, "diploma_secretary", data.secretary_name),
            )
        finally:
            if painter.isActive():
                painter.end()
        return image

    def render_appendix_front(
        self, data: DiplomaPrintData, include_background: bool = True
    ) -> QImage:
        image = self._image(
            self.backgrounds["appendix_front"], APPENDIX_SIZE, include_background
        )
        painter = QPainter(image)
        if not painter.isActive():
            raise RuntimeError("Не удалось начать отрисовку документа.")
        try:
            self._apply_appendix_skew(painter, data, "appendix_front")
            draw = self._draw_key
            number = data.appendix_number or data.blank_number
            draw(
                painter, image, APPENDIX_SIZE, data,
                "appendix_number",
                self._resolve_text(data, "appendix_number", number),
            )
            if data.appendix_sheet_count > 1:
                draw(
                    painter, image, APPENDIX_SIZE, data,
                    "appendix_sheet",
                    self._resolve_text(
                        data,
                        "appendix_sheet",
                        f"Лист № {data.appendix_sheet_number}",
                    ),
                )
            draw(
                painter, image, APPENDIX_SIZE, data,
                "appendix_last_name",
                self._resolve_text(data, "appendix_last_name", data.last_name),
            )
            first_middle = " ".join(
                part for part in (str(data.first_name or ""), str(data.middle_name or "")) if part
            ).strip()
            draw(
                painter, image, APPENDIX_SIZE, data,
                "appendix_first_middle_name",
                self._resolve_text(data, "appendix_first_middle_name", first_middle),
            )
            draw(
                painter, image, APPENDIX_SIZE, data,
                "appendix_education_level",
                self._resolve_text(data, "appendix_education_level", data.education_level),
            )
            for key, text in (
                ("appendix_study_start_day", data.study_start_day),
                ("appendix_study_start_month", data.study_start_month),
                ("appendix_study_start_year", data.study_start_year),
                ("appendix_study_end_day", data.study_end_day),
                ("appendix_study_end_month", data.study_end_month),
                ("appendix_study_end_year", data.study_end_year),
                ("appendix_organization", data.organization_name),
            ):
                draw(
                    painter,
                    image,
                    APPENDIX_SIZE,
                    data,
                    key,
                    self._resolve_text(data, key, str(text or "")),
                )

            # RC67: the programme name always uses two stable calibrated
            # baselines.  Whether line 2 is needed no longer changes the
            # vertical position of line 1.
            program_line_1, program_line_2 = self._split_appendix_program_name(
                image, data
            )
            for key, text in (
                ("appendix_program_1", program_line_1),
                ("appendix_program_2", program_line_2),
            ):
                draw(
                    painter,
                    image,
                    APPENDIX_SIZE,
                    data,
                    key,
                    text,
                    word_wrap=False,
                )

            for key, text in (
                ("appendix_internship", data.internship),
                ("appendix_thesis", data.thesis),
            ):
                draw(
                    painter,
                    image,
                    APPENDIX_SIZE,
                    data,
                    key,
                    self._resolve_text(data, key, str(text or "")),
                )
        finally:
            if painter.isActive():
                painter.end()
        return image

    def appendix_curriculum_fit_count(
        self,
        data: DiplomaPrintData,
        curriculum: list[Mapping[str, Any]],
    ) -> tuple[int, int]:
        """Return how many curriculum records fit in the configured table."""

        total = len(curriculum)
        if total == 0:
            return 0, 0
        image = self._image(
            self.backgrounds["appendix_back"], APPENDIX_SIZE, False
        )
        column_styles = {
            key: self._layout(data, key)
            for key in (
                "appendix_curriculum_number",
                "appendix_curriculum_name",
                "appendix_curriculum_hours",
                "appendix_curriculum_grade",
            )
        }
        available_height = min(
            max(0.0, float(style.get("h", 0.0) or 0.0))
            for style in column_styles.values()
        )
        name_style = column_styles["appendix_curriculum_name"]
        between_rows_spacing = appendix_curriculum_row_spacing(data.layout)
        row_offset = 0.0
        rendered = 0
        for row in curriculum:
            content_height, row_advance = self._curriculum_row_geometry(
                image,
                APPENDIX_SIZE,
                name_style,
                str(row.get("name", "") or ""),
                between_rows_spacing,
            )
            if row_offset + content_height > available_height + 0.001:
                break
            rendered += 1
            row_offset += row_advance
        return rendered, total

    def render_appendix_back(
        self,
        data: DiplomaPrintData,
        curriculum: list[Mapping[str, Any]],
        include_background: bool = True,
        *,
        start_index: int = 1,
    ) -> QImage:
        image = self._image(
            self.backgrounds["appendix_back"], APPENDIX_SIZE, include_background
        )
        painter = QPainter(image)
        if not painter.isActive():
            raise RuntimeError("Не удалось начать отрисовку документа.")
        try:
            self._apply_appendix_skew(painter, data, "appendix_back")
            column_keys = (
                "appendix_curriculum_number",
                "appendix_curriculum_name",
                "appendix_curriculum_hours",
                "appendix_curriculum_grade",
            )
            column_styles = {
                key: self._layout(data, key)
                for key in column_keys
            }
            available_height = min(
                max(0.0, float(style.get("h", 0.0) or 0.0))
                for style in column_styles.values()
            )
            name_style = column_styles["appendix_curriculum_name"]
            between_rows_spacing = appendix_curriculum_row_spacing(data.layout)
            row_offset = 0.0
            for index, row in enumerate(
                curriculum, start=max(1, int(start_index or 1))
            ):
                name = str(row.get("name", "") or "")
                content_height, row_advance = self._curriculum_row_geometry(
                    image,
                    APPENDIX_SIZE,
                    name_style,
                    name,
                    between_rows_spacing,
                )
                if row_offset + content_height > available_height + 0.001:
                    break
                for key, text in (
                    ("appendix_curriculum_number", str(index)),
                    ("appendix_curriculum_name", name),
                    ("appendix_curriculum_hours", str(row.get("hours", "") or "")),
                    ("appendix_curriculum_grade", str(row.get("grade", "") or "")),
                ):
                    style = column_styles[key]
                    overrides = {
                        "y": float(style["y"]) + row_offset,
                        "h": content_height,
                        # Every value in the logical row starts at the same
                        # top coordinate as the first line of the discipline.
                        "vertical_alignment": "top",
                    }
                    if key == "appendix_curriculum_name":
                        # Wrapped lines inside one discipline use normal
                        # single spacing.  The 1.5 spacing between disciplines
                        # is applied by row_advance, not inside this text block.
                        overrides["line_spacing"] = 1.0
                    if key == "appendix_curriculum_number":
                        overrides["alignment"] = "center"
                    self._draw_key(
                        painter,
                        image,
                        APPENDIX_SIZE,
                        data,
                        key,
                        text,
                        **overrides,
                    )
                row_offset += row_advance
            try:
                total = int(data.total_hours or 0)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                total = 0
            # Compatibility fallback for older callers that do not yet pass the
            # total duration from the course catalog.
            if total <= 0:
                total = sum(int(row.get("hours", 0) or 0) for row in curriculum)
            if int(data.appendix_sheet_count or 1) > 1 and int(data.appendix_sheet_number or 1) == 1:
                total_text = "----------"
            else:
                total_text = self._resolve_text(
                    data,
                    "appendix_total",
                    format_hours(total),
                    extra={
                        "total_hours": total,
                        "hours_word": hours_word(total),
                    },
                )
            # Fifteen non-breaking spaces on the right preserve the calibrated
            # visual offset in preview, PDF export and printer output.
            total_text += "\u00a0" * 15
            self._draw_key(
                painter, image, APPENDIX_SIZE, data,
                "appendix_total",
                total_text,
            )
            self._draw_key(
                painter, image, APPENDIX_SIZE, data,
                "appendix_director",
                self._resolve_text(data, "appendix_director", data.director_name),
            )
            self._draw_key(
                painter, image, APPENDIX_SIZE, data,
                "appendix_secretary",
                self._resolve_text(data, "appendix_secretary", data.secretary_name),
            )
        finally:
            if painter.isActive():
                painter.end()
        return image


def save_images_pdf(
    path: str | Path,
    images: list[QImage],
    sizes: list[tuple[float, float]],
) -> None:
    if len(images) != len(sizes):
        raise ValueError("Количество изображений и размеров страниц не совпадает.")
    if not images:
        raise ValueError("Нет страниц для сохранения в PDF.")

    writer = QPdfWriter(str(path))
    writer.setResolution(300)
    painter = QPainter()
    try:
        for index, (image, size) in enumerate(zip(images, sizes, strict=True)):
            page_size = QPageSize(
                QSizeF(size[0], size[1]),
                QPageSize.Unit.Millimeter,
                "Бланк",
                QPageSize.SizeMatchPolicy.ExactMatch,
            )
            writer.setPageLayout(
                QPageLayout(
                    page_size,
                    QPageLayout.Orientation.Portrait,
                    QMarginsF(0, 0, 0, 0),
                    QPageLayout.Unit.Millimeter,
                )
            )
            if index == 0:
                if not painter.begin(writer):
                    raise OSError("Не удалось начать формирование PDF-файла.")
            elif not writer.newPage():
                raise OSError("Не удалось добавить страницу в PDF-файл.")
            painter.drawImage(
                writer.pageLayout().paintRectPixels(writer.resolution()),
                image,
            )
    finally:
        if painter.isActive():
            painter.end()

from __future__ import annotations

"""Pure rules shared by diploma calibration, preview and printing.

Diploma field geometry now has one common settings profile.  Legacy
qualification-specific profiles are removed on load and by the database
migration so calibration, preview, PDF and printing always consume the same
common layout.
"""

from copy import deepcopy
from typing import Any, Callable, Iterable, Mapping

QUALIFICATION_LAYOUTS_KEY = "__qualification_layouts__"
SELECTED_QUALIFICATION_KEY = "__selected_qualification__"
SELECTED_PROFESSIONAL_AREA_KEY = "__selected_professional_area__"
LAYOUT_VARIANT_SELECTION_KEY = "__layout_variant_selection__"
LAYOUT_VARIANT_AUTO = "__auto__"
LAYOUT_VARIANT_COMMON = "__common__"

# Since RC23 the coordinates saved by the diploma calibration window are the
# final document coordinates used by preview, PDF and printing.  Older builds
# kept a measured Samsung-driver appearance offset outside the template and
# applied it only to calibration/preview/PDF.  The marker below allows those
# legacy layouts to be upgraded exactly once without moving the visible fields.
DIPLOMA_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_KEY = "__diploma_coordinate_system__"
DIPLOMA_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_CALIBRATION = "calibration_final_v1"
LEGACY_DIPLOMA_APPEARANCE_OFFSET_X_MM = 0.4
LEGACY_DIPLOMA_APPEARANCE_OFFSET_Y_MM = -4.0

# Template-level correction for a repeatable diagonal paper-feed skew when
# printing diploma appendices.  The value is the requested vertical movement
# of program-drawn content at the right edge of an A5 page, in millimetres.
# The left document edge remains at zero.  Negative values raise the right
# edge; positive values lower it.
APPENDIX_FRONT_RIGHT_EDGE_OFFSET_KEY = (
    "__appendix_front_right_edge_vertical_offset_mm__"
)
APPENDIX_BACK_RIGHT_EDGE_OFFSET_KEY = (
    "__appendix_back_right_edge_vertical_offset_mm__"
)
APPENDIX_SKEW_MIN_MM = -10.0
APPENDIX_SKEW_MAX_MM = 10.0

# Template-level spacing between logical curriculum rows on the appendix back.
# Wrapped lines inside one discipline always remain at single spacing.
APPENDIX_CURRICULUM_ROW_SPACING_KEY = (
    "__appendix_curriculum_between_rows_spacing__"
)
APPENDIX_CURRICULUM_ROW_SPACING_DEFAULT = 1.50
APPENDIX_CURRICULUM_ROW_SPACING_MIN = 1.00
APPENDIX_CURRICULUM_ROW_SPACING_MAX = 3.00

_RESERVED_LAYOUT_KEYS = frozenset(
    {
        QUALIFICATION_LAYOUTS_KEY,
        SELECTED_QUALIFICATION_KEY,
        SELECTED_PROFESSIONAL_AREA_KEY,
        LAYOUT_VARIANT_SELECTION_KEY,
        DIPLOMA_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_KEY,
        APPENDIX_FRONT_RIGHT_EDGE_OFFSET_KEY,
        APPENDIX_BACK_RIGHT_EDGE_OFFSET_KEY,
        APPENDIX_CURRICULUM_ROW_SPACING_KEY,
    }
)



def split_appendix_program_text(
    program_name: object,
    first_line_fits: Callable[[str], bool],
) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Split a programme title into the two physical lines of the blank.

    ``first_line_fits`` measures text using the actual font and calibrated width
    of line 1.  Words are never divided.  Russian angle quotes surround the
    complete title across one or two lines.
    """

    normalized = " ".join(str(program_name or "").split())
    if not normalized:
        return "", ""

    complete = f"«{normalized}»"
    if first_line_fits(complete):
        return complete, ""

    words = normalized.split()
    split_after = 0
    for index in range(1, len(words) + 1):
        candidate = "«" + " ".join(words[:index])
        if first_line_fits(candidate):
            split_after = index
        else:
            break

    if split_after <= 0:
        return "", complete
    if split_after >= len(words):
        split_after = max(0, len(words) - 1)
        if split_after == 0:
            return "", complete

    first = "«" + " ".join(words[:split_after])
    second = " ".join(words[split_after:]) + "»"
    return first, second


def _upgrade_appendix_program_fields(layout: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Migrate the former single programme rectangle to RC67's two lines.

    Existing users keep the exact geometry/font of the former field for line 1.
    Line 2 inherits its text formatting, starts farther left and uses the same
    right edge.  Saving the calibration once persists the new two-field layout.
    """

    legacy = layout.get("appendix_program")
    if not isinstance(legacy, Mapping):
        return layout
    legacy_value = deepcopy(dict(legacy))

    if "appendix_program_1" not in layout:
        first = deepcopy(legacy_value)
        first["label"] = "Наименование программы 1"
        layout["appendix_program_1"] = first

    if "appendix_program_2" not in layout:
        second = deepcopy(legacy_value)
        second["label"] = "Наименование программы 2"
        try:
            legacy_x = float(legacy_value.get("x", 43.0) or 43.0)
            legacy_w = float(legacy_value.get("w", 89.0) or 89.0)
            right_edge = legacy_x + legacy_w
            second_x = min(20.0, legacy_x)
            second["x"] = second_x
            second["w"] = max(1.0, right_edge - second_x)
            second["y"] = float(legacy_value.get("y", 120.0) or 120.0) + 6.0
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            second.update({"x": 20.0, "y": 126.0, "w": 112.0})
        layout["appendix_program_2"] = second

    # The legacy key is intentionally removed so calibration, preview, PDF and
    # physical printing cannot accidentally draw the old wrapped field as well.
    layout.pop("appendix_program", None)
    return layout


def upgrade_diploma_layout_to_calibration_coordinates(
    layout: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return a layout whose saved diploma x/y values are final coordinates.

    RC17--RC22 emulated a printer-dependent shift only in calibration, preview
    and PDF.  Physical printing used the unshifted field coordinates.  RC23
    makes the calibration window authoritative: all output paths consume one
    saved geometry.  To preserve the user's current visual placement, legacy
    diploma fields are shifted once and tagged with a coordinate-system marker.
    """

    result: dict[str, Any] = (
        deepcopy(dict(layout)) if isinstance(layout, Mapping) else {}
    )
    if (
        result.get(DIPLOMA_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_KEY)
        == DIPLOMA_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_CALIBRATION
    ):
        return _upgrade_appendix_program_fields(strip_qualification_variants(result))

    def upgrade_field(field_key: str, raw_value: object) -> object:
        if not isinstance(raw_value, Mapping):
            return deepcopy(raw_value)
        value = deepcopy(dict(raw_value))
        page = str(value.get("page", "") or "")
        is_diploma = page == "diploma" or str(field_key).startswith("diploma_")
        if not is_diploma:
            return value
        if "x" in value:
            try:
                value["x"] = float(value.get("x", 0.0) or 0.0) + (
                    LEGACY_DIPLOMA_APPEARANCE_OFFSET_X_MM
                )
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                pass
        if "y" in value:
            try:
                value["y"] = float(value.get("y", 0.0) or 0.0) + (
                    LEGACY_DIPLOMA_APPEARANCE_OFFSET_Y_MM
                )
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                pass
        return value

    for raw_key, raw_value in list(result.items()):
        key = str(raw_key)
        if key in _RESERVED_LAYOUT_KEYS:
            continue
        result[key] = upgrade_field(key, raw_value)

    # Qualification-specific variants were removed in RC28.  Keep only the
    # common profile and discard stale selection metadata from older databases.
    for obsolete_key in (
        QUALIFICATION_LAYOUTS_KEY,
        SELECTED_QUALIFICATION_KEY,
        SELECTED_PROFESSIONAL_AREA_KEY,
        LAYOUT_VARIANT_SELECTION_KEY,
    ):
        result.pop(obsolete_key, None)

    result[DIPLOMA_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_KEY] = (
        DIPLOMA_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_CALIBRATION
    )
    return _upgrade_appendix_program_fields(result)



def strip_qualification_variants(
    layout: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Return a deep-copied diploma layout containing common settings only."""

    result: dict[str, Any] = (
        deepcopy(dict(layout)) if isinstance(layout, Mapping) else {}
    )
    for obsolete_key in (
        QUALIFICATION_LAYOUTS_KEY,
        SELECTED_QUALIFICATION_KEY,
        SELECTED_PROFESSIONAL_AREA_KEY,
        LAYOUT_VARIANT_SELECTION_KEY,
    ):
        result.pop(obsolete_key, None)
    return _upgrade_appendix_program_fields(result)

def normalize_appendix_right_edge_offset(value: object) -> float:
    """Return a finite appendix skew correction clamped to the UI range."""

    try:
        result = float(value or 0.0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 0.0
    # ``NaN`` is the only ordinary float that is not equal to itself.  Avoid a
    # dependency on math.isfinite here so the pure helper remains lightweight.
    if result != result or result in {float("inf"), float("-inf")}:
        return 0.0
    return round(
        max(APPENDIX_SKEW_MIN_MM, min(APPENDIX_SKEW_MAX_MM, result)),
        1,
    )


def appendix_right_edge_offset(
    layout: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    page: str,
) -> float:
    """Read the saved right-edge vertical correction for an appendix side."""

    if not isinstance(layout, Mapping):
        return 0.0
    if str(page or "") == "appendix_front":
        key = APPENDIX_FRONT_RIGHT_EDGE_OFFSET_KEY
    elif str(page or "") == "appendix_back":
        key = APPENDIX_BACK_RIGHT_EDGE_OFFSET_KEY
    else:
        return 0.0
    return normalize_appendix_right_edge_offset(layout.get(key, 0.0))



def automatic_appendix_sheet_plan(
    fit_count: object, total_count: object
) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Return ``(sheet_count, second_sheet_from)`` for automatic layout.

    ``second_sheet_from`` is a 1-based discipline number.  Zero means that a
    second appendix sheet is not needed.  A discipline is never split between
    pages; callers provide the count of complete logical rows that fit.
    """
    try:
        fit = max(0, int(fit_count or 0))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        fit = 0
    try:
        total = max(0, int(total_count or 0))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        total = 0
    if total <= 0 or fit >= total:
        return 1, 0
    if fit <= 0:
        # No complete row fits sheet 1. Keep the supported two-sheet model and
        # start sheet 2 with the first discipline rather than silently losing it.
        return 2, 1
    return 2, fit + 1


def split_curriculum_for_appendix(
    curriculum: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]],
    sheet_count: object,
    second_sheet_from: object,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Split a curriculum at a 1-based discipline number.

    With one sheet, all rows stay on sheet 1.  With two sheets, the discipline
    whose number equals ``second_sheet_from`` becomes the first row of sheet 2.
    Order is preserved so numbering can continue across both sheets.
    """
    rows = [dict(row) for row in curriculum if isinstance(row, Mapping)]
    try:
        count = int(sheet_count or 1)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        count = 1
    if count != 2 or not rows:
        return rows, []
    try:
        start = int(second_sheet_from or 0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        start = 0
    if start <= 0:
        return rows, []
    start = min(max(1, start), len(rows))
    split_at = start - 1
    return rows[:split_at], rows[split_at:]

def normalize_appendix_curriculum_row_spacing(value: object) -> float:
    """Return a finite between-discipline spacing in the supported range."""

    try:
        result = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return APPENDIX_CURRICULUM_ROW_SPACING_DEFAULT
    if result != result or result in {float("inf"), float("-inf")}:
        return APPENDIX_CURRICULUM_ROW_SPACING_DEFAULT
    return round(
        max(
            APPENDIX_CURRICULUM_ROW_SPACING_MIN,
            min(APPENDIX_CURRICULUM_ROW_SPACING_MAX, result),
        ),
        2,
    )


def appendix_curriculum_row_spacing(
    layout: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
) -> float:
    """Read the saved spacing between curriculum records."""

    if not isinstance(layout, Mapping):
        return APPENDIX_CURRICULUM_ROW_SPACING_DEFAULT
    return normalize_appendix_curriculum_row_spacing(
        layout.get(
            APPENDIX_CURRICULUM_ROW_SPACING_KEY,
            APPENDIX_CURRICULUM_ROW_SPACING_DEFAULT,
        )
    )

def normalize_qualification(value: object) -> str:
    """Normalize a qualification for reliable, case-insensitive matching."""

    return " ".join(str(value or "").strip().split()).casefold()


def display_qualification(value: object) -> str:
    """Return a qualification with whitespace normalized for display/storage."""

    return " ".join(str(value or "").strip().split())


def qualification_layouts(layout: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    """Compatibility helper: qualification-specific profiles no longer exist."""

    return {}


def available_qualification_variants(
    layout: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
) -> list[str]:
    """Return no variants because only common settings are supported."""

    return []


def matching_qualification_variant(
    layout: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    qualification: object,
) -> str:
    return ""


def preferred_saved_layout_variant(
    layout: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    qualification: object,
    saved_selection: object = LAYOUT_VARIANT_AUTO,
) -> object:
    """Normalize every legacy choice to the sole common settings profile."""

def selected_qualification_variant(
    layout: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    qualification: object,
    selection: object = LAYOUT_VARIANT_AUTO,
) -> str:

def selected_qualification_layout(
    layout: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    qualification: object,
    selection: object = LAYOUT_VARIANT_AUTO,
) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    return {}


def sparse_layout_overrides(
    base_layout: Mapping[str, Any],
    candidate_layout: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    """Return property-level differences of ``candidate_layout`` from ``base``."""

    result: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for raw_key, raw_candidate in candidate_layout.items():
        key = str(raw_key)
        if key in _RESERVED_LAYOUT_KEYS:
            continue
        raw_base = base_layout.get(key)
        if not isinstance(raw_base, Mapping) or not isinstance(raw_candidate, Mapping):
            continue
        differences = {
            str(property_name): deepcopy(property_value)
            for property_name, property_value in raw_candidate.items()
            if raw_base.get(property_name) != property_value
        }
        if differences:
            result[key] = differences
    return result


def merged_field_layout(
    defaults: Mapping[str, Any],
    layout: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    field_key: str,
    *,
    qualification: object = "",
    selection: object = LAYOUT_VARIANT_COMMON,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Merge defaults with the sole common settings profile."""

    result = dict(defaults)
    if isinstance(layout, Mapping):
        common = layout.get(field_key, {})
        if isinstance(common, Mapping):
            result.update(dict(common))
    return result


def canonical_appendix_front_values(
    sheet1: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    sheet2: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    keys: Iterable[str],
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Build one canonical set for both appendix front sides.

    Sheet 1 is authoritative.  For legacy records where it is blank, a non-empty
    sheet-2 value is retained.  The returned values can then be written to both
    UI pages and to persistent storage.
    """

    first = sheet1 if isinstance(sheet1, Mapping) else {}
    second = sheet2 if isinstance(sheet2, Mapping) else {}
    result: dict[str, str] = {}
    for key in keys:
        first_value = str(first.get(key, "") or "").strip()
        second_value = str(second.get(key, "") or "").strip()
        result[str(key)] = first_value or second_value
    return result


def validate_template_layout(
    layout: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    *,
    required_fields: Iterable[str] = (),
) -> list[str]:
    """Return human-readable structural problems without modifying the layout."""

    issues: list[str] = []
    if not isinstance(layout, Mapping):
        return ["Настройки шаблона не являются объектом JSON."]

    for key in required_fields:
        if not isinstance(layout.get(key), Mapping):
            issues.append(f"Отсутствуют общие настройки поля «{key}».")

    valid_pages = {"diploma", "appendix_front", "appendix_back"}
    for raw_key, raw_value in layout.items():
        key = str(raw_key)
        if key in _RESERVED_LAYOUT_KEYS:
            continue
        if not isinstance(raw_value, Mapping):
            issues.append(f"Настройки поля «{key}» имеют неверный формат.")
            continue
        page = str(raw_value.get("page", "") or "")
        if page not in valid_pages:
            issues.append(f"У поля «{key}» не указана допустимая сторона бланка.")
        for number_key in ("x", "y", "w", "h", "size"):
            try:
                float(raw_value.get(number_key))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                issues.append(
                    f"У поля «{key}» параметр «{number_key}» не является числом."
                )
        for optional_number_key in ("line_spacing", "text_vertical_offset_mm"):
            if optional_number_key not in raw_value:
                continue
            try:
                float(raw_value.get(optional_number_key))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                issues.append(
                    f"У поля «{key}» параметр «{optional_number_key}» не является числом."
                )
        vertical_alignment = str(
            raw_value.get("vertical_alignment", "center") or "center"
        ).lower()
        if vertical_alignment not in {"top", "center", "bottom"}:
            issues.append(
                f"У поля «{key}» указано недопустимое вертикальное выравнивание."
            )

    return issues

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Any


_DOCUMENT_DATE_FORMATS = ("%d.%m.%Y", "%Y-%m-%d", "%Y.%m.%d", "%d/%m/%Y")


def parse_document_date(value: Any) -> date | None:
    """Parse every issue-date format supported by the application."""

    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.date()
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    for fmt in _DOCUMENT_DATE_FORMATS:
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(text[:10], fmt).date()
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return None


def normalize_document_date(value: Any) -> str:
    """Return the canonical document storage format ``ДД.ММ.ГГГГ``.

    Unknown legacy text is preserved instead of being silently discarded.
    """

    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return ""
    parsed = parse_document_date(text)
    return parsed.strftime("%d.%m.%Y") if parsed else text


def document_date_iso_key(value: Any) -> str:
    """Return an ISO key suitable for comparisons and SQLite sorting."""

    parsed = parse_document_date(value)
    return parsed.isoformat() if parsed else ""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import sys
import traceback
from logging.handlers import RotatingFileHandler
from pathlib import Path



LOG_DIRECTORY_NAME = "logs"
APPLICATION_LOG_NAME = "application.log"
ERROR_LOG_NAME = "errors.log"


def log_directory(data_dir: Path) -> Path:
    path = Path(data_dir) / LOG_DIRECTORY_NAME
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return path


def application_log_path(data_dir: Path) -> Path:
    return log_directory(data_dir) / APPLICATION_LOG_NAME


def error_log_path(data_dir: Path) -> Path:
    return log_directory(data_dir) / ERROR_LOG_NAME


def configure_logging(data_dir: Path) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    """Configure rotating application and error logs.

    The application log keeps general startup and workflow information.  The
    error log contains ERROR/CRITICAL records only and is shown in the built-in
    diagnostics window.
    """

    application_path = application_log_path(data_dir)
    errors_path = error_log_path(data_dir)
    root = logging.getLogger()
    root.setLevel(logging.INFO)

    # The application calls this once, but clearing our own file handlers makes
    # the function safe for tests and accidental repeated startup initialisation.
    for handler in list(root.handlers):
        if getattr(handler, "_dpo_logging_handler", False):
            root.removeHandler(handler)
            try:
                handler.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

    formatter = logging.Formatter(
        "%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s"
    )

    application_handler = RotatingFileHandler(
        application_path,
        maxBytes=2 * 1024 * 1024,
        backupCount=3,
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    application_handler.setLevel(logging.INFO)
    application_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
    application_handler._dpo_logging_handler = True  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    root.addHandler(application_handler)

    error_handler = RotatingFileHandler(
        errors_path,
        maxBytes=2 * 1024 * 1024,
        backupCount=5,
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    error_handler.setLevel(logging.ERROR)
    error_handler.setFormatter(formatter)
    error_handler._dpo_logging_handler = True  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    root.addHandler(error_handler)
    return application_path, errors_path


def install_exception_handler(errors_path: Path) -> None:
    """Log unhandled exceptions and show a non-technical user message."""

    def handle_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback) -> None:
        if issubclass(exc_type, KeyboardInterrupt):
            sys.__excepthook__(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback)
            return
        details = "".join(
            traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_traceback)
        )
        logging.getLogger("dpo_app.unhandled").critical(
            "Unhandled exception:\n%s", details
        )
        try:
            from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMessageBox
        except ImportError:
            return
        app = QApplication.instance()
        if app is not None:
            QMessageBox.critical(
                None,
                "Ошибка программы",
                "Операцию не удалось завершить из-за внутренней ошибки.\n\n"
                "Закройте это сообщение и откройте «Диагностика» в главном "
                "окне. Технические сведения сохранены в журнале ошибок:\n"
                f"{errors_path}",
            )

    sys.excepthook = handle_exception


def read_recent_errors(data_dir: Path, max_chars: int = 200_000) -> str:
    path = error_log_path(data_dir)
    if not path.exists():
        return "Журнал ошибок пока пуст."
    try:
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    except OSError as exc:
        return f"Не удалось прочитать журнал ошибок: {exc}"
    if not text.strip():
        return "Журнал ошибок пока пуст."
    return text[-max_chars:]


def clear_error_log(data_dir: Path) -> None:
    path = error_log_path(data_dir)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    resolved = path.resolve()
    cleared_open_handler = False
    for handler in logging.getLogger().handlers:
        base_name = getattr(handler, "baseFilename", "")
        if not base_name:
            continue
        try:
            if Path(base_name).resolve() != resolved:
                continue
        except OSError:
            continue
        handler.acquire()
        try:
            stream = getattr(handler, "stream", None)
            if stream is not None:
                stream.seek(0)
                stream.truncate(0)
                stream.flush()
                cleared_open_handler = True
        finally:
            handler.release()
    if not cleared_open_handler:
        path.write_text("", encoding="utf-8")

@dataclass
class ParsedExcelRow:
    source_row: int
    values: dict[str, Any]
    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    warnings: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def valid(self) -> bool:
        return not self.errors


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ExcelSheetData:
    sheet_name: str
    headers: tuple[str, ...]
    rows: tuple[tuple[Any, ...], ...]
    epoch: datetime


class ExcelImportError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def workbook_sheet_names(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    try:
        workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ExcelImportError(f"Не удалось открыть файл Excel: {exc}") from exc
    try:
        return list(workbook.sheetnames)
    finally:
        workbook.close()


def read_sheet(
    path: Path,
    sheet_name: str,
    header_row: int,
    has_headers: bool = True,
) -> ExcelSheetData:
    if header_row < 1:
        raise ExcelImportError("Номер строки заголовков должен быть не меньше 1.")
    try:
        workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ExcelImportError(f"Не удалось открыть файл Excel: {exc}") from exc
    try:
        if sheet_name not in workbook.sheetnames:
            raise ExcelImportError(f"Лист «{sheet_name}» не найден.")
        sheet = workbook[sheet_name]
        all_rows = list(sheet.iter_rows(min_row=header_row, values_only=True))
        if not all_rows:
            raise ExcelImportError("Строка заголовков отсутствует.")

        last_used_column = 0
        for values in all_rows:
            for index, value in enumerate(values, start=1):
                if _cell_has_value(value):
                    last_used_column = max(last_used_column, index)
        if last_used_column == 0:
            raise ExcelImportError("На выбранном листе нет данных.")

        first_values = tuple(all_rows[0][:last_used_column])
        if len(first_values) < last_used_column:
            first_values += (None,) * (last_used_column - len(first_values))
        if has_headers:
            headers = _unique_headers(first_values, preserve_trailing=True)
            data_rows = all_rows[1:]
        else:
            headers = _sample_headers(first_values)
            data_rows = all_rows

        rows: list[tuple[Any, ...]] = []
        for values in data_rows:
            normalized = tuple(values[:last_used_column])
            if len(normalized) < last_used_column:
                normalized += (None,) * (last_used_column - len(normalized))
            if any(_cell_has_value(value) for value in normalized):
                rows.append(normalized)
        return ExcelSheetData(
            sheet_name=sheet_name,
            headers=tuple(headers),
            rows=tuple(rows),
            epoch=workbook.epoch,
        )
    finally:
        workbook.close()


def auto_mapping(headers: Iterable[str]) -> dict[str, int | None]:
    normalized_headers = [_normalize_header(header) for header in headers]
    result: dict[str, int | None] = {field.key: None for field in IMPORT_FIELDS}
    used: set[int] = set()
    for field in IMPORT_FIELDS:
        aliases = {
            _normalize_header(field.title),
            *(_normalize_header(value) for value in field.aliases),
        }
        match: int | None = None
        for index, header in enumerate(normalized_headers):
            if index in used:
                continue
            if header in aliases:
                match = index
                break
        if match is None:
            for index, header in enumerate(normalized_headers):
                if index in used or not header:
                    continue
                if any(
                    len(alias) >= 3 and (alias in header or header in alias)
                    for alias in aliases
                ):
                    match = index
                    break
        result[field.key] = match
        if match is not None:
            used.add(match)
    return result


def parse_rows(
    sheet: ExcelSheetData,
    mapping: Mapping[str, int | None],
    header_row: int,
    has_headers: bool = True,
) -> list[ParsedExcelRow]:
    parsed: list[ParsedExcelRow] = []
    for offset, raw_row in enumerate(sheet.rows, start=1):
        source_row = header_row + offset if has_headers else header_row + offset - 1
        raw_values = {
            key: _mapped_value(raw_row, mapping.get(key))
            for key in mapping
        }
        row = _parse_row(source_row, raw_values, sheet.epoch)
        if row is not None:
            parsed.append(row)

    _mark_snils_identity_conflicts(parsed)
    return parsed


def _parse_row(
    source_row: int,
    raw: Mapping[str, Any],
    epoch: datetime,
) -> ParsedExcelRow | None:
    if not any(_cell_has_value(value) for value in raw.values()):
        return None

    imported_address = _text(raw.get("address"))
    values: dict[str, Any] = {
        "last_name": "",
        "first_name": "",
        "middle_name": "",
        "gender": "",
        "gender_source": "uncertain",
        "gender_reason": "",
        "birth_date": "",
        "snils": "",
        "postal_code": "",
        "address": imported_address,
        "imported_address": imported_address,
        "imported_postal_code": _text(raw.get("postal_code")),
        "address_sync_status": "failed" if imported_address else "",
        "fias_id": "",
        "fias_object_id": "",
        "phone": _text(raw.get("phone")),
        "email": _text(raw.get("email")),
        "notes": "",
        "course_name": "",
        "duration_hours": 0,
        "program_type": "",
        "registration_number": "",
        "issue_date": "",
        "track_number": "",
        "course_hours_warning": False,
    }
    errors: list[str] = []
    warnings: list[str] = []

    full_name = _text(raw.get("full_name"))
    parts = [part for part in re.split(r"[\s,;]+", full_name.strip()) if part]
    if len(parts) < 2:
        errors.append("ФИО должно содержать как минимум фамилию и имя")
    else:
        values["last_name"] = _title_name(parts[0])
        values["first_name"] = _title_name(parts[1])
        values["middle_name"] = " ".join(_title_name(part) for part in parts[2:])
        if len(parts) == 2:
            warnings.append("отчество в ФИО не указано")

        inference = infer_gender(
            str(values["first_name"] or ""),
            str(values["middle_name"] or ""),
        )
        values["gender"] = inference.gender
        values["gender_source"] = inference.source
        values["gender_reason"] = inference.reason
        if not inference.confident:
            warnings.append(
                "пол не определён однозначно: "
                + inference.reason
                + "; проверьте карточку вручную"
            )

    birth_date, date_error = _parse_date(raw.get("birth_date"), epoch)
    values["birth_date"] = birth_date
    if date_error:
        errors.append(date_error)

    snils_digits = normalize_snils(_text(raw.get("snils")))
    if snils_digits:
        if len(snils_digits) != 11:
            errors.append("СНИЛС должен содержать 11 цифр")
        else:
            valid, expected = validate_snils_checksum(snils_digits)
            if not valid:
                errors.append(
                    f"неверная контрольная сумма СНИЛС (должно быть {expected:02d})"
                )
            else:
                values["snils"] = format_snils(snils_digits)

    postal_digits = "".join(ch for ch in _text(raw.get("postal_code")) if ch.isdigit())
    if postal_digits:
        if len(postal_digits) != 6:
            errors.append("почтовый индекс должен содержать 6 цифр")
        else:
            values["postal_code"] = postal_digits

    email = str(values["email"] or "").strip()
    if email and not re.fullmatch(r"[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+", email):
        warnings.append("электронная почта выглядит некорректно")

    values["course_name"] = _text(raw.get("course_name"))

    duration_hours, duration_error = _parse_duration_hours(raw.get("duration_hours"))
    values["duration_hours"] = duration_hours
    if duration_error:
        errors.append(duration_error)

    values["program_type"] = infer_program_type(
        str(values["course_name"] or ""), duration_hours
    )

    values["registration_number"] = _text(raw.get("registration_number"))
    values["track_number"] = _text(raw.get("track_number"))
    issue_date, issue_date_error = _parse_issue_date(raw.get("issue_date"), epoch)
    values["issue_date"] = issue_date
    if issue_date_error:
        errors.append(issue_date_error)

    has_any_course_data = bool(
        str(values["course_name"] or "").strip()
        or duration_hours > 0
        or str(values["registration_number"] or "").strip()
        or str(values["issue_date"] or "").strip()
        or str(values["track_number"] or "").strip()
    )
    if has_any_course_data:
        if not str(values["course_name"] or "").strip():
            errors.append("для сведений об обучении не указано название курса")
        if duration_hours <= 0:
            errors.append("для сведений об обучении не указана продолжительность в часах")
        if str(values["course_name"] or "").strip() and duration_hours > 0:
            hours_warning = import_hours_warning(
                str(values["program_type"]), duration_hours
            )
            if hours_warning:
                values["course_hours_warning"] = True
                warnings.append(hours_warning + " Импорт будет разрешён.")

    return ParsedExcelRow(source_row, values, errors, warnings)


def _person_signature(row: ParsedExcelRow) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    return tuple(
        _normalize_person_name(str(row.values.get(field, "") or ""))
        for field in ("last_name", "first_name", "middle_name")
    )


def _mark_snils_identity_conflicts(rows: list[ParsedExcelRow]) -> None:
    seen: dict[str, tuple[tuple[str, str, str], int]] = {}
    for row in rows:
        digits = normalize_snils(str(row.values.get("snils", "") or ""))
        if not digits:
            continue
        signature = _person_signature(row)
        previous = seen.get(digits)
        if previous is None:
            seen[digits] = (signature, row.source_row)
            continue
        previous_signature, previous_row = previous
        if signature == previous_signature:
            row.warnings.append(
                "тот же СНИЛС и Ф.И.О. повторяются: строка будет добавлена как ещё один курс "
                f"к той же карточке (первая строка: {previous_row})"
            )
        else:
            row.errors.append(
                "СНИЛС повторяется, но Ф.И.О. отличается "
                f"(первая строка: {previous_row})"
            )


def infer_program_type(course_name: str, duration_hours: int) -> str:
    """Infer DPO type without a separate Excel column.

    «Анти-магистратура» is always treated as professional retraining.
    Otherwise courses of 250 hours or more are retraining; courses from
    16 through 249 hours are advanced training. Imported values below
    16 hours are still accepted as advanced training with an hours warning.
    """
    normalized_name = re.sub(
        r"[^а-яёa-z0-9]+", " ", str(course_name or "").casefold()
    ).strip()
    if "антимагистратура" in normalized_name.replace(" ", ""):
        return PROGRAM_TYPE_RETRAINING
    if duration_hours >= 250:
        return PROGRAM_TYPE_RETRAINING
    if 16 <= duration_hours <= 249:
        return PROGRAM_TYPE_ADVANCED_TRAINING
    # Imported values below 16 hours are allowed through with a warning;
    # they remain classified as advanced training so the row can be saved.
    return PROGRAM_TYPE_ADVANCED_TRAINING


def _parse_duration_hours(value: Any) -> tuple[int, str]:
    if value is None or _text(value) == "":
        return 0, ""
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return 0, "продолжительность курса не распознана"
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        numeric = float(value)
    else:
        match = re.search(r"\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?", _text(value))
        if not match:
            return 0, "продолжительность курса не распознана"
        numeric = float(match.group(0).replace(",", "."))
    if numeric <= 0:
        return 0, "продолжительность курса должна быть больше нуля"
    if not numeric.is_integer():
        return 0, "продолжительность курса должна быть целым числом часов"
    return int(numeric), ""


def _parse_date(value: Any, epoch: datetime) -> tuple[str, str]:
    if value is None or _text(value) == "":
        return "", ""
    parsed: date | None = None
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        parsed = value.date()
    elif isinstance(value, date):
        parsed = value
    elif isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        try:
            converted = from_excel(value, epoch)
            parsed = converted.date() if isinstance(converted, datetime) else converted
        except Exception:
            parsed = None
    else:
        text = _text(value).strip()
        for pattern in (
            "%d.%m.%Y",
            "%Y-%m-%d",
            "%d/%m/%Y",
            "%d-%m-%Y",
            "%d.%m.%y",
        ):
            try:
                parsed = datetime.strptime(text, pattern).date()
                break
            except ValueError:
                continue
    if parsed is None:
        return "", "дата рождения не распознана"
    if parsed > date.today():
        return "", "дата рождения не может быть позднее сегодняшней даты"
    if parsed.year < 1900:
        return "", "дата рождения выглядит некорректно"
    return parsed.isoformat(), ""


def _parse_issue_date(value: Any, epoch: datetime) -> tuple[str, str]:
    parsed, error = _parse_date(value, epoch)
    if error:
        error = error.replace("дата рождения", "дата выдачи")
    return parsed, error


def validate_snils_checksum(snils_digits: str) -> tuple[bool, int]:
    if len(snils_digits) != 11 or not snils_digits.isdigit():
        return False, 0
    insurance_number = int(snils_digits[:9])
    actual_checksum = int(snils_digits[9:])
    if insurance_number <= 1_001_998:
        return True, actual_checksum
    weighted_sum = sum(
        int(digit) * weight
        for digit, weight in zip(snils_digits[:9], range(9, 0, -1))
    )
    remainder = weighted_sum % 101
    expected_checksum = remainder if remainder < 100 else 0
    return actual_checksum == expected_checksum, expected_checksum


def format_snils(digits: str) -> str:
    return f"{digits[:3]}-{digits[3:6]}-{digits[6:9]} {digits[9:11]}"


def _sample_headers(values: Iterable[Any]) -> list[str]:
    result: list[str] = []
    for index, value in enumerate(values, start=1):
        column_letter = get_column_letter(index)
        sample = _text(value).strip().replace("\n", " ")
        if len(sample) > 50:
            sample = sample[:47] + "…"
        result.append(
            f"{column_letter} — пример: {sample}" if sample else f"{column_letter} — без примера"
        )
    return result


def _unique_headers(
    values: Iterable[Any],
    *,
    preserve_trailing: bool = False,
) -> list[str]:
    result: list[str] = []
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for index, value in enumerate(values, start=1):
        column_letter = get_column_letter(index)
        raw_header = _text(value).strip()
        base = raw_header or "Без заголовка"
        count = counts.get(base.casefold(), 0) + 1
        counts[base.casefold()] = count
        unique_name = base if count == 1 else f"{base} ({count})"
        result.append(f"{column_letter} — {unique_name}")
    if not preserve_trailing:
        while result and "Без заголовка" in result[-1]:
            result.pop()
    return result


def _mapped_value(row: tuple[Any, ...], index: int | None) -> Any:
    if index is None or index < 0 or index >= len(row):
        return None
    return row[index]


def _cell_has_value(value: Any) -> bool:
    return value is not None and _text(value).strip() != ""


def _text(value: Any) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "Да" if value else "Нет"
    if isinstance(value, float) and value.is_integer():
        return str(int(value))
    return str(value).strip()


def _normalize_header(value: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^a-zа-яё0-9]+", "", str(value).casefold())


def _normalize_person_name(value: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(str(value or "").casefold().replace("ё", "е").split())


def _title_name(value: str) -> str:
    return "-".join(part[:1].upper() + part[1:].lower() for part in value.split("-"))
