from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtGui import QFontDatabase


PREFERRED_FONT_FAMILIES: tuple[str, ...] = (
    "Lazurski",
    "Book Antiqua",
    "Times New Roman",
    "Arial",
    "Calibri",
    "Cambria",
    "Courier New",
    "Georgia",
)

_FONT_EXTENSIONS = {".ttf", ".otf", ".ttc"}


def register_custom_fonts(data_dir: Path | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Register application-local fonts and return the loaded family names.

    Font files can be placed either into ``dpo_app/assets/fonts`` in the
    program folder or into ``DPO_Documents_Data/fonts`` in the user's profile.
    The second location survives replacement of the program folder.
    """

    font_dirs = [Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "assets" / "fonts"]
    if data_dir is not None:
        user_font_dir = Path(data_dir) / "fonts"
        user_font_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        font_dirs.append(user_font_dir)

    loaded: list[str] = []
    seen_paths: set[Path] = set()
    for directory in font_dirs:
        if not directory.exists():
            continue
        for path in sorted(directory.iterdir(), key=lambda item: item.name.casefold()):
            if not path.is_file() or path.suffix.lower() not in _FONT_EXTENSIONS:
                continue
            resolved = path.resolve()
            if resolved in seen_paths:
                continue
            seen_paths.add(resolved)
            font_id = QFontDatabase.addApplicationFont(str(resolved))
            if font_id < 0:
                logging.warning("Could not load application font: %s", path)
                continue
            families = QFontDatabase.applicationFontFamilies(font_id)
            loaded.extend(family for family in families if family not in loaded)
            logging.info("Loaded application font %s: %s", path, ", ".join(families))
    return loaded


def available_font_families() -> list[str]:
    """Return font families for print-template controls in stable order."""

    available = sorted(QFontDatabase.families(), key=str.casefold)
    ordered: list[str] = []
    for family in (*PREFERRED_FONT_FAMILIES, *available):
        if family and family not in ordered:
            ordered.append(family)
    return ordered


def is_font_available(family: str) -> bool:
    target = family.strip().casefold()
    return any(item.casefold() == target for item in QFontDatabase.families())

    "Источник финансирования обучения",

    "Гражданство получателя (код страны по ОКСМ)",
    "Наименование документа об образовании (оригинала)",
    "Серия (оригинала)",
    "Номер (оригинала)",
    "Регистрационный N (оригинала)",
    "Дата выдачи (оригинала)",
    "Фамилия получателя (оригинала)",
    "Имя получателя (оригинала)",
    "Отчество получателя (оригинала)",
    "Номер документа для изменения",
)

STATUS_VALUES = ("Оригинал", "Дубликат")
LOSS_VALUES = (
    "Нет",
    "Справка из органов внутренних дел",
    "Справка из органов пожарной охраны",
    "Объявление в газете",
    "Другое",
)
EXCHANGE_VALUES = (
    "Нет",
    "Обмен по причине порчи",
    "Обмен по причине наличия недостоверной информации",
)
DESTRUCTION_VALUES = ("Да", "Нет")
GENDER_OUTPUT = {"Мужской": "Муж", "Женский": "Жен"}
STUDY_FORM_VALUES = ("Очная", "Очно-заочная (вечерняя)", "Заочная")
FUNDING_VALUES = (
    "Федеральный бюджет",
    "Региональный бюджет",
    "Местный бюджет",
    "Платное обучение",
)
EDUCATION_LOCATION_VALUES = (
    "в образовательной организации",
    "вне образовательной организации",
)
EDUCATION_LEVEL_VALUES = (
    "",
    "Высшее образование",
    "Среднее профессиональное образование",
    "Справка",
    "Стаж",
    "Пункт 1 правил формирования ФИС ФРДО",
)

REFERENCE_COLUMNS: dict[str, str] = {
    "document_types": "A",
    "statuses": "D",
    "loss_confirmations": "E",
    "exchange_confirmations": "F",
    "professional_areas": "G",
    "genders": "H",
    "destruction_confirmations": "J",
    "program_types": "K",
    "education_levels": "L",
    "specialty_groups": "M",
    "citizenships": "N",
    "education_locations": "O",
    "funding_sources": "P",
    "study_forms": "Q",
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FrdoValidationIssue:
    student_course_id: int
    field: str
    message: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class FrdoExportResult:
    files: tuple[Path, ...]
    records_count: int


def bundled_template_path() -> Path:
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "assets" / "frdo_certificate_template.xlsx"


def normalize_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return " ".join(str(value or "").strip().split())


def parse_date(value: Any) -> date | None:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value.date()
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return value
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%d.%m.%Y", "%d/%m/%Y"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(text, fmt).date()
        except ValueError:
            continue
    return None


def format_date(value: Any) -> str:
    parsed = parse_date(value)
    return parsed.strftime("%d.%m.%Y") if parsed else ""


def normalize_snils(value: Any) -> str:
    digits = "".join(character for character in str(value or "") if character.isdigit())
    if len(digits) == 11:
        return f"{digits[:3]}-{digits[3:6]}-{digits[6:9]} {digits[9:]}"
    return str(value or "").strip()


def _headers_from_workbook(path: Path) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    workbook = load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=False)
    try:
        if TEMPLATE_SHEET not in workbook.sheetnames:
            raise ValueError("В файле отсутствует лист «Шаблон».")
        sheet = workbook[TEMPLATE_SHEET]
        return tuple(str(sheet.cell(1, column).value or "").strip() for column in range(1, 41))
    finally:
        workbook.close()


def _validate_headers(headers: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
    if headers == EXPECTED_HEADERS:
        return
    mismatch = next(
        (
            index
            for index, (actual, expected) in enumerate(
                zip(headers, EXPECTED_HEADERS), start=1
            )
            if actual != expected
        ),
        None,
    )
    if mismatch is None and len(headers) != len(EXPECTED_HEADERS):
        mismatch = min(len(headers), len(EXPECTED_HEADERS)) + 1
    if mismatch is None:
        mismatch = 1
    expected = (
        EXPECTED_HEADERS[mismatch - 1]
        if mismatch <= len(EXPECTED_HEADERS)
        else ""
    )
    actual = headers[mismatch - 1] if mismatch <= len(headers) else ""
    raise ValueError(
        "Структура шаблона не соответствует поддерживаемому формату. "
        f"Столбец {get_column_letter(mismatch)}: ожидалось «{expected}», "
        f"найдено «{actual}»."
    )


def validate_template(path: Path) -> None:
    if not path.exists():
        raise ValueError(f"Файл шаблона не найден: {path}")
    try:
        headers = _headers_from_workbook(path)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"Не удалось открыть шаблон ФИС ФРДО: {exc}") from exc
    _validate_headers(headers)


def load_reference_lists(template_path: Path) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    """Validate the template and read reference lists in one workbook pass."""
    if not template_path.exists():
        raise ValueError(f"Файл шаблона не найден: {template_path}")
    try:
        workbook = load_workbook(template_path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"Не удалось открыть шаблон ФИС ФРДО: {exc}") from exc
    try:
        if TEMPLATE_SHEET not in workbook.sheetnames:
            raise ValueError("В файле отсутствует лист «Шаблон».")
        template_sheet = workbook[TEMPLATE_SHEET]
        first_row = next(
            template_sheet.iter_rows(
                min_row=1,
                max_row=1,
                min_col=1,
                max_col=40,
                values_only=True,
            ),
            tuple(),
        )
        headers = tuple(str(value or "").strip() for value in first_row)
        _validate_headers(headers)

        if REFERENCE_SHEET not in workbook.sheetnames:
            return {}
        sheet = workbook[REFERENCE_SHEET]
        column_indexes = {
            key: column_index_from_string(column) - 1
            for key, column in REFERENCE_COLUMNS.items()
        }
        max_column = max(column_indexes.values(), default=0) + 1
        result: dict[str, list[str]] = {
            key: [] for key in REFERENCE_COLUMNS
        }
        seen_values: dict[str, set[str]] = {
            key: set() for key in REFERENCE_COLUMNS
        }
        for row_values in sheet.iter_rows(
            min_row=2,
            max_row=int(sheet.max_row or 1),
            min_col=1,
            max_col=max_column,
            values_only=True,
        ):
            for key, index in column_indexes.items():
                value = row_values[index] if index < len(row_values) else None
                item = str(value or "").strip()
                if item and item not in seen_values[key]:
                    result[key].append(item)
                    seen_values[key].add(item)
        return result
    finally:
        workbook.close()


def validate_record(record: Mapping[str, Any], current_year: int | None = None) -> list[FrdoValidationIssue]:
    year_now = int(current_year or date.today().year)
    course_id = int(record.get("student_course_id", 0) or 0)
    issues: list[FrdoValidationIssue] = []

    def required(key: str, label: str) -> str:
        value = normalize_text(record.get(key, ""))
        if not value:
            issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, key, f"Не заполнено поле «{label}»."))
        return value

    required("document_type", "Вид документа")
    required("program_type", "Дополнительная профессиональная программа")

    status = required("document_status", "Статус документа")
    if status and status not in STATUS_VALUES:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "document_status", "Недопустимый статус документа."))

    for key, label, allowed in (
        ("loss_confirmation", "Подтверждение утраты", LOSS_VALUES),
        ("exchange_confirmation", "Подтверждение обмена", EXCHANGE_VALUES),
        ("destruction_confirmation", "Подтверждение уничтожения", DESTRUCTION_VALUES),
    ):
        value = required(key, label)
        if value and value not in allowed:
            issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, key, f"Недопустимое значение поля «{label}»."))

    series = required("document_series", "Серия документа")
    if len(series) > 20:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "document_series", "Серия документа содержит более 20 символов."))

    number = required("document_number", "Номер документа")
    if len(number) > 40:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "document_number", "Номер документа содержит более 40 символов."))

    issue_date = parse_date(record.get("issue_date"))
    if issue_date is None:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "issue_date", "Не заполнена или неверно указана дата выдачи."))

    registration = required("registration_number", "Регистрационный номер")
    if len(registration) > 30:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "registration_number", "Регистрационный номер содержит более 30 символов."))

    course_name = required("course_name", "Наименование программы")
    if len(course_name) > 600:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "course_name", "Наименование программы содержит более 600 символов."))

    qualification = required("qualification_name", "Наименование квалификации")
    if len(qualification) > 500:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "qualification_name", "Наименование квалификации содержит более 500 символов."))
    if (
        normalize_text(record.get("program_type", "")) == DIPLOMA_PROGRAM_TYPE
        and qualification.casefold() == "нет"
    ):
        issues.append(
            FrdoValidationIssue(
                course_id,
                "qualification_name",
                "Для диплома необходимо указать присваиваемую квалификацию.",
            )
        )

    start_text = normalize_text(record.get("start_year", ""))
    end_text = normalize_text(record.get("end_year", ""))
    try:
        start_year = int(start_text)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        start_year = 0
    try:
        end_year = int(end_text)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        end_year = 0
    if not start_year:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "start_year", "Не указан год начала обучения."))
    if not end_year:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "end_year", "Не указан год окончания обучения."))
    minimum_year = 1955 if status == "Дубликат" else 1978
    if start_year and not minimum_year <= start_year <= year_now:
        issues.append(
            FrdoValidationIssue(
                course_id,
                "start_year",
                f"Год начала обучения должен быть от {minimum_year} до {year_now}.",
            )
        )
    if end_year and not 1955 <= end_year <= year_now:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "end_year", f"Год окончания обучения должен быть не позднее {year_now}."))
    if start_year and end_year and end_year < start_year:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "end_year", "Год окончания обучения меньше года начала."))

    try:
        hours = int(record.get("duration_hours", 0) or 0)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        hours = 0
    program_type = normalize_text(record.get("program_type", ""))
    if program_type == DIPLOMA_PROGRAM_TYPE:
        if hours < 250:
            issues.append(
                FrdoValidationIssue(
                    course_id,
                    "duration_hours",
                    "Для профессиональной переподготовки должно быть не менее 250 часов.",
                )
            )
    elif not 16 <= hours <= 249:
        issues.append(
            FrdoValidationIssue(
                course_id,
                "duration_hours",
                "Для повышения квалификации должно быть от 16 до 249 часов.",
            )
        )

    document_type = normalize_text(record.get("document_type", ""))
    expected_document_type = (
        DIPLOMA_DOCUMENT_TYPE
        if program_type == DIPLOMA_PROGRAM_TYPE
        else CERTIFICATE_DOCUMENT_TYPE
    )
    if document_type and document_type != expected_document_type:
        issues.append(
            FrdoValidationIssue(
                course_id,
                "document_type",
                "Вид документа не соответствует виду программы.",
            )
        )

    for key, label in (
        ("last_name", "Фамилия получателя"),
        ("first_name", "Имя получателя"),
        ("birth_date", "Дата рождения"),
        ("gender", "Пол"),
    ):
        required(key, label)
    middle_name = normalize_text(record.get("middle_name", ""))
    if not middle_name:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "middle_name", "Отчество должно быть указано либо заменено словом «Нет»."))

    birth_date = parse_date(record.get("birth_date"))
    if birth_date is None:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "birth_date", "Дата рождения имеет неверный формат."))

    gender = normalize_text(record.get("gender", ""))
    if gender and gender not in GENDER_OUTPUT:
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "gender", "Пол должен быть «Мужской» или «Женский»."))

    if issue_date and issue_date.year >= 2021:
        snils = normalize_snils(record.get("snils", ""))
        citizenship = normalize_text(record.get("citizenship_code", ""))
        if citizenship == "643" and len("".join(ch for ch in snils if ch.isdigit())) != 11:
            issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "snils", "Для гражданства 643 требуется корректный СНИЛС."))
        for key, label, allowed in (
            ("study_form", "Форма обучения", STUDY_FORM_VALUES),
            ("funding_source", "Источник финансирования", FUNDING_VALUES),
            ("education_location_form", "Форма получения образования", EDUCATION_LOCATION_VALUES),
        ):
            value = required(key, label)
            if value and value not in allowed:
                issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, key, f"Недопустимое значение поля «{label}»."))
        if not citizenship:
            issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "citizenship_code", "Не указан код гражданства по ОКСМ."))

    if status == "Дубликат":
        for key, label in (
            ("original_document_type", "Вид документа-оригинала"),
            ("original_series", "Серия оригинала"),
            ("original_number", "Номер оригинала"),
            ("original_registration_number", "Регистрационный номер оригинала"),
            ("original_issue_date", "Дата выдачи оригинала"),
            ("original_last_name", "Фамилия получателя оригинала"),
            ("original_first_name", "Имя получателя оригинала"),
            ("original_middle_name", "Отчество получателя оригинала"),
        ):
            required(key, label)
        if record.get("original_issue_date") and parse_date(record.get("original_issue_date")) is None:
            issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "original_issue_date", "Дата выдачи оригинала имеет неверный формат."))

    if normalize_text(record.get("document_change_number", "")):
        issues.append(FrdoValidationIssue(course_id, "document_change_number", "Поле «Номер документа для изменения» должно оставаться пустым."))

    return issues


def record_to_row(record: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[Any]:
    issue_date = parse_date(record.get("issue_date"))
    original_issue_date = parse_date(record.get("original_issue_date"))
    status = normalize_text(record.get("document_status", "Оригинал")) or "Оригинал"
    duplicate = status == "Дубликат"
    citizenship = normalize_text(record.get("citizenship_code", "643")) or "643"
    middle_name = normalize_text(record.get("middle_name", "")) or "Нет"

    values: list[Any] = [
        normalize_text(record.get("document_type", DOCUMENT_TYPE)) or DOCUMENT_TYPE,
        status,
        normalize_text(record.get("loss_confirmation", "Нет")) or "Нет",
        normalize_text(record.get("exchange_confirmation", "Нет")) or "Нет",
        normalize_text(record.get("destruction_confirmation", "Нет")) or "Нет",
        normalize_text(record.get("document_series", "Нет")) or "Нет",
        normalize_text(record.get("document_number", "")),
        issue_date,
        normalize_text(record.get("registration_number", "")),
        normalize_text(record.get("program_type", PROGRAM_TYPE)) or PROGRAM_TYPE,
        normalize_text(record.get("course_name", "")),
        normalize_text(record.get("professional_area", "")) or None,
        normalize_text(record.get("specialty_group", "")) or None,
        normalize_text(record.get("qualification_name", "Нет")) or "Нет",
        normalize_text(record.get("education_level", "")) or None,
        normalize_text(record.get("previous_diploma_surname", "")) or None,
        normalize_text(record.get("previous_document_series", "")) or None,
        normalize_text(record.get("previous_document_number", "")) or None,
        int(record.get("start_year", 0) or 0) or None,
        int(record.get("end_year", 0) or 0) or None,
        int(record.get("duration_hours", 0) or 0),
        normalize_text(record.get("last_name", "")),
        normalize_text(record.get("first_name", "")),
        middle_name,
        format_date(record.get("birth_date")),
        GENDER_OUTPUT.get(normalize_text(record.get("gender", "")), ""),
        normalize_snils(record.get("snils", "")),
        normalize_text(record.get("study_form", "")) or None,
        normalize_text(record.get("funding_source", "")) or None,
        normalize_text(record.get("education_location_form", "")) or None,
        citizenship,
        normalize_text(record.get("original_document_type", "")) if duplicate else None,
        normalize_text(record.get("original_series", "")) if duplicate else None,
        normalize_text(record.get("original_number", "")) if duplicate else None,
        normalize_text(record.get("original_registration_number", "")) if duplicate else None,
        original_issue_date if duplicate else None,
        normalize_text(record.get("original_last_name", "")) if duplicate else None,
        normalize_text(record.get("original_first_name", "")) if duplicate else None,
        normalize_text(record.get("original_middle_name", "")) if duplicate else None,
        None,
    ]
    return values


def _copy_template_row_style(sheet, source_row: int, target_row: int) -> None:
    """Copy the formatting of a prepared template row without copying values."""
    source_dimension = sheet.row_dimensions[source_row]
    target_dimension = sheet.row_dimensions[target_row]
    for attribute in (
        "height",
        "hidden",
        "outlineLevel",
        "collapsed",
        "thickTop",
        "thickBottom",
    ):
        try:
            setattr(target_dimension, attribute, getattr(source_dimension, attribute))
        except (AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError):
            pass

    for column in range(1, 41):
        source = sheet.cell(source_row, column)
        target = sheet.cell(target_row, column)
        if source.has_style:
            target._style = copy(source._style)
        if source.number_format:
            target.number_format = source.number_format
        target.alignment = copy(source.alignment)
        target.protection = copy(source.protection)


def _extend_data_validations(sheet, required_last_row: int) -> None:
    """Extend template dropdowns and date checks to dynamically added rows."""
    if required_last_row <= LAST_TEMPLATE_DATA_ROW:
        return
    validations = getattr(sheet, "data_validations", None)
    if validations is None:
        return
    for validation in validations.dataValidation:
        expanded: list[str] = []
        changed = False
        for cell_range in validation.ranges.ranges:
            max_row = cell_range.max_row
            if (
                cell_range.min_row == FIRST_DATA_ROW
                and max_row <= LAST_TEMPLATE_DATA_ROW
            ):
                max_row = required_last_row
                changed = True
            expanded.append(
                str(
                    CellRange(
                        min_col=cell_range.min_col,
                        min_row=cell_range.min_row,
                        max_col=cell_range.max_col,
                        max_row=max_row,
                    )
                )
            )
        if changed:
            validation.sqref = " ".join(expanded)


def _ensure_template_capacity(sheet, records_count: int) -> int:
    """Add as many formatted data rows as are required for one export file."""
    required_last_row = max(
        LAST_TEMPLATE_DATA_ROW,
        FIRST_DATA_ROW + max(0, records_count) - 1,
    )
    if required_last_row > LAST_TEMPLATE_DATA_ROW:
        for row in range(LAST_TEMPLATE_DATA_ROW + 1, required_last_row + 1):
            _copy_template_row_style(sheet, LAST_TEMPLATE_DATA_ROW, row)
        _extend_data_validations(sheet, required_last_row)
    return required_last_row


def _clear_template_rows(sheet, last_row: int) -> None:
    for row in range(FIRST_DATA_ROW, last_row + 1):
        for column in range(1, 41):
            sheet.cell(row, column).value = None


def _write_records(sheet, records: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> None:
    for offset, record in enumerate(records):
        row_number = FIRST_DATA_ROW + offset
        values = record_to_row(record)
        for column, value in enumerate(values, start=1):
            cell = sheet.cell(row_number, column)
            cell.value = value
            if column == 8 and value is not None:
                cell.number_format = "DD.MM.YYYY"
            elif column == 36 and value is not None:
                cell.number_format = "DD.MM.YYYY"
            elif column in {6, 7, 9, 25, 27, 31, 33, 34, 35, 37, 38, 39, 40}:
                cell.number_format = "@"


def _save_one(template_path: Path, output_path: Path, records: list[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> None:
    workbook = load_workbook(template_path)
    try:
        sheet = workbook[TEMPLATE_SHEET]
        last_row = _ensure_template_capacity(sheet, len(records))
        _clear_template_rows(sheet, last_row)
        _write_records(sheet, records)
        workbook.active = workbook.sheetnames.index(TEMPLATE_SHEET)
        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        workbook.save(output_path)
    finally:
        workbook.close()


def export_records(
    records: list[Mapping[str, Any]],
    output_path: Path,
    template_path: Path | None = None,
) -> FrdoExportResult:
    if not records:
        raise ValueError("Не выбраны документы для выгрузки.")
    template = template_path or bundled_template_path()
    validate_template(template)

    all_issues = [issue for record in records for issue in validate_record(record)]
    if all_issues:
        raise ValueError("В выбранных документах есть ошибки заполнения.")

    target = Path(output_path)
    if target.suffix.lower() != ".xlsx":
        target = target.with_suffix(".xlsx")
    _save_one(template, target, records)
    return FrdoExportResult((target,), len(records))

ФАЙЛ 016/137: dpo_app/gar_client.py
Исходная кодировка при чтении архива: utf-8-sig

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, QTimer, QUrl, QUrlQuery, Signal
from PySide6.QtNetwork import QNetworkAccessManager, QNetworkReply, QNetworkRequest


from dpo_app.version import APP_VERSION

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GarSuggestion:
    address: str
    object_id: str = ""
    fias_id: str = ""
    postal_code: str = ""


class GarClient(QObject):
    """Small asynchronous client for the public FIAS/GAR address service."""

    search_finished = Signal(list)
    search_failed = Signal(str)
    details_finished = Signal(dict)
    details_failed = Signal(str)
    address_item_finished = Signal(str, str)
    address_item_failed = Signal(str, str)

    TOKEN_URL = "https://fias.nalog.ru/Home/GetSpasSettings"
    API_BASE = "https://fias-public-service.nalog.ru/api/spas/v2.0"

    def __init__(self, parent: QObject | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._manager = QNetworkAccessManager(self)
        self._token = ""
        self._pending_query = ""
        self._pending_action = ""
        self._pending_object_id = ""
        self._retry_count = 0

    def search(self, query: str) -> None:
        normalized = " ".join(query.split())
        if len(normalized) < 3:
            self.search_failed.emit("Введите не менее трёх символов адреса.")
            return

        self._pending_query = normalized
        self._pending_action = "search"
        self._retry_count = 0
        if self._token:
            self._request_search()
        else:
            self._request_token()

    def request_details(self, object_id: str) -> None:
        if not object_id:
            self.details_finished.emit({})
            return
        if not self._token:
            self.details_failed.emit(
                "Не удалось получить почтовый индекс: токен ФИАС ещё не загружен."
            )
            return

        url = self._build_url(
            f"{self.API_BASE}/GetDetails",
            {"object_id": object_id},
        )
        reply = self._manager.get(self._request(url, authenticated=True))
        reply.finished.connect(lambda: self._handle_details_reply(reply))

    def request_address_item(self, object_id: str) -> None:
        """Resolve an internal object ID to the stable FIAS object GUID."""
        if not object_id:
            self.address_item_finished.emit("", "")
            return
        self._pending_object_id = object_id
        self._pending_action = "address_item"
        if self._token:
            self._request_address_item(object_id)
        else:
            self._request_token()

    def _request_address_item(self, object_id: str) -> None:
        url = self._build_url(
            f"{self.API_BASE}/GetAddressItemById",
            {"object_id": object_id, "address_type": "2"},
        )
        reply = self._manager.get(self._request(url, authenticated=True))
        reply.finished.connect(
            lambda: self._handle_address_item_reply(reply, object_id)
        )

    def _request_token(self) -> None:
        url = self._build_url(self.TOKEN_URL, {"url": "https://fias.nalog.ru/"})
        reply = self._manager.get(self._request(url))
        reply.finished.connect(lambda: self._handle_token_reply(reply))

    def _request_search(self) -> None:
        url = self._build_url(
            f"{self.API_BASE}/GetAddressHint",
            {
                "search_string": self._pending_query,
                "address_type": "2",
            },
        )
        reply = self._manager.get(self._request(url, authenticated=True))
        reply.finished.connect(lambda: self._handle_search_reply(reply))

    def _handle_token_reply(self, reply: QNetworkReply) -> None:
        try:
            data = self._read_json(reply)
            token = self._first_nonempty(data, "Token", "token")
            if not token:
                raise ValueError("Сервис ФИАС не вернул токен доступа.")
            self._token = str(token)
            if self._pending_action == "address_item" and self._pending_object_id:
                self._request_address_item(self._pending_object_id)
            else:
                self._request_search()
        except Exception as exc:
            message = self._friendly_error(exc, reply)
            if self._pending_action == "address_item" and self._pending_object_id:
                self.address_item_failed.emit(self._pending_object_id, message)
            else:
                self.search_failed.emit(message)
        finally:
            reply.deleteLater()

    def _handle_search_reply(self, reply: QNetworkReply) -> None:
        try:
            status = reply.attribute(QNetworkRequest.Attribute.HttpStatusCodeAttribute)
            if status and int(status) >= 500 and self._retry_count < 1:
                self._retry_count += 1
                QTimer.singleShot(700, self._request_search)
                return

            data = self._read_json(reply)
            raw_items = self._list_value_recursive(
                data, "hints", "Hints", "addresses", "Addresses"
            )
            suggestions: list[GarSuggestion] = []
            seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()

            for item in raw_items:
                if not isinstance(item, dict):
                    continue
                address = self._best_address(item)
                object_id = str(
                    self._first_nonempty(
                        item,
                        "object_id",
                        "objectId",
                        "ObjectId",
                        "OBJECTID",
                        "id",
                        "Id",
                    )
                    or ""
                )
                fias_id = str(
                    self._first_nonempty(
                        item,
                        "object_guid",
                        "objectGuid",
                        "ObjectGuid",
                        "OBJECTGUID",
                        "fias_id",
                        "fiasId",
                        "guid",
                        "Guid",
                        "GUID",
                    )
                    or ""
                )
                postal_code = str(
                    self._first_nonempty(
                        item,
                        "postal_code",
                        "postalCode",
                        "PostalCode",
                        "POSTALCODE",
                        "index",
                    )
                    or ""
                )
                if not address:
                    continue
                key = (address, object_id or fias_id)
                if key in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(key)
                suggestions.append(
                    GarSuggestion(
                        address=address,
                        object_id=object_id,
                        fias_id=fias_id,
                        postal_code=postal_code,
                    )
                )
                if len(suggestions) >= 30:
                    break

            self.search_finished.emit(suggestions)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.search_failed.emit(self._friendly_error(exc, reply))
        finally:
            reply.deleteLater()

    def _handle_details_reply(self, reply: QNetworkReply) -> None:
        try:
            data = self._read_json(reply)
            details = self._dict_value(
                data,
                "address_details",
                "addressDetails",
                "details",
                "Details",
            )
            if not details:
                details = data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
            self.details_finished.emit(details)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.details_failed.emit(self._friendly_error(exc, reply))
        finally:
            reply.deleteLater()

    def _handle_address_item_reply(
        self,
        reply: QNetworkReply,
        requested_object_id: str,
    ) -> None:
        try:
            data = self._read_json(reply)
            # The public GAR service can wrap the address object several levels
            # deep.  Excel import has always searched the full response tree; the
            # interactive student card used to inspect only the top-level list,
            # which made a valid OBJECTGUID look missing on some responses.
            fias_id = self._extract_fias_id(data)

            if not fias_id:
                raise ValueError("Сервис ФИАС не вернул OBJECTGUID выбранного адреса.")
            self.address_item_finished.emit(requested_object_id, fias_id)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.address_item_failed.emit(
                requested_object_id,
                self._friendly_error(exc, reply),
            )
        finally:
            reply.deleteLater()

    def _request(self, url: QUrl, authenticated: bool = False) -> QNetworkRequest:
        request = QNetworkRequest(url)
        request.setTransferTimeout(15_000)
        request.setAttribute(
            QNetworkRequest.Attribute.RedirectPolicyAttribute,
            QNetworkRequest.RedirectPolicy.NoLessSafeRedirectPolicy,
        )
        request.setRawHeader(b"Accept", b"application/json")
        request.setRawHeader(b"User-Agent", f"DPO-Documents/{APP_VERSION}".encode("ascii"))
        if authenticated:
            request.setRawHeader(b"master-token", self._token.encode("utf-8"))
        return request

    @staticmethod
    def _build_url(base: str, params: dict[str, str]) -> QUrl:
        url = QUrl(base)
        query = QUrlQuery()
        for key, value in params.items():
            query.addQueryItem(key, value)
        url.setQuery(query)
        return url

    @staticmethod
    def _read_json(reply: QNetworkReply) -> Any:
        if reply.error() != QNetworkReply.NetworkError.NoError:
            raise ConnectionError(reply.errorString())

        status = reply.attribute(QNetworkRequest.Attribute.HttpStatusCodeAttribute)
        if status and int(status) >= 400:
            raise ConnectionError(f"HTTP {int(status)}")

        raw = bytes(reply.readAll()).decode("utf-8-sig", errors="replace")
        if not raw.strip():
            raise ValueError("Сервис ФИАС вернул пустой ответ.")
        return json.loads(raw)

    @classmethod
    def _best_address(cls, item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        for key in (
            "address",
            "Address",
            "full_name",
            "fullName",
            "FullName",
            "name",
            "Name",
            "value",
            "Value",
        ):
            value = item.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
                return " ".join(value.split())
        return ""

    @staticmethod
    def _first_nonempty(data: Any, *keys: str) -> Any:
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            return None
        for key in keys:
            value = data.get(key)
            if value not in (None, "", [], {}):
                return value
        return None


    @classmethod
    def _extract_fias_id(cls, data: Any) -> str:
        """Return a FIAS GUID from any nested GAR response shape."""
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            value = cls._first_nonempty(
                data,
                "object_guid",
                "objectGuid",
                "ObjectGuid",
                "OBJECTGUID",
                "fias_id",
                "fiasId",
                "guid",
                "Guid",
                "GUID",
            )
            if value:
                return str(value).strip()
            for nested in data.values():
                found = cls._extract_fias_id(nested)
                if found:
                    return found
        elif isinstance(data, list):
            for nested in data:
                found = cls._extract_fias_id(nested)
                if found:
                    return found
        return ""

    @classmethod
    def _list_value_recursive(cls, data: Any, *keys: str) -> list[Any]:
        """Find a named list even when the service wraps it in a payload object."""
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            value = cls._first_nonempty(data, *keys)
            if isinstance(value, list):
                return value
            for nested in data.values():
                found = cls._list_value_recursive(nested, *keys)
                if found:
                    return found
        elif isinstance(data, list):
            for nested in data:
                found = cls._list_value_recursive(nested, *keys)
                if found:
                    return found
        return []
    @classmethod
    def _list_value(cls, data: Any, *keys: str) -> list[Any]:
        value = cls._first_nonempty(data, *keys)
        return value if isinstance(value, list) else []

    @classmethod
    def _dict_value(cls, data: Any, *keys: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        value = cls._first_nonempty(data, *keys)
        return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}

    @staticmethod
    def _friendly_error(exc: Exception, reply: QNetworkReply) -> str:
        status = reply.attribute(QNetworkRequest.Attribute.HttpStatusCodeAttribute)
        suffix = f" (HTTP {int(status)})" if status else ""
        return (
            "Не удалось обратиться к Государственному адресному реестру"
            f"{suffix}. Проверьте интернет-соединение, VPN или антивирус. "
            "Адрес можно ввести вручную.\n\n"
            f"Техническая информация: {exc}"
        )

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from difflib import SequenceMatcher
from typing import Any
from urllib.error import URLError
from urllib.parse import urlencode
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen


from dpo_app.version import APP_VERSION

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GarSuggestion:
    address: str
    object_id: str = ""
    fias_id: str = ""
    postal_code: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GarSyncResult:
    success: bool
    imported_address: str
    address: str = ""
    postal_code: str = ""
    fias_id: str = ""
    object_id: str = ""
    error: str = ""


class GarImportSynchronizer:
    """Synchronous GAR client for Excel import.

    One object is reused for the whole import, so the public GAR token and
    repeated address results are cached. The original Excel address is always
    preserved separately from the normalized GAR address.
    """

    TOKEN_URL = "https://fias.nalog.ru/Home/GetSpasSettings"
    API_BASE = "https://fias-public-service.nalog.ru/api/spas/v2.0"

    def __init__(self, timeout: float = 10.0) -> None:
        self.timeout = timeout
        self._token = ""
        self._service_error = ""
        self._cache: dict[tuple[str, str], GarSyncResult] = {}

    def synchronize(
        self, imported_address: str, imported_postal_code: str = ""
    ) -> GarSyncResult:
        raw_address = " ".join(str(imported_address or "").split())
        postal_code = "".join(
            ch for ch in str(imported_postal_code or "") if ch.isdigit()
        )[:6]
        if not raw_address:
            return GarSyncResult(False, "", error="адрес не указан")
        if self._service_error:
            return GarSyncResult(
                False,
                raw_address,
                address=raw_address,
                postal_code=postal_code,
                error=self._service_error,
            )

        cache_key = (self._normalize(raw_address), postal_code)
        cached = self._cache.get(cache_key)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached

        try:
            token = self._ensure_token()
            search_data = self._get_json(
                f"{self.API_BASE}/GetAddressHint",
                {"search_string": raw_address, "address_type": "2"},
                token,
            )
            suggestions = self._parse_suggestions(search_data)
            selected = self._choose_suggestion(
                raw_address, postal_code, suggestions
            )
            if selected is None:
                raise ValueError("подходящий адрес в ГАР не найден")

            resolved_postal = selected.postal_code
            if selected.object_id and len(resolved_postal) != 6:
                details = self._get_json(
                    f"{self.API_BASE}/GetDetails",
                    {"object_id": selected.object_id},
                    token,
                )
                resolved_postal = (
                    self._extract_postal_code(details) or resolved_postal
                )
            if len(resolved_postal) != 6:
                raise ValueError(
                    "ГАР не вернул почтовый индекс выбранного адреса"
                )

            fias_id = selected.fias_id
            if selected.object_id and not fias_id:
                item_data = self._get_json(
                    f"{self.API_BASE}/GetAddressItemById",
                    {
                        "object_id": selected.object_id,
                        "address_type": "2",
                    },
                    token,
                )
                fias_id = self._extract_fias_id(item_data)

            if not fias_id:
                raise ValueError("ГАР не вернул ID ФИАС выбранного адреса")

            result = GarSyncResult(
                success=True,
                imported_address=raw_address,
                address=selected.address,
                postal_code=resolved_postal,
                fias_id=fias_id,
                object_id=selected.object_id,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            if isinstance(exc, (URLError, TimeoutError, OSError)) or not self._token:
                self._service_error = str(exc)
            result = GarSyncResult(
                success=False,
                imported_address=raw_address,
                address=raw_address,
                postal_code=postal_code,
                error=str(exc),
            )

        self._cache[cache_key] = result
        return result

    def _ensure_token(self) -> str:
        if self._token:
            return self._token
        data = self._get_json(
            self.TOKEN_URL,
            {"url": "https://fias.nalog.ru/"},
            token="",
        )
        token = self._first_nonempty(data, "Token", "token")
        if not token:
            raise ValueError("сервис ГАР не вернул токен доступа")
        self._token = str(token)
        return self._token

    def _get_json(
        self, base_url: str, params: dict[str, str], token: str
    ) -> Any:
        url = base_url + "?" + urlencode(params)
        headers = {
            "Accept": "application/json",
            "User-Agent": f"DPO-Documents/{APP_VERSION}",
        }
        if token:
            headers["master-token"] = token
        request = Request(url, headers=headers, method="GET")
        with urlopen(request, timeout=self.timeout) as response:
            raw = response.read().decode("utf-8-sig", errors="replace")
        if not raw.strip():
            raise ValueError("сервис ГАР вернул пустой ответ")
        return json.loads(raw)

    @classmethod
    def _parse_suggestions(cls, data: Any) -> list[GarSuggestion]:
        raw_items = cls._list_value(
            data, "hints", "Hints", "addresses", "Addresses"
        )
        result: list[GarSuggestion] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
        for item in raw_items:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            address = cls._best_address(item)
            if not address:
                continue
            object_id = str(
                cls._first_nonempty(
                    item,
                    "object_id",
                    "objectId",
                    "ObjectId",
                    "OBJECTID",
                    "id",
                    "Id",
                )
                or ""
            )
            fias_id = str(
                cls._first_nonempty(
                    item,
                    "object_guid",
                    "objectGuid",
                    "ObjectGuid",
                    "OBJECTGUID",
                    "fias_id",
                    "fiasId",
                    "guid",
                    "Guid",
                    "GUID",
                )
                or ""
            )
            postal_code = str(
                cls._first_nonempty(
                    item,
                    "postal_code",
                    "postalCode",
                    "PostalCode",
                    "POSTALCODE",
                    "index",
                )
                or ""
            )
            postal_code = "".join(
                ch for ch in postal_code if ch.isdigit()
            )[:6]
            key = (address, object_id or fias_id)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            result.append(
                GarSuggestion(address, object_id, fias_id, postal_code)
            )
        return result

    @classmethod
    def _choose_suggestion(
        cls,
        imported_address: str,
        imported_postal_code: str,
        suggestions: list[GarSuggestion],
    ) -> GarSuggestion | None:
        if not suggestions:
            return None
        query = cls._normalize(imported_address)
        query_tokens = set(query.split())
        ranked: list[tuple[float, GarSuggestion]] = []
        for suggestion in suggestions:
            candidate = cls._normalize(suggestion.address)
            candidate_tokens = set(candidate.split())
            sequence = SequenceMatcher(None, query, candidate).ratio()
            overlap = len(query_tokens & candidate_tokens) / max(
                1, len(query_tokens)
            )
            containment = (
                1.0 if query in candidate or candidate in query else 0.0
            )
            postal_bonus = 0.0
            if imported_postal_code and suggestion.postal_code:
                postal_bonus = (
                    0.35
                    if imported_postal_code == suggestion.postal_code
                    else -0.35
                )
            score = (
                sequence * 0.55
                + overlap * 0.35
                + containment * 0.10
                + postal_bonus
            )
            ranked.append((score, suggestion))
        ranked.sort(key=lambda pair: pair[0], reverse=True)
        score, best = ranked[0]
        if score < 0.48:
            return None
        return best

    @staticmethod
    def _normalize(value: str) -> str:
        text = str(value or "").casefold().replace("ё", "е")
        replacements = {
            "город": "г",
            "улица": "ул",
            "дом": "д",
            "корпус": "корп",
            "строение": "стр",
            "квартира": "кв",
            "область": "обл",
            "район": "р-н",
            "проспект": "пр-т",
            "переулок": "пер",
        }
        for source, target in replacements.items():
            text = re.sub(rf"\b{source}\b", target, text)
        text = re.sub(r"[^0-9a-zа-я]+", " ", text)
        return " ".join(text.split())

    @classmethod
    def _extract_postal_code(cls, data: Any) -> str:
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            for key in (
                "postal_code",
                "postalCode",
                "index",
                "postIndex",
                "POSTALCODE",
            ):
                value = data.get(key)
                if value is not None:
                    digits = "".join(
                        ch for ch in str(value) if ch.isdigit()
                    )[:6]
                    if len(digits) == 6:
                        return digits
            for value in data.values():
                found = cls._extract_postal_code(value)
                if found:
                    return found
        elif isinstance(data, list):
            for value in data:
                found = cls._extract_postal_code(value)
                if found:
                    return found
        return ""

    @classmethod
    def _extract_fias_id(cls, data: Any) -> str:
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            value = cls._first_nonempty(
                data,
                "object_guid",
                "objectGuid",
                "ObjectGuid",
                "OBJECTGUID",
                "fias_id",
                "fiasId",
                "guid",
                "Guid",
                "GUID",
            )
            if value:
                return str(value)
            for nested in data.values():
                found = cls._extract_fias_id(nested)
                if found:
                    return found
        elif isinstance(data, list):
            for nested in data:
                found = cls._extract_fias_id(nested)
                if found:
                    return found
        return ""

    @staticmethod
    def _best_address(item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        for key in (
            "address",
            "Address",
            "full_name",
            "fullName",
            "FullName",
            "name",
            "Name",
            "value",
            "Value",
        ):
            value = item.get(key)
            if isinstance(value, str) and value.strip():
                return " ".join(value.split())
        return ""

    @staticmethod
    def _first_nonempty(data: Any, *keys: str) -> Any:
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            return None
        for key in keys:
            value = data.get(key)
            if value not in (None, "", [], {}):
                return value
        return None

    @classmethod
    def _list_value(cls, data: Any, *keys: str) -> list[Any]:
        value = cls._first_nonempty(data, *keys)
        return value if isinstance(value, list) else []

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable, Iterable, Mapping
from typing import Any

from dpo_app.document_dates import document_date_iso_key


def _text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value or "").strip()


def _russian_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return _text(value).casefold().replace("ё", "е")


def student_name_key(record: Mapping[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str, str, int]:
    """Return a deterministic Russian-alphabetical student key."""

    try:
        record_id = int(record["id"] or 0)
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
        record_id = 0
    return (
        _russian_text(record["last_name"]),
        _russian_text(record["first_name"]),
        _russian_text(record["middle_name"]),
        record_id,
    )


def sort_journal_records(
    records: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]],
    column: int,
    *,
    descending: bool = False,
    postal_acceptance_getter: Callable[[Mapping[str, Any]], str] | None = None,
) -> list[Mapping[str, Any]]:
    """Sort journal records with the student's name as a stable secondary key.

    For issue date and postal dispatch date, empty values are always placed at
    the end. When dates are descending, students sharing the same date remain
    alphabetically ordered by surname, first name and middle name.
    """

    rows = sorted(list(records), key=student_name_key)

    if column == 2:
        return sorted(rows, key=student_name_key, reverse=descending)

    def primary(record: Mapping[str, Any]):
        if column == 1:
            return document_date_iso_key(record["issue_date"])
        if column == 3:
            return _russian_text(record["course_name"])
        if column == 4:
            try:
                return int(record["duration_hours"] or 0)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                return 0
        if column == 5:
            return _russian_text(record["registration_number"])
        if column == 6:
            return _russian_text(record["blank_number"])
        if column == 7:
            return _russian_text(record["document_kind"])
        if column == 8:
            try:
                revision_number = int(record["revision_number"] or 0)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                revision_number = 0
            return (_russian_text(record["revision_kind"] or "Оригинал"), revision_number)
        if column == 9:
            return _russian_text(record["status"])
        if column == 10:
            return _text(postal_acceptance_getter(record) if postal_acceptance_getter else "")
        if column == 11:
            return _russian_text(record["notes"])
        return 0

    if column in (1, 10):
        filled = [row for row in rows if primary(row)]
        empty = [row for row in rows if not primary(row)]
        filled.sort(key=primary, reverse=descending)
        return filled + empty

    rows.sort(key=primary, reverse=descending)
    return rows

from __future__ import annotations

"""Offline Russian given-name and patronymic gender inference.

The module deliberately uses conservative rules. A gender is returned only when
there is a strong signal, primarily a patronymic ending or agreement between a
known given name and a patronymic. Unclear and conflicting cases remain empty so
that the registry can highlight them for manual review.

from dataclasses import dataclass

MALE = "Мужской"
FEMALE = "Женский"


@dataclass(frozen=True)

    source: str
    confident: bool
    reason: str

    "сабина", "саида", "фарида", "фатима", "эльмира",

# Diminutives and genuinely cross-gender forms should never be used alone for
# automatic filling.
AMBIGUOUS_NAMES = {
    "алекс", "валя", "женя", "саша", "слава", "шура", "ника", "ким",
    "дани", "миша", "паша", "сеня",
}


MALE_PATRONYMIC_SUFFIXES = (
    "ович", "евич", "ич", "оглы", "улы",
)
FEMALE_PATRONYMIC_SUFFIXES = (
    "овна", "евна", "ична", "инична", "кызы", "гызы",
)


def _normalize(value: str) -> str:
    value = str(value or "").strip().casefold().replace("ё", "е")
    value = re.sub(r"[^а-яa-z-]+", " ", value)
    return " ".join(value.split())


def _first_token(value: str) -> str:
    normalized = _normalize(value)
    return normalized.split()[0] if normalized else ""


def gender_from_name(first_name: str) -> str:
    name = _first_token(first_name)
    if not name or name in AMBIGUOUS_NAMES:
        return ""
    if name in MALE_NAMES and name not in FEMALE_NAMES:
        return MALE
    if name in FEMALE_NAMES and name not in MALE_NAMES:
        return FEMALE
    return ""


def gender_from_patronymic(middle_name: str) -> str:
    patronymic = _first_token(middle_name)
    if not patronymic:
        return ""
    if patronymic.endswith(FEMALE_PATRONYMIC_SUFFIXES):
        return FEMALE
    if patronymic.endswith(MALE_PATRONYMIC_SUFFIXES):
        return MALE
    return ""


def infer_gender(first_name: str, middle_name: str = "") -> GenderInference:
    """Return a conservative offline gender inference.

    A missing patronymic keeps a record in the review queue even when the given
    name is common. This avoids silently accepting foreign, universal and
    incorrectly parsed names.
    """

    name_gender = gender_from_name(first_name)
    patronymic_gender = gender_from_patronymic(middle_name)

    if name_gender and patronymic_gender:
        if name_gender == patronymic_gender:
            return GenderInference(
                name_gender,
                "inferred_name_patronymic",
                True,
                "имя и отчество однозначно указывают один пол",
            )
        return GenderInference(
            "",
            "uncertain",
            False,
            "имя и отчество дают противоречивые результаты",
        )

    if patronymic_gender:
        return GenderInference(
            patronymic_gender,
            "inferred_patronymic",
            True,
            "пол однозначно определён по окончанию отчества",
        )

    if name_gender and not _first_token(middle_name):
        return GenderInference(
            "",
            "uncertain",
            False,
            "имя распознано, но отчество отсутствует; требуется проверка",
        )

    if name_gender:
        return GenderInference(
            "",
            "uncertain",
            False,
            "имя распознано, но отчество не удалось распознать",
        )

    if not _first_token(first_name):
        reason = "имя отсутствует"
    elif _first_token(first_name) in AMBIGUOUS_NAMES:
        reason = "имя имеет универсальную или сокращённую форму"
    else:
        reason = "имя и отчество отсутствуют в локальном словаре"
    return GenderInference("", "uncertain", False, reason)

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone


AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_HOURS = 6
AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL = timedelta(hours=AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_HOURS)
AUTO_REFRESH_LAST_ATTEMPT_KEY = "russian_post/last_auto_refresh_attempt_at"


def _parse_timestamp(value: str, *, fallback_timezone) -> datetime | None:
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    if text.endswith("Z"):
        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=fallback_timezone)
    return parsed


def is_auto_refresh_due(
    last_attempt_at: str,
    *,
    now: datetime | None = None,
) -> bool:
    """Return True when a new startup tracking batch may contact Russian Post.

    The cooldown applies only to the automatic batch started with the program.
    Manual status checks remain available to the user.
    """
    current = now or datetime.now().astimezone()
    if current.tzinfo is None:
        current = current.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    previous = _parse_timestamp(
        last_attempt_at, fallback_timezone=current.tzinfo
    )
    if previous is None:
        return True
    elapsed = (
        current.astimezone(timezone.utc)
        - previous.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    )
    return elapsed >= AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL


def automatic_refresh_attempt_timestamp(now: datetime | None = None) -> str:
    current = now or datetime.now().astimezone()
    if current.tzinfo is None:
        current = current.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return current.astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds")

"""Application-wide Russian localization for standard Qt menus and buttons.

Qt's built-in context menus and QMessageBox button captions depend on the Qt
translation catalog installed with the runtime.  Some Windows/PySide6 installs
used by DPO Documents do not ship/load the Russian catalog, so standard actions
appear in English.  This event filter translates only standard Qt captions;
application-defined text is left untouched.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re

from PySide6.QtCore import QEvent, QObject
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMenu, QMessageBox


_STANDARD_MENU_TEXTS = {
    "undo": "Отменить",
    "redo": "Повторить",
    "cut": "Вырезать",
    "copy": "Копировать",
    "paste": "Вставить",
    "delete": "Удалить",
    "select all": "Выделить всё",
}

_STANDARD_MESSAGE_BUTTON_TEXTS = {
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Ok: "ОК",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Save: "Сохранить",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.SaveAll: "Сохранить всё",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Open: "Открыть",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes: "Да",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.YesToAll: "Да для всех",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.No: "Нет",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.NoToAll: "Нет для всех",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Abort: "Прервать",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Retry: "Повторить",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Ignore: "Игнорировать",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Close: "Закрыть",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Cancel: "Отмена",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Discard: "Не сохранять",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Help: "Справка",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Apply: "Применить",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.Reset: "Сбросить",
    QMessageBox.StandardButton.RestoreDefaults: "Восстановить по умолчанию",
}


def _plain_action_text(text: str) -> str:
    """Return a stable key for a standard Qt action caption."""
    value = str(text or "")
    # Qt marks keyboard mnemonics with '&'.  A doubled && is a literal ampersand,
    # but standard edit actions do not contain one, so removing mnemonic marks is
    # sufficient and keeps this helper independent from the Qt runtime.
    value = value.replace("&&", "\0").replace("&", "").replace("\0", "&")
    # Some styles append the shortcut directly to QAction.text(); normally the
    # shortcut is a separate property.  Ignore it if present.
    value = value.split("\t", 1)[0]
    value = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", value).strip().casefold()
    return value


def russian_standard_menu_text(text: str) -> str | None:
    """Translate a known standard Qt context-menu caption, if applicable."""
    return _STANDARD_MENU_TEXTS.get(_plain_action_text(text))


class RussianQtUiLocalizer(QObject):
    """Translate standard Qt-generated UI text just before it is shown."""

    def eventFilter(self, watched, event) -> bool:  # noqa: N802 - Qt API name
        if event.type() == QEvent.Type.Show:
            if isinstance(watched, QMenu):
                self._localize_menu(watched)
            elif isinstance(watched, QMessageBox):
                self._localize_message_box(watched)
        return False

    @staticmethod
    def _localize_menu(menu: QMenu) -> None:
        for action in menu.actions():
            translated = russian_standard_menu_text(action.text())
            if translated is not None:
                action.setText(translated)

    @staticmethod
    def _localize_message_box(box: QMessageBox) -> None:
        for button in box.buttons():
            standard_button = box.standardButton(button)
            translated = _STANDARD_MESSAGE_BUTTON_TEXTS.get(standard_button)
            if translated is not None:
                button.setText(translated)


def install_russian_qt_ui(app: QApplication) -> RussianQtUiLocalizer:
    """Install the application-wide Qt standard-text localizer once."""
    existing = getattr(app, "_dpo_russian_qt_ui_localizer", None)
    if isinstance(existing, RussianQtUiLocalizer):
        return existing
    localizer = RussianQtUiLocalizer(app)
    app.installEventFilter(localizer)
    # Keep an explicit reference for the whole QApplication lifetime.
    app._dpo_russian_qt_ui_localizer = localizer  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    return localizer

TRACKING_ENDPOINT = "https://tracking.russianpost.ru/rtm34"
PASSWORD_SECRET_KEY = "russian_post_tracking_password"
DAILY_REQUEST_LIMIT = 100
AUTOMATIC_REQUEST_STOP_AT = 95
REQUEST_USAGE_FILE_NAME = "russian_post_request_usage.json"

SOAP_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2003/05/soap-envelope"
OPER_NS = "http://russianpost.org/operationhistory"
