from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Callable

from PySide6.QtCore import QDate, QEvent, QLocale, QObject, QTimer, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QAction, QColor, QFont, QPalette, QTextCharFormat
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QCalendarWidget,
    QDateEdit,
    QDialog,
    QLineEdit,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)


RUSSIAN_MONTHS_GENITIVE = (
    "",
    "января",
    "февраля",
    "марта",
    "апреля",
    "мая",
    "июня",
    "июля",
    "августа",
    "сентября",
    "октября",
    "ноября",
    "декабря",
)


def parse_date_text(value: object) -> QDate:
    """Parse all date formats currently used by the application."""
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if not text:
        return QDate()

    for fmt in ("dd.MM.yyyy", "yyyy-MM-dd"):
        parsed = QDate.fromString(text, fmt)
        if parsed.isValid():
            return parsed

    normalized = (
        text.replace(" г.", "")
        .replace(" года", "")
        .replace(" год", "")
        .strip()
    )
    parts = normalized.split()
    if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0].isdigit() and parts[2].isdigit():
        month_name = parts[1].casefold()
        try:
            month = next(
                index
                for index, name in enumerate(RUSSIAN_MONTHS_GENITIVE)
                if name and name.casefold() == month_name
            )
        except StopIteration:
            month = 0
        if month:
            parsed = QDate(int(parts[2]), month, int(parts[0]))
            if parsed.isValid():
                return parsed
    return QDate()


def format_numeric_date(value: QDate) -> str:
    return value.toString("dd.MM.yyyy") if value.isValid() else ""


def format_russian_long_date(value: QDate) -> str:
    if not value.isValid():
        return ""
    return (
        f"{value.day():02d} "
        f"{RUSSIAN_MONTHS_GENITIVE[value.month()]} "
        f"{value.year()} года"
    )


def _apply_today_style(calendar: QCalendarWidget) -> None:
    """Highlight the actual current date in blue in every popup calendar.

    ``QTextCharFormat`` alone is not reliable with every Windows theme: the
    native selection palette can cover the cell background or render it grey
    when the popup is inactive.  Apply both the per-date format and an explicit
    active/inactive selection palette so today's cell remains visibly blue.
    """
    today = QDate.currentDate()
    blue = QColor(0, 120, 215)
    white = QColor(Qt.GlobalColor.white)

    palette = calendar.palette()
    for group in (
        QPalette.ColorGroup.Active,
        QPalette.ColorGroup.Inactive,
    ):
        palette.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.Highlight, blue)
        palette.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.HighlightedText, white)
    calendar.setPalette(palette)

    # Keep the native calendar appearance while forcing selected cells to use
    # the same blue in styles that otherwise draw an inactive grey selection.
    if not calendar.property("dpo_today_style_sheet_applied"):
        calendar.setStyleSheet(
            calendar.styleSheet()
            + "\nQCalendarWidget QAbstractItemView {"
            " selection-background-color: rgb(0, 120, 215);"
            " selection-color: white;"
            " }"
        )
        calendar.setProperty("dpo_today_style_sheet_applied", True)

    style = QTextCharFormat()
    style.setBackground(blue)
    style.setForeground(white)
    style.setFontWeight(QFont.Weight.Bold)
    calendar.setDateTextFormat(today, style)
    calendar.updateCell(today)

    # Some styles rebuild the month model when navigating. Reapply the format
    # after every page change without accumulating duplicate connections.
    if not calendar.property("dpo_today_page_hook_installed"):
        calendar.currentPageChanged.connect(
            lambda _year, _month, cal=calendar: QTimer.singleShot(
                0, lambda: _apply_today_style(cal)
            )
        )
        calendar.setProperty("dpo_today_page_hook_installed", True)


class _CalendarPopupFilter(QObject):
    """Open a current-month calendar whenever its date field is clicked."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        anchor: QWidget,
        set_date: Callable[[QDate], None],
        *,
        minimum_date: QDate | None = None,
        maximum_date: QDate | None = None,
        initial_date_getter: Callable[[], QDate] | None = None,
        install_on_click: bool = True,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(anchor)
        self.anchor = anchor
        self.set_date = set_date
        self.minimum_date = (
            QDate(minimum_date)
            if minimum_date is not None and minimum_date.isValid()
            else QDate(1900, 1, 1)
        )
        self.maximum_date = (
            QDate(maximum_date)
            if maximum_date is not None and maximum_date.isValid()
            else QDate(2999, 12, 31)
        )
        self.initial_date_getter = initial_date_getter
        self._popup: QDialog | None = None
        if install_on_click:
            anchor.installEventFilter(self)

    def eventFilter(self, watched, event) -> bool:  # noqa: N802 - Qt API name
        if watched is self.anchor and event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonRelease:
            button = getattr(event, "button", lambda: Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton)()
            if button == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton and self.anchor.isEnabled():
                QTimer.singleShot(0, self.show_calendar)
        return super().eventFilter(watched, event)

    def show_calendar(self) -> None:
        if self._popup is not None and self._popup.isVisible():
            return

        today = QDate.currentDate()
        popup = QDialog(self.anchor, Qt.WindowType.Popup)
        popup.setWindowTitle("Выбор даты")
        popup_layout = QVBoxLayout(popup)
        popup_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)

        calendar = QCalendarWidget(popup)
        calendar.setLocale(
            QLocale(QLocale.Language.Russian, QLocale.Country.Russia)
        )
        calendar.setGridVisible(True)
        calendar.setMinimumDate(self.minimum_date)
        calendar.setMaximumDate(self.maximum_date)

        initial_date = QDate()
        if self.initial_date_getter is not None:
            try:
                initial_date = QDate(self.initial_date_getter())
            except Exception:
                initial_date = QDate()
        if (
            not initial_date.isValid()
            or initial_date < self.minimum_date
            or initial_date > self.maximum_date
        ):
            initial_date = today
        calendar.setSelectedDate(initial_date)
        calendar.setCurrentPage(initial_date.year(), initial_date.month())
        _apply_today_style(calendar)
        popup_layout.addWidget(calendar)

        def select_date(value: QDate) -> None:
            self.set_date(QDate(value))
            popup.accept()

        calendar.clicked.connect(select_date)
        calendar.activated.connect(select_date)
        popup.finished.connect(lambda _result: self._clear_popup(popup))

        popup.adjustSize()
        popup.move(self.anchor.mapToGlobal(self.anchor.rect().bottomLeft()))
        self._popup = popup
        popup.show()
        popup.raise_()
        popup.activateWindow()

    def _clear_popup(self, popup: QDialog) -> None:
        if self._popup is popup:
            self._popup = None
        popup.deleteLater()


class _CurrentMonthCalendarFilter(QObject):
    """Keep a QDateEdit popup on the current month without changing its value."""

    def __init__(self, date_edit: QDateEdit) -> None:
        super().__init__(date_edit)
        self.date_edit = date_edit
        self.calendar = date_edit.calendarWidget()
        self.calendar.installEventFilter(self)
        _apply_today_style(self.calendar)

        # QDateEdit normally opens its calendar only from the arrow button.
        # Attach an additional popup to the editable field itself so a mouse
        # click anywhere in the date field always opens a calendar.
        self.line_edit = date_edit.findChild(QLineEdit)
        self.field_popup_filter: _CalendarPopupFilter | None = None
        if self.line_edit is not None:
            self.field_popup_filter = _CalendarPopupFilter(
                self.line_edit,
                date_edit.setDate,
                minimum_date=date_edit.minimumDate(),
                maximum_date=date_edit.maximumDate(),
            )

    def eventFilter(self, watched, event) -> bool:  # noqa: N802 - Qt API name
        if watched is self.calendar and event.type() == QEvent.Type.Show:
            # QDateEdit may first navigate the built-in popup to its stored
            # value. Apply the current page on the next event-loop turn so the
            # current month and year always win.
            QTimer.singleShot(0, self.show_current_month)
        return super().eventFilter(watched, event)

    def show_current_month(self) -> None:
        today = QDate.currentDate()
        _apply_today_style(self.calendar)
        self.calendar.setCurrentPage(today.year(), today.month())


def configure_current_month_calendar(date_edit: QDateEdit) -> None:
    """Configure a QDateEdit to open on the current month from any click."""
    date_edit.setCalendarPopup(True)
    date_edit._current_month_calendar_filter = _CurrentMonthCalendarFilter(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        date_edit
    )


def configure_line_edit_calendar(
    line_edit: QLineEdit,
    *,
    formatter: Callable[[QDate], str] = format_numeric_date,
    minimum_date: QDate | None = None,
    maximum_date: QDate | None = None,
    sync_from_text: bool = False,
    open_on_click: bool = True,
    show_dropdown_action: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """Attach a calendar to an editable date line edit.

    The field always remains available for keyboard input.  With
    ``sync_from_text`` the popup calendar opens on the valid date currently
    typed in the field, so manual edits and calendar selection stay in sync.
    ``open_on_click=False`` is useful when a dedicated dropdown action is shown.
    """

    def set_date(value: QDate) -> None:
        line_edit.setText(formatter(value))
        line_edit.setFocus()
        line_edit.setCursorPosition(len(line_edit.text()))

    popup_filter = _CalendarPopupFilter(
        line_edit,
        set_date,
        minimum_date=minimum_date,
        maximum_date=maximum_date,
        initial_date_getter=(
            (lambda: parse_date_text(line_edit.text()))
            if sync_from_text
            else None
        ),
        install_on_click=open_on_click,
    )
    line_edit._current_month_calendar_filter = popup_filter  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

    if show_dropdown_action:
        action = QAction("▼", line_edit)
        action.setToolTip("Выбрать дату в календаре")
        action.triggered.connect(popup_filter.show_calendar)
        line_edit.addAction(action, QLineEdit.ActionPosition.TrailingPosition)
        line_edit._calendar_dropdown_action = action  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtCore import QUrl, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QColor, QDesktopServices, QFont
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QApplication,

class ProgramDiagnosticsDialog(QDialog):
    STATUS_LABELS = {
        OK: "Готово",
        WARNING: "Предупреждение",
        ERROR: "Ошибка",
        INFO: "Сведения",
    }
    STATUS_COLORS = {
        OK: QColor(20, 120, 55),
        WARNING: QColor(170, 105, 0),
        ERROR: QColor(180, 30, 30),
        INFO: QColor(35, 90, 150),
    }

    def __init__(
        self,
        database: Database,
        backup_manager: BackupManager,
        russian_post_manager: RussianPostManager,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.database = database
        self.data_dir = database.path.parent
        self.backup_manager = backup_manager
        self.russian_post_manager = russian_post_manager
        self.report: DiagnosticReport | None = None

        self.setWindowTitle("Диагностика программы")
        self.resize(1180, 760)
        self.setMinimumSize(860, 560)

        explanation = QLabel(
            "Диагностика проверяет рабочую базу, связи документов и почтовых "
            "отправлений, печатные файлы, настройки ФИС ФРДО, резервное "
            "копирование и журнал ошибок. Проверка не изменяет данные."
        )
        explanation.setWordWrap(True)

        self.summary = QLabel()
        summary_font = QFont(self.summary.font())
        summary_font.setBold(True)
        self.summary.setFont(summary_font)

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 3)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            ["Результат", "Проверка", "Подробности и рекомендации"]
        )
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setWordWrap(True)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        header_font = header.font()
        header_font.setBold(True)
        header.setFont(header_font)
        header.setMinimumHeight(34)

        checks_page = QWidget()
        checks_layout = QVBoxLayout(checks_page)
        checks_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        checks_layout.addWidget(self.summary)
        checks_layout.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        self.error_text = QTextEdit()
        self.error_text.setReadOnly(True)
        self.error_text.setLineWrapMode(QTextEdit.LineWrapMode.NoWrap)
        fixed_font = QFont("Consolas")
        fixed_font.setStyleHint(QFont.StyleHint.Monospace)
        self.error_text.setFont(fixed_font)

        error_page = QWidget()
        error_layout = QVBoxLayout(error_page)
        error_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        error_path_label = QLabel(
            f"Файл журнала: {error_log_path(self.data_dir)}"
        )
        error_path_label.setTextInteractionFlags(
            Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse
        )
        error_path_label.setWordWrap(True)
        error_layout.addWidget(error_path_label)
        error_layout.addWidget(self.error_text, 1)

        self.tabs = QTabWidget()
        self.tabs.addTab(checks_page, "Результаты проверки")
        self.tabs.addTab(error_page, "Журнал ошибок")

        self.run_button = QPushButton("Повторить проверку")
        self.copy_button = QPushButton("Копировать отчёт")
        self.save_button = QPushButton("Сохранить отчёт")
        self.open_logs_button = QPushButton("Открыть папку журналов")
        self.clear_log_button = QPushButton("Очистить журнал ошибок")
        self.close_button = QPushButton("Закрыть")

        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        buttons.addWidget(self.run_button)
        buttons.addWidget(self.copy_button)
        buttons.addWidget(self.save_button)
        buttons.addWidget(self.open_logs_button)
        buttons.addWidget(self.clear_log_button)
        buttons.addStretch(1)
        buttons.addWidget(self.close_button)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addWidget(explanation)
        layout.addWidget(self.tabs, 1)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)

        self.run_button.clicked.connect(self.run_diagnostics)
        self.copy_button.clicked.connect(self.copy_report)
        self.save_button.clicked.connect(self.save_report)
        self.open_logs_button.clicked.connect(self.open_logs_folder)
        self.clear_log_button.clicked.connect(self.clear_errors)
        self.close_button.clicked.connect(self.close)

        self.run_diagnostics()

    def run_diagnostics(self) -> None:
        self.run_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.summary.setText("Выполняется проверка…")
        QApplication.setOverrideCursor(Qt.CursorShape.WaitCursor)
        QApplication.processEvents()
        try:
            self.report = ProgramDiagnostics(
                self.database,
                self.data_dir,
                self.backup_manager,
                self.russian_post_manager,
            ).run()
            self._show_report(self.report)
            self._reload_error_log()
        finally:
            QApplication.restoreOverrideCursor()
            self.run_button.setEnabled(True)

    def _show_report(self, report: DiagnosticReport) -> None:
        self.table.setRowCount(len(report.checks))
        for row, check in enumerate(report.checks):
            status_item = QTableWidgetItem(
                self.STATUS_LABELS.get(check.status, check.status)
            )
            status_item.setForeground(
                self.STATUS_COLORS.get(check.status, QColor("black"))
            )
            status_font = status_item.font()
            status_font.setBold(True)
            status_item.setFont(status_font)
            title_item = QTableWidgetItem(check.title)
            detail_text = check.details
            if check.recommendation:
                detail_text += f"\nРекомендация: {check.recommendation}"
            details_item = QTableWidgetItem(detail_text)
            self.table.setItem(row, 0, status_item)
            self.table.setItem(row, 1, title_item)
            self.table.setItem(row, 2, details_item)
        self.table.resizeRowsToContents()

        if report.error_count:
            text = (
                f"Найдены ошибки: {report.error_count}; предупреждения: "
                f"{report.warning_count}; успешные проверки: {report.ok_count}."
            )
            self.summary.setStyleSheet("color: #b41e1e;")
        elif report.warning_count:
            text = (
                f"Критических ошибок нет. Предупреждения: {report.warning_count}; "
                f"успешные проверки: {report.ok_count}."
            )
            self.summary.setStyleSheet("color: #a56a00;")
        else:
            text = f"Все основные проверки пройдены. Успешных проверок: {report.ok_count}."
            self.summary.setStyleSheet("color: #147837;")
        self.summary.setText(text)

    def _reload_error_log(self) -> None:
        self.error_text.setPlainText(read_recent_errors(self.data_dir))
        cursor = self.error_text.textCursor()
        cursor.movePosition(cursor.MoveOperation.End)
        self.error_text.setTextCursor(cursor)

    def copy_report(self) -> None:
        if self.report is None:
            return
        QApplication.clipboard().setText(self.report.to_text())
        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Диагностика",
            "Отчёт скопирован в буфер обмена.",
        )

    def save_report(self) -> None:
        if self.report is None:
            return
        suggested = (
            Path.home()
            / "Documents"
            / f"DPO_Diagnostics_{self.report.created_at.replace(':', '-').replace(' ', '_')}.txt"
        )
        path_text, _selected_filter = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Сохранить отчёт диагностики",
            str(suggested),
            "Текстовый файл (*.txt)",
        )
        if not path_text:
            return
        try:
            Path(path_text).write_text(self.report.to_text(), encoding="utf-8")
        except OSError as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(
                self,
                "Сохранение отчёта",
                f"Не удалось сохранить отчёт:\n{exc}",
            )
            return
        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Сохранение отчёта",
            "Отчёт диагностики сохранён.",
        )

    def open_logs_folder(self) -> None:
        folder = log_directory(self.data_dir)
        if not QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl.fromLocalFile(str(folder))):
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Журналы программы",
                f"Не удалось открыть папку:\n{folder}",
            )

    def clear_errors(self) -> None:
        answer = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            "Очистить журнал ошибок",
            "Удалить все записи из журнала ошибок?",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
        )
        if answer != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        try:
            clear_error_log(self.data_dir)
        except OSError as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(
                self,
                "Журнал ошибок",
                f"Не удалось очистить журнал:\n{exc}",
            )
            return
        self._reload_error_log()
        self.run_diagnostics()

# The saved field coordinates remain authoritative.  The Samsung paper feed
# moves the whole physical raster by a repeatable amount after Qt has rendered
# it.  Compensate only at the final printer-device stage, leaving preview and
# saved PDF completely untouched.
DIPLOMA_PRINT_FEED_OFFSET_X_MM = -0.4
DIPLOMA_PRINT_FEED_OFFSET_Y_MM = 4.0

# Horizontal compensation applied only to the physical printing of the diploma.
# The calibrated coordinates remain authoritative for the calibration window,
# preview and saved PDF.  Only the explicitly listed fields are adjusted in the
# final raster sent to the printer; every other field remains unchanged.
DIPLOMA_PRINT_FIELD_X_OFFSETS_MM = {
    "diploma_registration_number": 2.0,
    "diploma_issue_city": 2.0,
    "diploma_issue_date": 2.0,
    "diploma_full_name": 1.0,
    "diploma_organization": 1.5,
    "diploma_decision_date": 1.5,
    "diploma_qualification": 1.5,
    "diploma_professional_area": 1.0,
}

# Vertical compensation applied only to the physical printing of the diploma.
# Negative values move a field upward.  Preview, PDF and calibration continue
# to use the stored coordinates without these final printer-only corrections.
DIPLOMA_PRINT_FIELD_Y_OFFSETS_MM = {
    "diploma_registration_number": -1.0,
    "diploma_issue_city": -1.0,
    "diploma_issue_date": -1.0,
    "diploma_decision_date": -0.5,
    "diploma_qualification": -0.7,
    "diploma_professional_area": -0.5,
}

class CurriculumHeaderView(QHeaderView):
    """Bold curriculum headings with one permanent separator line."""

    def paintEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().paintEvent(event)
        painter = QPainter(self.viewport())
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing, False)
        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(70, 70, 70), 2))
        y = max(0, self.viewport().height() - 1)
        painter.drawLine(0, y, max(0, self.viewport().width() - 1), y)



class PreviewLabel(QLabel):
    """Preview image that always fits the available viewport area."""

    def __init__(self, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._source_pixmap = QPixmap()
        self.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        self.setSizePolicy(
            QSizePolicy.Policy.Ignored, QSizePolicy.Policy.Ignored
        )
        self.setMinimumSize(0, 0)

    def set_preview_image(self, image) -> None:
        self._source_pixmap = QPixmap.fromImage(image)
        self._update_scaled_pixmap()

    def clear_preview(self) -> None:
        self._source_pixmap = QPixmap()
        super().clear()

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        self._update_scaled_pixmap()

    def _update_scaled_pixmap(self) -> None:
        if self._source_pixmap.isNull():
            super().clear()
            return
        target = self.contentsRect().size()
        if target.width() <= 0 or target.height() <= 0:
            return
        super().setPixmap(
            self._source_pixmap.scaled(
                target,
                Qt.AspectRatioMode.KeepAspectRatio,
                Qt.TransformationMode.SmoothTransformation,
            )
        )


class CurrentMonthDateEdit(QWidget):
    """Nullable date field with a calendar that opens on the current month."""

    dateChanged = Signal(QDate)

    def __init__(self, decision_format: bool = False, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.decision_format = bool(decision_format)
        self._date = QDate()
        self._has_value = False

        self.line_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.line_edit.setReadOnly(True)
        self.line_edit.installEventFilter(self)
        self.line_edit.setPlaceholderText("")

        self.calendar_button = QToolButton()
        self.calendar_button.setText("▼")
        self.calendar_button.setToolTip("Выбрать дату")
        self.calendar_button.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus)
        self.calendar_button.setFixedWidth(24)
        self.calendar_button.clicked.connect(self.showPopup)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        layout.setSpacing(0)
        layout.addWidget(self.line_edit, 1)
        layout.addWidget(self.calendar_button)
        self.setFocusProxy(self.line_edit)

    @staticmethod
    def _highlight_current_date(calendar: QCalendarWidget) -> None:
        today = QDate.currentDate()
        blue = QColor(0, 120, 215)
        white = QColor(255, 255, 255)

        palette = calendar.palette()
        for group in (
            QPalette.ColorGroup.Active,
            QPalette.ColorGroup.Inactive,
        ):
            palette.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.Highlight, blue)
            palette.setColor(group, QPalette.ColorRole.HighlightedText, white)
        calendar.setPalette(palette)
        calendar.setStyleSheet(
            calendar.styleSheet()
            + "\nQCalendarWidget QAbstractItemView {"
            " selection-background-color: rgb(0, 120, 215);"
            " selection-color: white;"
            " }"
        )

        today_format = QTextCharFormat()
        today_format.setBackground(blue)
        today_format.setForeground(white)
        font = today_format.font()
        font.setBold(True)
        today_format.setFont(font)
        calendar.setDateTextFormat(today, today_format)
        calendar.updateCell(today)

    def showPopup(self) -> None:
        today = QDate.currentDate()
        popup = QDialog(self, Qt.WindowType.Popup)
        popup.setWindowTitle("Выбор даты")
        popup_layout = QVBoxLayout(popup)
        popup_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)

        calendar = QCalendarWidget(popup)
        calendar.setLocale(QLocale(QLocale.Language.Russian, QLocale.Country.Russia))
        calendar.setGridVisible(True)
        calendar.setMinimumDate(QDate(1900, 1, 1))
        calendar.setMaximumDate(QDate(2999, 12, 31))

        # The page is always the actual current month/year, regardless of an
        # empty field or a previously saved date.
        calendar.setSelectedDate(today)
        calendar.setCurrentPage(today.year(), today.month())
        self._highlight_current_date(calendar)
        popup_layout.addWidget(calendar)

        def select_date(value: QDate) -> None:
            self._set_date(value, emit_signal=True)
            popup.accept()

        calendar.clicked.connect(select_date)
        calendar.activated.connect(select_date)
        popup.adjustSize()
        popup.move(self.mapToGlobal(self.rect().bottomLeft()))
        popup.exec()

    def _display_text(self, value: QDate) -> str:
        if self.decision_format:
            return f"{value.day():02d} {RUSSIAN_MONTHS[value.month()]} {value.year()} года"
        return value.toString("dd.MM.yyyy")

    def _set_date(self, value: QDate, *, emit_signal: bool) -> None:
        if not value.isValid():
            self.clear_date(emit_signal=emit_signal)
            return
        changed = (not self._has_value) or value != self._date
        self._date = QDate(value)
        self._has_value = True
        self.line_edit.setText(self._display_text(value))
        if emit_signal and changed:
            self.dateChanged.emit(QDate(value))

    def clear_date(self, *, emit_signal: bool = True) -> None:
        changed = self._has_value
        self._date = QDate()
        self._has_value = False
        self.line_edit.clear()
        if emit_signal and changed:
            self.dateChanged.emit(QDate())

    def eventFilter(self, watched, event) -> bool:
        if watched is self.line_edit:
            if event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonRelease:
                button = getattr(
                    event, "button", lambda: Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton
                )()
                if button == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
                    QTimer.singleShot(0, self.showPopup)
            elif event.type() == QEvent.Type.KeyPress:
                if event.key() in {Qt.Key.Key_Delete, Qt.Key.Key_Backspace}:
                    self.clear_date(emit_signal=True)
                    return True
        return super().eventFilter(watched, event)

    def formatted_text(self) -> str:
        if not self._has_value or not self._date.isValid():
            return ""
        return self._display_text(self._date)

    def set_text_date(self, value: object) -> None:
        text = str(value or "").strip()
        if not text:
            self.clear_date(emit_signal=False)
            return
        parsed = QDate.fromString(text, "dd.MM.yyyy")
        if not parsed.isValid():
            parsed = QDate.fromString(text, "yyyy-MM-dd")
        if not parsed.isValid():
            normalized = text.replace(" г.", "").replace(" года", "").strip()
            parts = normalized.split()
            if len(parts) == 3 and parts[0].isdigit() and parts[2].isdigit():
                month_name = parts[1].casefold()
                try:
                    month = next(
                        index
                        for index, name in enumerate(RUSSIAN_MONTHS)
                        if name and name.casefold() == month_name
                    )
                except StopIteration:
                    month = 0
                if month:
                    parsed = QDate(int(parts[2]), month, int(parts[0]))
        if parsed.isValid():
            self._set_date(parsed, emit_signal=False)
        else:
            self.clear_date(emit_signal=False)


class TwoRowTabWidget(QWidget):
    """Document tabs arranged in two aligned rows above one content area."""

    currentChanged = Signal(int)

    def __init__(self, tab_height: int | None = None, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._buttons: list[QToolButton] = []
        self._tab_height = max(0, int(tab_height or 0))
        self._stack = QStackedWidget(self)
        self._current_index = -1

        # Both document panels must receive exactly the same share of the
        # available width.  Ignore content size hints (especially the large
        # preview pixmap) so they cannot make one side wider than the other.
        self.setSizePolicy(
            QSizePolicy.Policy.Ignored, QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding
        )
        self.setMinimumWidth(0)
        self._stack.setMinimumWidth(0)

        self._tabs_layout = QGridLayout()
        self._tabs_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self._tabs_layout.setHorizontalSpacing(3)
        self._tabs_layout.setVerticalSpacing(3)
        for column in range(3):
            self._tabs_layout.setColumnStretch(column, 1)

        root = QVBoxLayout(self)
        root.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        root.setSpacing(3)
        root.addLayout(self._tabs_layout)
        root.addWidget(self._stack, 1)

        self.setStyleSheet(
            """
            QToolButton[documentTab="true"] {
                border: 1px solid palette(mid);
                border-radius: 3px;
                padding: 1px 6px;
                background: palette(button);
            }
            QToolButton[documentTab="true"]:checked {
                background: palette(base);
                font-weight: bold;
                border-bottom: 2px solid #2878c8;
            }
            QToolButton[documentTab="true"]:disabled {
                color: palette(mid);
                background: palette(window);
            }
            """
        )

    def addTab(self, widget: QWidget, title: str, row: int, column: int) -> int:
        index = self._stack.addWidget(widget)
        button = QToolButton(self)
        button.setText(title)
        button.setCheckable(True)
        button.setAutoRaise(False)
        button.setProperty("documentTab", True)
        button.setSizePolicy(
            QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed
        )

        # The selected tab is drawn in bold.  Calculate the minimum width
        # using that bold font as well, otherwise the last characters can be
        # clipped when the tab becomes active on Windows display scaling.
        bold_font = button.font()
        bold_font.setBold(True)
        bold_text_width = QFontMetrics(bold_font).horizontalAdvance(title)
        button.setMinimumWidth(bold_text_width + 30)

        if self._tab_height > 0:
            button.setFixedHeight(self._tab_height)
        button.clicked.connect(
            lambda _checked=False, tab_index=index: self.setCurrentIndex(tab_index)
        )
        self._tabs_layout.addWidget(button, row, column)
        self._buttons.append(button)
        if self._current_index < 0:
            self.setCurrentIndex(index)
        return index

    def count(self) -> int:
        return len(self._buttons)

    def currentIndex(self) -> int:
        return self._current_index

    def isTabEnabled(self, index: int) -> bool:
        return 0 <= index < len(self._buttons) and self._buttons[index].isEnabled()

    def setTabEnabled(self, index: int, enabled: bool) -> None:
        if not 0 <= index < len(self._buttons):
            return
        self._buttons[index].setEnabled(bool(enabled))

    def setCurrentIndex(self, index: int) -> None:
        if not 0 <= index < len(self._buttons) or not self.isTabEnabled(index):
            return
        changed = index != self._current_index
        self._current_index = index
        self._stack.setCurrentIndex(index)
        for button_index, button in enumerate(self._buttons):
            button.setChecked(button_index == index)
        if changed:
            self.currentChanged.emit(index)



class DiplomaPrintDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(
        self,
        database: Database,
        student_id: int,
        parent=None,
        *,
        journal_document_id: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.database = database
        self.student_id = int(student_id)
        self.journal_document_id = (
            int(journal_document_id) if journal_document_id is not None else None
        )
        self.journal_document = (
            dict(database.get_issued_document(self.journal_document_id))
            if self.journal_document_id is not None
            else None
        )
        if self.journal_document_id is not None and self.journal_document is None:
            raise ValueError("Запись журнала документов не найдена.")
        self.journal_is_revision = bool(
            self.journal_document is not None
            and str(self.journal_document.get("revision_kind", "Оригинал")) != "Оригинал"
        )
        if self.journal_document is not None:
            if int(self.journal_document["student_id"]) != self.student_id:
                raise ValueError("Запись журнала относится к другому обучающемуся.")
            if str(self.journal_document["document_kind"]) != "diploma":
                raise ValueError("Выбранная запись не является дипломом.")
        self.student = database.get_student(student_id)
        if self.student is None:
            raise ValueError("Карточка обучающегося не найдена.")
        self.courses = [
            dict(row) for row in database.list_student_courses(student_id)
            if str(row["program_type"] or "") == "Профессиональная переподготовка"
        ]
        if not self.courses:
            raise ValueError("У обучающегося нет программы профессиональной переподготовки.")
        self.organization = dict(database.get_organization_settings())
        self.renderer = DiplomaRenderer()
        self.template_layout: dict = {}
        self._loading_course = False
        self._catalog_curriculum_initialized = False
        # Automatic split is the default for legacy/new documents. Once the

        # is no longer overwritten by automatic fitting on reopen.
        self._manual_curriculum_split = False
        self._redistributing_curriculum = False
        self._curriculum_frozen = False
        self._curriculum_linked_to_catalog = False
        self._syncing_tabs = False
        self._syncing_appendix_front_fields = False
        self._preview_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._preview_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._preview_timer.setInterval(180)

        # Every document field and both curricula are saved automatically after
