    @staticmethod
    def _configure_form(form: QFormLayout) -> None:
        """Keep every form row inside the visible width of the dialog."""
        form.setFieldGrowthPolicy(
            QFormLayout.FieldGrowthPolicy.AllNonFixedFieldsGrow
        )
        form.setRowWrapPolicy(QFormLayout.RowWrapPolicy.WrapLongRows)
        form.setLabelAlignment(
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
        )
        form.setFormAlignment(
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft
        )
        form.setHorizontalSpacing(12)
        form.setVerticalSpacing(8)

        for row in range(form.rowCount()):
            field_item = form.itemAt(
                row, QFormLayout.ItemRole.FieldRole
            )
            if field_item is None:
                continue
            field = field_item.widget()
            if field is None:
                continue
            field.setMinimumWidth(0)
            field.setSizePolicy(
                QSizePolicy.Policy.Expanding,
                QSizePolicy.Policy.Fixed,
            )
            if isinstance(field, QComboBox):
                field.setSizeAdjustPolicy(
                    QComboBox.SizeAdjustPolicy.AdjustToMinimumContentsLengthWithIcon
                )
                field.setMinimumContentsLength(1)

    @staticmethod
    def _configure_tab_page(page: QWidget) -> None:
        page.setMinimumWidth(0)
        page.setSizePolicy(
            QSizePolicy.Policy.Ignored,
            QSizePolicy.Policy.Preferred,
        )

    def values(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        values = dict(self.record)
        values.update(
            {
                "document_type": self.document_type.text().strip(),
                # Never trust a UI control or a stale FRDO override for this
                # value.  The selected student course is the authoritative source.
                "program_type": self._authoritative_program_type,
                "course_name": self.course_name.text().strip(),
                "duration_hours": str(self.duration_hours.value()),
                # Personal data comes only from the student card.  Clear old
                # per-certificate overrides created by earlier versions.
                "recipient_last_name": "",
                "recipient_first_name": "",
                "recipient_middle_name": "",
                "recipient_birth_date": "",
                "recipient_gender": "",
                "recipient_snils": "",
                "document_status": self.status.currentText().strip(),
                "loss_confirmation": self.loss.currentText().strip(),
                "exchange_confirmation": self.exchange.currentText().strip(),
                "destruction_confirmation": self.destruction.currentText().strip(),
                "document_series": self.series.text().strip(),
                "document_number": self.number.text().strip(),
                "issue_date": self.issue_date.text().strip(),
                "registration_number": self.registration.text().strip(),
                "professional_area": self.area.currentText().strip(),
                "specialty_group": self.specialty.currentText().strip(),
                "qualification_name": self.qualification.text().strip(),
                "education_level": self.education_level.currentText().strip(),
                "previous_diploma_surname": self.previous_surname.text().strip(),
                "previous_document_series": self.previous_series.text().strip(),
                "previous_document_number": self.previous_number.text().strip(),
                "start_year": str(self.start_year.value()),
                "end_year": str(self.end_year.value()),
                "study_form": self.study_form.currentText().strip(),
                "funding_source": self.funding.currentText().strip(),
                "education_location_form": self.location.currentText().strip(),
                "citizenship_code": self.citizenship.currentText().strip(),
                "original_document_type": self.original_document_type.currentText().strip(),
                "original_series": self.original_series.text().strip(),
                "original_number": self.original_number.text().strip(),
                "original_registration_number": self.original_registration.text().strip(),
                "original_issue_date": self.original_issue_date.text().strip(),
                "original_last_name": self.original_last_name.text().strip(),
                "original_first_name": self.original_first_name.text().strip(),
                "original_middle_name": self.original_middle_name.text().strip(),
                "document_change_number": self.document_change_number.text().strip(),
            }
        )
        return values


def edit_frdo_record_for_course(
    database: Database,
    student_id: int,
    student_course_id: int,
    parent=None,
) -> bool:
    """Open and save the same FRDO record editor used by the export window."""
    settings = dict(database.get_frdo_settings())
    custom = Path(str(settings.get("template_path", "") or "").strip())
    template = custom if custom.is_file() else bundled_template_path()
    try:
        references = load_reference_lists(template)
    except ValueError:
        references = {}

    rows = database.list_frdo_certificate_candidates([int(student_id)])
    source = next(
        (
            row
            for row in rows
            if int(row["student_course_id"]) == int(student_course_id)
        ),
        None,
    )
    if source is None:
        QMessageBox.warning(
            parent,
            "ФИС ФРДО",
            "Сведения о выбранном документе не найдены.",
        )
        return False

    record = row_to_effective_record(source, settings)
    dialog = FrdoRecordDialog(record, references, parent)
    if not dialog.exec():
        return False

    values = dialog.values()
    issue_date = parse_date(values.get("issue_date"))
    issue_iso = (
        issue_date.isoformat()
        if issue_date
        else str(values.get("issue_date", "") or "").strip()
    )
    database.update_frdo_document_fields(
        int(student_id),
        int(student_course_id),
        {**values, "issue_date": issue_iso},
    )
    values["issue_date"] = issue_iso
    database.save_frdo_certificate_data(int(student_course_id), values)
    return True


def open_frdo_record_for_course(
    database: Database,
    student_id: int,
    student_course_id: int,
    parent=None,
    *,
    on_saved: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
):
    """Open the shared FRDO editor as an independent non-modal window."""
    settings = dict(database.get_frdo_settings())
    custom = Path(str(settings.get("template_path", "") or "").strip())
    template = custom if custom.is_file() else bundled_template_path()
    try:
        references = load_reference_lists(template)
    except ValueError:
        references = {}

    rows = database.list_frdo_certificate_candidates([int(student_id)])
    source = next(
        (
            row
            for row in rows
            if int(row["student_course_id"]) == int(student_course_id)
        ),
        None,
    )
    if source is None:
        QMessageBox.warning(
            parent,
            "ФИС ФРДО",
            "Сведения о выбранном документе не найдены.",
        )
        return None

    record = row_to_effective_record(source, settings)

    def save_record(dialog: FrdoRecordDialog, result: int) -> None:
        if result != int(QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted):
            return
        values = dialog.values()
        issue_date = parse_date(values.get("issue_date"))
        issue_iso = (
            issue_date.isoformat()
            if issue_date
            else str(values.get("issue_date", "") or "").strip()
        )
        database.update_frdo_document_fields(
            int(student_id),
            int(student_course_id),
            {**values, "issue_date": issue_iso},
        )
        values["issue_date"] = issue_iso
        database.save_frdo_certificate_data(int(student_course_id), values)

    return show_independent_window(
        ("frdo_record", int(student_course_id)),
        lambda: FrdoRecordDialog(record, references, None),
        on_finished=save_record,
        on_closed=on_saved,
    )


class FrdoExportDialog(QDialog):
    CHECK_COLUMN = 0
    COURSE_ID_ROLE = int(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) + 10
    POPULATE_BATCH_SIZE = 40

    def __init__(
        self,
        database: Database,
        student_ids: list[int] | tuple[int, ...] | set[int] | None = None,
        parent=None,
        *,
        selected_only: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.database = database
        self.student_ids = tuple(
            sorted(
                {
                    int(value)
                    for value in (student_ids or [])
                    if int(value) > 0
                }
            )
        )
        self.selected_only = bool(selected_only)
        self.settings: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self.records: dict[int, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self.references: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
        self._loading = False
        self._load_thread: QThread | None = None
        self._load_worker: FrdoLoadWorker | None = None
        self._export_thread: QThread | None = None
        self._export_worker: FrdoExportWorker | None = None
        self._prepared_rows: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], tuple[Any, ...]]] = []
        self._populate_index = 0
        self._reload_checked_ids: set[int] = set()
        self._default_check_valid = True
        self._select_course_after_load: int | None = None

        self.setWindowTitle("Выгрузка документов ДПО в ФИС ФРДО")
        self.setModal(True)
        self.resize(1320, 720)
        self.setWindowFlags(
            self.windowFlags()
            | Qt.WindowType.WindowMinimizeButtonHint
            | Qt.WindowType.WindowMaximizeButtonHint
        )

        self.template_label = QLabel("Подготовка шаблона…")
        self.template_label.setTextInteractionFlags(
            Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse
        )
        self.summary_label = QLabel()
        self.loading_label = QLabel(
            "Подготовка данных только по отмеченным обучающимся…"
        )
        self.loading_progress = QProgressBar()
        self.loading_progress.setRange(0, 0)
        self.loading_progress.setTextVisible(False)
        self.loading_progress.setMaximumWidth(260)

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 10)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            [
                "Выгрузить",
                "Ф.И.О.",
                "Вид документа",
                "Программа",
                "Часы",
                "Номер документа",
                "Регистрационный номер",
                "Дата выдачи",
                "Статус документа",
                "Проверка",
            ]
        )
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(
            QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows
        )
        self.table.setSelectionMode(
            QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection
        )
        self.table.setEditTriggers(
            QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers
        )
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        # ResizeToContents on every inserted cell becomes very slow on large
        # selections.  Use stable widths while rows are filled in batches.
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(3, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        for column in (2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(
                column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive
            )
        self.table.setColumnWidth(0, 82)
        self.table.setColumnWidth(1, 240)
        self.table.setColumnWidth(2, 210)
        self.table.setColumnWidth(4, 70)
        self.table.setColumnWidth(5, 135)
        self.table.setColumnWidth(6, 150)
        self.table.setColumnWidth(7, 105)
        self.table.setColumnWidth(8, 125)
        self.table.setColumnWidth(9, 90)
        header.setMinimumHeight(42)

        self.select_all_button = QPushButton("Выбрать все")
        self.clear_button = QPushButton("Снять выбор")
        self.valid_button = QPushButton("Выбрать готовые")
        self.edit_button = QPushButton("Изменить сведения...")
        self.defaults_button = QPushButton("Общие настройки...")
        self.template_button = QPushButton("Загрузить актуальный шаблон...")
        self.validate_button = QPushButton("Проверить выбранные")
        self.export_button = QPushButton("Сформировать XLSX")
        self.close_button = QPushButton("Закрыть")

        self.select_all_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._set_all_checked(True)
        )
        self.clear_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._set_all_checked(False)
        )
        self.valid_button.clicked.connect(self._check_only_valid)
        self.edit_button.clicked.connect(self.edit_current_record)
        self.defaults_button.clicked.connect(self.edit_defaults)
        self.template_button.clicked.connect(self.choose_template)
        self.validate_button.clicked.connect(self.validate_selected)
        self.export_button.clicked.connect(self.export_selected)
        self.close_button.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        self.table.doubleClicked.connect(self.edit_current_record)

        self._action_widgets = (
            self.select_all_button,
            self.clear_button,
            self.valid_button,
            self.edit_button,
            self.defaults_button,
            self.template_button,
            self.validate_button,
            self.export_button,
            self.close_button,
        )

        top_actions = QHBoxLayout()
        top_actions.addWidget(self.select_all_button)
        top_actions.addWidget(self.clear_button)
        top_actions.addWidget(self.valid_button)
        top_actions.addSpacing(12)
        top_actions.addWidget(self.edit_button)
        top_actions.addWidget(self.defaults_button)
        top_actions.addWidget(self.template_button)
        top_actions.addStretch(1)

        loading_row = QHBoxLayout()
        loading_row.addWidget(self.loading_label)
        loading_row.addWidget(self.loading_progress)
        loading_row.addStretch(1)

        bottom_actions = QHBoxLayout()
        bottom_actions.addWidget(self.summary_label)
        bottom_actions.addStretch(1)
        bottom_actions.addWidget(self.validate_button)
        bottom_actions.addWidget(self.export_button)
        bottom_actions.addWidget(self.close_button)

        explanation = QLabel(
            "Модуль формирует один файл XLSX для выбранных удостоверений "
            "о повышении квалификации и дипломов о профессиональной "
            "переподготовке. Загружаются только обучающиеся, отмеченные "
            "в главном реестре."
        )
        explanation.setWordWrap(True)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addWidget(explanation)
        layout.addWidget(self.template_label)
        layout.addLayout(top_actions)
        layout.addLayout(loading_row)
        layout.addWidget(self.table, 1)
        layout.addLayout(bottom_actions)

        QTimer.singleShot(0, self.reload)

    def template_path(self) -> Path:
        custom = Path(
            str(self.settings.get("template_path", "") or "").strip()
        )
        if custom.is_file():
            return custom
        return bundled_template_path()

    def _set_loading(self, loading: bool, message: str = "") -> None:
        self._loading = bool(loading)
        self.loading_label.setVisible(loading)
        self.loading_progress.setVisible(loading)
        if message:
            self.loading_label.setText(message)
        self.table.setEnabled(not loading)
        for widget in self._action_widgets:
            widget.setEnabled(not loading)

    def reload(self, checked_ids: set[int] | None = None) -> None:
        if self._loading:
            return
        existing_rows = self.table.rowCount()
        previous_checked = (
            set(checked_ids)
            if checked_ids is not None
            else self.checked_course_ids()
        )
        self._reload_checked_ids = previous_checked
        self._default_check_valid = checked_ids is None and existing_rows == 0
        self.records = {}
        self.table.clearContents()
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        self.summary_label.setText("")
        self.template_label.setText("Подготовка шаблона…")
        self._set_loading(
            True,
            "Чтение шаблона и данных отмеченных обучающихся…",
        )

        thread = QThread(self)
        worker = FrdoLoadWorker(
            self.database.path,
            self.student_ids,
            self.selected_only,
        )
        worker.moveToThread(thread)
        thread.started.connect(worker.run)
        worker.finished.connect(self._load_finished)
        worker.failed.connect(self._load_failed)
        worker.finished.connect(thread.quit)
        worker.failed.connect(thread.quit)
        worker.finished.connect(worker.deleteLater)
        worker.failed.connect(worker.deleteLater)
        thread.finished.connect(self._load_thread_finished)
        thread.finished.connect(thread.deleteLater)
        self._load_thread = thread
        self._load_worker = worker
        thread.start()

    def _load_thread_finished(self) -> None:
        self._load_thread = None
        self._load_worker = None

    def _load_failed(self, message: str) -> None:
        self._prepared_rows = []
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        self.summary_label.setText("Документы не загружены")
        self._set_loading(False)
        QMessageBox.critical(
            self,
            "Выгрузка ФИС ФРДО",
            "Не удалось подготовить данные для выгрузки.\n\n" + message,
        )

    def _load_finished(
        self,
        settings: object,
        references: object,
        prepared: object,
        template_status: str,
    ) -> None:
        self.settings = dict(settings) if isinstance(settings, Mapping) else {}
        self.references = (
            dict(references) if isinstance(references, Mapping) else {}
        )
        self.template_label.setText(str(template_status))
        self._prepared_rows = list(prepared) if isinstance(prepared, list) else []
        self._populate_index = 0
        self.records = {}
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self._prepared_rows))
        self.loading_progress.setRange(0, max(1, len(self._prepared_rows)))
        self.loading_progress.setValue(0)
        self.loading_label.setText("Заполнение таблицы ФИС ФРДО…")
        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._populate_next_batch)

    def _populate_next_batch(self) -> None:
        total = len(self._prepared_rows)
        if self._populate_index >= total:
            self._finish_population()
            return

        end = min(total, self._populate_index + self.POPULATE_BATCH_SIZE)
        self.table.setUpdatesEnabled(False)
        try:
            for row_index in range(self._populate_index, end):
                record, issues = self._prepared_rows[row_index]
                course_id = int(record["student_course_id"])
                self.records[course_id] = record
                valid = not issues

                check_item = QTableWidgetItem()
                check_item.setFlags(
                    Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled
                    | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable
                    | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsSelectable
                )
                should_check = (
                    valid
                    if self._default_check_valid
                    else course_id in self._reload_checked_ids
                )
                check_item.setCheckState(
                    Qt.CheckState.Checked
                    if should_check
                    else Qt.CheckState.Unchecked
                )
                check_item.setData(self.COURSE_ID_ROLE, course_id)
                self.table.setItem(row_index, 0, check_item)

                fio = " ".join(
                    str(record.get(key, "") or "").strip()
                    for key in ("last_name", "first_name", "middle_name")
                    if str(record.get(key, "") or "").strip()
                    and str(record.get(key, "") or "").strip() != "Нет"
                )
                values = [
                    fio,
                    str(record.get("document_type", "") or ""),
                    str(record.get("course_name", "") or ""),
                    str(record.get("duration_hours", "") or ""),
                    str(record.get("document_number", "") or ""),
                    str(record.get("registration_number", "") or ""),
                    format_date(record.get("issue_date")),
                    str(record.get("document_status", "") or ""),
                    "Готово" if valid else f"Ошибок: {len(issues)}",
                ]
                tooltip = "\n".join(
                    str(issue.message) for issue in issues[:10]
                )
                for column, value in enumerate(values, start=1):
                    item = QTableWidgetItem(value)
                    item.setData(self.COURSE_ID_ROLE, course_id)
                    if not valid:
                        item.setBackground(QColor(255, 220, 220))
                        item.setToolTip(tooltip)
                    elif column == 9:
                        item.setForeground(QColor(0, 125, 45))
                    self.table.setItem(row_index, column, item)
        finally:
            self.table.setUpdatesEnabled(True)

        self._populate_index = end
        self.loading_progress.setValue(end)
        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._populate_next_batch)

    def _finish_population(self) -> None:
        total = len(self._prepared_rows)
        valid_count = sum(1 for _record, issues in self._prepared_rows if not issues)
        certificate_count = sum(
            1
            for record, _issues in self._prepared_rows
            if str(record.get("program_type", "") or "")
            == CERTIFICATE_PROGRAM_TYPE
        )
        diploma_count = sum(
            1
            for record, _issues in self._prepared_rows
            if str(record.get("program_type", "") or "")
            == DIPLOMA_PROGRAM_TYPE
        )
        self.summary_label.setText(
            f"Документов: {total} "
            f"(удостоверений: {certificate_count}; дипломов: {diploma_count}); "
            f"готовы: {valid_count}; требуют заполнения: {total - valid_count}"
        )
        target_course_id = self._select_course_after_load
        self._select_course_after_load = None
        selected_row = -1
        if target_course_id is not None:
            for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
                item = self.table.item(row, 0)
                if (
                    item is not None
                    and int(item.data(self.COURSE_ID_ROLE)) == target_course_id
                ):
                    selected_row = row
                    break
        if selected_row < 0 and total:
            selected_row = 0
        if selected_row >= 0:
            self.table.selectRow(selected_row)
        self._prepared_rows = []
        self._set_loading(False)

    def reject(self) -> None:
        if self._loading:
            self.loading_label.setText(
                "Операция выполняется. Дождитесь завершения…"
            )
            return
        super().reject()

    def closeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        if self._loading:
            event.ignore()
            self.loading_label.setText(
                "Операция выполняется. Дождитесь завершения…"
            )
            return
        super().closeEvent(event)

    def checked_course_ids(self) -> set[int]:
        result: set[int] = set()
        for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            item = self.table.item(row, self.CHECK_COLUMN)
            if item is not None and item.checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked:
                result.add(int(item.data(self.COURSE_ID_ROLE)))
        return result

    def current_course_id(self) -> int | None:
        row = self.table.currentRow()
        if row < 0:
            return None
        item = self.table.item(row, 0)
        return int(item.data(self.COURSE_ID_ROLE)) if item is not None else None

    def _set_all_checked(self, checked: bool) -> None:
        state = Qt.CheckState.Checked if checked else Qt.CheckState.Unchecked
        for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            item = self.table.item(row, 0)
            if item is not None:
                item.setCheckState(state)

    def _check_only_valid(self) -> None:
        for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            item = self.table.item(row, 0)
            if item is None:
                continue
            course_id = int(item.data(self.COURSE_ID_ROLE))
            item.setCheckState(
                Qt.CheckState.Checked if not validate_record(self.records[course_id]) else Qt.CheckState.Unchecked
            )

    def edit_defaults(self) -> None:
        def save_defaults(dialog: FrdoDefaultsDialog, result: int) -> None:
            if result != int(QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted):
                return
            values = dict(self.settings)
            values.update(dialog.values())
            self.database.update_frdo_settings(values)
            checked = self.checked_course_ids()
            self.reload(checked)

        show_independent_window(
            ("frdo_defaults", id(self)),
            lambda: FrdoDefaultsDialog(self.settings, self.references, None),
            on_finished=save_defaults,
        )

    def edit_current_record(self) -> None:
        course_id = self.current_course_id()
        if course_id is None:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self, "ФИС ФРДО", "Выберите документ в таблице."
            )
            return

        record = self.records.get(course_id, {})
        student_id = int(record.get("student_id", 0) or 0)
        if student_id <= 0:
            return

        def reload_record() -> None:
            checked = self.checked_course_ids()
            checked.add(course_id)
            self._select_course_after_load = course_id
            self.reload(checked)

        open_frdo_record_for_course(
            self.database,
            student_id,
            course_id,
            None,
            on_saved=reload_record,
        )

    def choose_template(self) -> None:
        path, _selected_filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Выберите актуальный шаблон ФИС ФРДО",
            str(Path.home() / "Documents"),
            "Книга Excel (*.xlsx)",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        source = Path(path)
        try:
            validate_template(source)
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Шаблон ФИС ФРДО", str(exc))
            return
        target = self.database.path.parent / "frdo_certificate_template.xlsx"
        try:
            shutil.copy2(source, target)
        except OSError as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Шаблон ФИС ФРДО", f"Не удалось сохранить шаблон:\n{exc}")
            return
        values = dict(self.settings)
        values["template_path"] = str(target)
        self.database.update_frdo_settings(values)
        self.reload(self.checked_course_ids())
        QMessageBox.information(self, "Шаблон ФИС ФРДО", "Актуальный шаблон сохранён и будет использоваться при выгрузке.")

    def selected_records(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return [self.records[course_id] for course_id in sorted(self.checked_course_ids()) if course_id in self.records]

    def _issues_for_records(self, records: list[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[tuple[Mapping[str, Any], Any]]:
        result: list[tuple[Mapping[str, Any], Any]] = []
        for record in records:
            for issue in validate_record(record):
                result.append((record, issue))
        return result

    def validate_selected(self) -> bool:
        records = self.selected_records()
        if not records:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "ФИС ФРДО", "Отметьте документы для проверки.")
            return False
        issues = self._issues_for_records(records)
        if not issues:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Проверка ФИС ФРДО", f"Проверка пройдена. Документов: {len(records)}.")
            return True
        lines: list[str] = []
        for record, issue in issues[:40]:
            fio = f"{record.get('last_name', '')} {record.get('first_name', '')}".strip()
            lines.append(f"• {fio}, {record.get('course_name', '')}: {issue.message}")
        if len(issues) > 40:
            lines.append(f"…ещё ошибок: {len(issues) - 40}")
        box = QMessageBox(self)
        box.setIcon(QMessageBox.Icon.Warning)
        box.setWindowTitle("Проверка ФИС ФРДО")
        box.setText(f"Обнаружено ошибок: {len(issues)}")
        box.setDetailedText("\n".join(lines))
        box.setStandardButtons(QMessageBox.StandardButton.Ok)
        box.exec()
        return False

    def export_selected(self) -> None:
        records = self.selected_records()
        if not records:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "ФИС ФРДО",
                "Отметьте документы для выгрузки.",
            )
            return
        if self._issues_for_records(records):
            self.validate_selected()
            return
        default_name = f"ФИС_ФРДО_ДПО_{date.today():%Y%m%d}.xlsx"
        path, _selected_filter = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Сохранить файл ФИС ФРДО",
            str(Path.home() / "Documents" / default_name),
            "Книга Excel (*.xlsx)",
        )
        if not path:
            return

        output_path = Path(path)
        template_path = self.template_path()
        export_records_snapshot = tuple(dict(record) for record in records)
        self._set_loading(
            True,
            f"Формирование файла ФИС ФРДО: {len(records)} документ(ов)…",
        )
        self.loading_progress.setRange(0, 0)
        self.loading_progress.setTextVisible(False)

        thread = QThread(self)
        worker = FrdoExportWorker(
            self.database.path,
            export_records_snapshot,
            output_path,
            template_path,
        )
        worker.moveToThread(thread)
        thread.started.connect(worker.run)
        worker.finished.connect(self._export_finished)
        worker.failed.connect(self._export_failed)
        worker.finished.connect(thread.quit)
        worker.failed.connect(thread.quit)
        worker.finished.connect(worker.deleteLater)
        worker.failed.connect(worker.deleteLater)
        thread.finished.connect(self._export_thread_finished)
        thread.finished.connect(thread.deleteLater)
        self._export_thread = thread
        self._export_worker = worker
        thread.start()

    def _export_thread_finished(self) -> None:
        self._export_thread = None
        self._export_worker = None

    def _export_failed(self, message: str) -> None:
        self._set_loading(False)
        self.loading_progress.setRange(0, 1)
        self.loading_progress.setValue(0)
        QMessageBox.critical(
            self,
            "Выгрузка ФИС ФРДО",
            "Не удалось сформировать файл:\n\n" + message,
        )

    def _export_finished(self, result: object) -> None:
        self._set_loading(False)
        self.loading_progress.setRange(0, 1)
        self.loading_progress.setValue(1)
        files = tuple(getattr(result, "files", tuple()))
        records_count = int(getattr(result, "records_count", 0) or 0)
        file_lines = "\n".join(str(file_path) for file_path in files)
        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Выгрузка ФИС ФРДО",
            f"Сформировано документов: {records_count}.\n\n"
            f"Файлы:\n{file_lines}",
        )

class GarSelectorDialog(QDialog):

        self,

    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("Выбор адреса из ГАР")
        self.resize(820, 430)

        self.list_widget.setAlternatingRowColors(True)

            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, suggestion)
            item.setToolTip(suggestion.address)
            self.list_widget.addItem(item)

        if self.list_widget.count():
            self.list_widget.setCurrentRow(0)

        buttons = QDialogButtonBox(
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok
            | QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel
        )
        buttons.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Ok).setText("Выбрать")

        buttons.accepted.connect(self._accept_if_selected)
        buttons.rejected.connect(self.reject)
        self.list_widget.itemDoubleClicked.connect(lambda _: self._accept_if_selected())

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addWidget(description)
        layout.addWidget(self.list_widget, 1)
        layout.addWidget(buttons)

    def selected_suggestion(self) -> GarSuggestion | None:
        item = self.list_widget.currentItem()
        if item is None:
            return None
        value = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        return value if isinstance(value, GarSuggestion) else None

    def _accept_if_selected(self) -> None:
        if self.selected_suggestion() is not None:
            self.accept()

def _native_grid_color(widget=None) -> QColor:
    """Fixed light-grey journal grid colour."""

    color = QColor("#D8D8D8")
    color.setAlpha(255)
    return color


# Visible logical columns. Legacy separator columns remain hidden so they no
# longer consume width or create borders of their own.
VISIBLE_JOURNAL_COLUMNS = (0, 1, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 13, 15)
# A thick edge is needed on both sides of the student and postal-date columns.
# Each boundary is drawn only once: as the right edge of the preceding column.
VERTICAL_BOUNDARY_WIDTHS = {1: 3, 3: 3, 11: 3, 13: 3}


def _boundary_width_after(logical_index: int) -> int:
    return VERTICAL_BOUNDARY_WIDTHS.get(logical_index, 1)


class JournalHeaderView(QHeaderView):
    """Header with cell-local vertical borders and a black bottom line."""

    BOTTOM_WIDTH = 3

    def paintSection(self, painter: QPainter, rect, logical_index: int) -> None:
        super().paintSection(painter, rect, logical_index)
        if (
            logical_index in VISIBLE_JOURNAL_COLUMNS
            and logical_index != VISIBLE_JOURNAL_COLUMNS[-1]
        ):
            width = _boundary_width_after(logical_index)
            painter.save()
            painter.fillRect(
                rect.right() - width + 1,
                rect.top(),
                width,
                rect.height(),
                _native_grid_color(self),
            )
            painter.restore()

    def paintEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().paintEvent(event)
        painter = QPainter(self.viewport())
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing, False)
        painter.fillRect(
            0,
            max(0, self.viewport().height() - self.BOTTOM_WIDTH),
            self.viewport().width(),
            self.BOTTOM_WIDTH,
            QColor(0, 0, 0),
        )


class JournalCellBorderDelegate(QStyledItemDelegate):
    """Draw borders inside actual cells, never across the empty viewport."""

    def paint(
        self,
        painter: QPainter,
        option: QStyleOptionViewItem,
        index,
    ) -> None:
        super().paint(painter, option, index)
        logical_index = index.column()
        color = _native_grid_color(option.widget or self.parent())
        painter.save()
        # Horizontal grid line for the current row.
        painter.fillRect(
            option.rect.left(),
            option.rect.bottom(),
            option.rect.width(),
            1,
            color,
        )
        # One vertical boundary per pair of adjacent visible columns.
        if (
            logical_index in VISIBLE_JOURNAL_COLUMNS
            and logical_index != VISIBLE_JOURNAL_COLUMNS[-1]
        ):
            width = _boundary_width_after(logical_index)
            painter.fillRect(
                option.rect.right() - width + 1,
                option.rect.top(),
                width,
                option.rect.height(),
                color,
            )
        painter.restore()


class SortableTableWidgetItem(QTableWidgetItem):
    """Table item that sorts by a typed value instead of formatted text."""

    SORT_ROLE = int(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) + 1

    def __init__(self, text: str, sort_value=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(text)
        self.setData(self.SORT_ROLE, sort_value if sort_value is not None else text)

    def __lt__(self, other) -> bool:
        if not isinstance(other, QTableWidgetItem):
            return super().__lt__(other)
        left = self.data(self.SORT_ROLE)
        right = other.data(self.SORT_ROLE)
        if left is None:
            left = ""
        if right is None:
            right = ""
        if isinstance(left, str) and isinstance(right, str):
            return left.casefold() < right.casefold()
        try:
            return left < right
        except TypeError:
            return str(left).casefold() < str(right).casefold()


class DocumentDetailsDialog(QDialog):
    """Edit journal-only document numbers without changing a student card."""

    def __init__(self, record: dict, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("Реквизиты документа")
        self.resize(560, 360)

        self.registration_number = QLineEdit(
            str(record.get("registration_number", "") or "")
        )
        self.blank_number = QLineEdit(str(record.get("blank_number", "") or ""))
        self.issue_date = QLineEdit(str(record.get("issue_date", "") or ""))
        self.issue_date.setPlaceholderText("ГГГГ-ММ-ДД или ДД.ММ.ГГГГ")
        self.notes = QTextEdit(str(record.get("notes", "") or ""))
        self.notes.setPlaceholderText("Примечание к записи журнала")

        form = QFormLayout()
        form.addRow("Регистрационный номер", self.registration_number)
        form.addRow("Номер бланка", self.blank_number)
        form.addRow("Дата выдачи", self.issue_date)
        form.addRow("Примечание", self.notes)

        buttons = QDialogButtonBox(
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Save
            | QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel
        )
        buttons.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Save).setText("Сохранить")
        buttons.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel).setText("Отмена")
        buttons.accepted.connect(self.accept)
        buttons.rejected.connect(self.reject)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addLayout(form)
        layout.addWidget(buttons)

    @staticmethod
    def _iso_date(value: str) -> str:
        text = str(value or "").strip()
        if not text:
            return ""
        for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%d.%m.%Y", "%d/%m/%Y"):
            try:
                return datetime.strptime(text, fmt).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
            except ValueError:
                continue
        raise ValueError("Введите дату в формате ДД.ММ.ГГГГ или ГГГГ-ММ-ДД.")

    def values(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return {
            "registration_number": self.registration_number.text().strip(),
            "blank_number": self.blank_number.text().strip(),
            "issue_date": self._iso_date(self.issue_date.text()),
            "notes": self.notes.toPlainText().strip(),
        }

    def accept(self) -> None:
        try:
            self._iso_date(self.issue_date.text())
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Реквизиты документа", str(exc))
            self.issue_date.setFocus()
            return
        super().accept()

    @staticmethod
    def _iso_filter_date(value: str) -> str:
        text = str(value or "").strip()
        if not text:
            return ""
        for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%d.%m.%Y", "%d/%m/%Y"):
            try:
                return datetime.strptime(text, fmt).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
            except ValueError:
                continue
        raise ValueError("Дата фильтра должна быть в формате ДД.ММ.ГГГГ.")

    @staticmethod
    def _display_date(value: str) -> str:
        text = str(value or "").strip()
        if not text:
            return ""
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(text[:10], "%Y-%m-%d").strftime("%d.%m.%Y")
        except ValueError:
            return text

    @staticmethod
    def _display_datetime(value: str) -> str:
        text = str(value or "").strip()
        if not text:
            return ""
        for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"):
            try:
                return datetime.strptime(text[:19], fmt).strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M")
            except ValueError:
                continue
        return text

    def _filters(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
        date_from = self._iso_filter_date(self.date_from.text())
        date_to = self._iso_filter_date(self.date_to.text())
        if date_from and date_to and date_from > date_to:
            raise ValueError("Начальная дата не может быть позднее конечной.")
        return date_from, date_to

    @staticmethod
    def _russian_sort_key(value) -> str:
        return str(value or "").strip().casefold().replace("ё", "е")

    def _sort_by_header(self, logical_index: int) -> None:
        if logical_index not in self.VISUAL_TO_SORT_COLUMN:
            return
        if logical_index == self._sort_column:
            self._sort_order = (
                Qt.SortOrder.DescendingOrder
                if self._sort_order == Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder
                else Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder
            )
        else:
            self._sort_column = logical_index
            self._sort_order = Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.blockSignals(True)
        try:
            header.setSortIndicator(self._sort_column, self._sort_order)
        finally:
            header.blockSignals(False)
        self.load_documents()

    def _renumber_visible_rows(self) -> None:
        if self._renumbering_rows:
            return
        self._renumbering_rows = True
        try:
            for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
                item = self.table.item(row, self.COL_NUMBER)
                if item is None:
                    item = SortableTableWidgetItem(str(row + 1), row + 1)
                    self.table.setItem(row, self.COL_NUMBER, item)
                else:
                    item.setText(str(row + 1))
                    item.setData(SortableTableWidgetItem.SORT_ROLE, row + 1)
                item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        finally:
            self._renumbering_rows = False

    @staticmethod
    def _two_line_text_width(text: str, metrics) -> int:
        """Return the smallest width that can show text in at most two lines."""

        words = str(text or "").split()
        if not words:
            return 0
        if len(words) == 1:
            return metrics.horizontalAdvance(words[0])

        best = metrics.horizontalAdvance(" ".join(words))
        for split_at in range(1, len(words)):
            first = metrics.horizontalAdvance(" ".join(words[:split_at]))
            second = metrics.horizontalAdvance(" ".join(words[split_at:]))
            best = min(best, max(first, second))
        return best

    def _resize_course_column_for_two_lines(self) -> None:
        metrics = self.table.fontMetrics()
        header_metrics = self.table.horizontalHeader().fontMetrics()
        required_width = header_metrics.horizontalAdvance("Курс") + 24
        for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            item = self.table.item(row, self.COL_COURSE)
            if item is not None:
                required_width = max(
                    required_width,
                    self._two_line_text_width(item.text(), metrics) + 24,
                )
        self.table.setColumnWidth(
            self.COL_COURSE, max(150, required_width)
        )
        self.table.resizeRowsToContents()

    def _resize_status_column(self) -> None:
        metrics = self.table.fontMetrics()
        header_metrics = self.table.horizontalHeader().fontMetrics()
        required_width = header_metrics.horizontalAdvance("Статус") + 24
        for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            item = self.table.item(row, self.COL_STATUS)
            if item is not None:
                required_width = max(
                    required_width,
                    metrics.horizontalAdvance(item.text()) + 24,
                )
        self.table.setColumnWidth(self.COL_STATUS, max(108, required_width))

    def load_documents(self) -> None:
        try:
            date_from, date_to = self._filters()
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Фильтр журнала", str(exc))
            return
        rows = self.database.list_issued_documents(
            query=self.search.text(),
            document_kind=str(self.document_type.currentData() or ""),
            status=str(self.status.currentData() or ""),
            date_from=date_from,
            date_to=date_to,
        )
        rows = sort_journal_records(
            rows,
            self.VISUAL_TO_SORT_COLUMN[self._sort_column],
            descending=self._sort_order == Qt.SortOrder.DescendingOrder,
            postal_acceptance_getter=self.database.postal_acceptance_datetime,
        )
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.blockSignals(True)
        try:
            header.setSortIndicator(self._sort_column, self._sort_order)
        finally:
            header.blockSignals(False)
        self.table.setSortingEnabled(False)
        self.table.clearSelection()
        self.table.setRowCount(len(rows))
        for row_index, record in enumerate(rows):
            full_name = " ".join(
                part for part in (
                    str(record["last_name"] or "").strip(),
                    str(record["first_name"] or "").strip(),
                    str(record["middle_name"] or "").strip(),
                ) if part
            )
            name_sort = "\n".join((
                self._russian_sort_key(record["last_name"]),
                self._russian_sort_key(record["first_name"]),
                self._russian_sort_key(record["middle_name"]),
                f"{int(record['id']):020d}",
            ))
            revision = str(record["revision_kind"] or "Оригинал")
            if revision != "Оригинал":
                revision = f"{revision} № {int(record['revision_number'] or 0)}"
            postal_sent_at = self.database.postal_acceptance_datetime(record)
            issue_date = str(record["issue_date"] or "").strip()
            values = (
                (str(row_index + 1), row_index + 1),
                (self._display_date(issue_date), issue_date),
                ("", ""),
                (full_name, name_sort),
                ("", ""),
                (str(record["course_name"] or ""), str(record["course_name"] or "")),
                (str(record["duration_hours"] or ""), int(record["duration_hours"] or 0)),
                (str(record["registration_number"] or ""), str(record["registration_number"] or "")),
                (str(record["blank_number"] or ""), str(record["blank_number"] or "")),
                (DOCUMENT_KIND_LABELS.get(str(record["document_kind"]), str(record["document_title"] or "")), str(record["document_kind"] or "")),
                (revision, f"{str(record['revision_kind'] or 'Оригинал')} {int(record['revision_number'] or 0):020d}"),
                (str(record["status"] or ""), str(record["status"] or "")),
                ("", ""),
                (self._display_datetime(postal_sent_at), postal_sent_at),
                ("", ""),
                (str(record["notes"] or ""), str(record["notes"] or "")),
                (str(record["id"]), int(record["id"])),
            )
            for column, (value, sort_value) in enumerate(values):
                item = SortableTableWidgetItem(value, sort_value)
                if column in (
                    self.COL_NUMBER,
                    self.COL_ISSUE_DATE,
                    self.COL_HOURS,
                    self.COL_REGISTRATION_NUMBER,
                    self.COL_BLANK_NUMBER,
                    self.COL_POSTAL_DATE,
                ):
                    item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
                if column in self.SEPARATOR_COLUMNS:
                    item.setFlags(Qt.ItemFlag.NoItemFlags)
                item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, int(record["id"]))
                self.table.setItem(row_index, column, item)
            if str(record["status"] or "") == "Аннулирован":
                for column in range(self.table.columnCount()):
                    item = self.table.item(row_index, column)
                    if item is not None:
                        item.setForeground(QColor("darkred"))
        self._resize_course_column_for_two_lines()
        self._resize_status_column()
        self._renumber_visible_rows()
        self.summary.setText(f"Записей в журнале: {len(rows)}")
        self._update_buttons()

    def _record_for_row(self, row: int) -> dict | None:
        if row < 0 or row >= self.table.rowCount():
            return None
        item = self.table.item(row, self.COL_ID)
        if item is None:
            return None
        record = self.database.get_issued_document(int(item.text()))
        return dict(record) if record is not None else None

    def _handle_cell_double_clicked(self, row: int, column: int) -> None:
        # Informational and separator columns do not open additional windows.
        if column in (
            self.COL_NUMBER,
            self.COL_ISSUE_DATE,
            self.COL_NOTES,
            *self.SEPARATOR_COLUMNS,
        ):
            return
        record = self._record_for_row(row)
        if record is None:
            return
        if column == self.COL_STUDENT:
            self.studentOpenRequested.emit(int(record["student_id"]))
            return
        if column == self.COL_POSTAL_DATE:
            self.postalOpenRequested.emit(int(record["id"]))
            return
        self.documentOpenRequested.emit(int(record["id"]))

    def selected_document_id(self) -> int | None:
        rows = self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows()
        if len(rows) != 1:
            return None
        item = self.table.item(rows[0].row(), self.COL_ID)
        return int(item.text()) if item is not None else None

    def selected_record(self) -> dict | None:
        document_id = self.selected_document_id()
        if document_id is None:
            return None
        row = self.database.get_issued_document(document_id)
        return dict(row) if row is not None else None

    def _update_buttons(self) -> None:
        record = self.selected_record()
        enabled = record is not None
        annulled = enabled and str(record.get("status", "")) == "Аннулирован"
        issued = enabled and bool(str(record.get("issued_at", "")).strip())
        delivery_datetime = (
            self.database.issued_document_postal_delivery_datetime(
                int(record["id"])
            )
            if enabled
            else ""
        )
        self.open_document_button.setEnabled(enabled and not annulled)
        self.open_student_button.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.edit_button.setEnabled(enabled and not annulled)
        self.mark_issued_button.setEnabled(enabled and not annulled and not issued)
        self.mark_issued_button.setToolTip(
            "Отметить документ выданным лично. Для почтовых отправлений статус "
            "«Выдан» устанавливается автоматически после операции «Вручение»."
        )
        self.unmark_issued_button.setEnabled(
            enabled and not annulled and issued and not delivery_datetime
        )
        if delivery_datetime:
            self.unmark_issued_button.setToolTip(
                "Отметку нельзя снять: Почта России подтвердила вручение."
            )
        else:
            self.unmark_issued_button.setToolTip(
                "Снять ручную отметку о личной выдаче документа."
            )
        self.duplicate_button.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.correction_button.setEnabled(enabled)
        self.annul_button.setEnabled(enabled and not annulled)

    def clear_filters(self) -> None:
        self.search.clear()
        self.document_type.setCurrentIndex(0)
        self.status.setCurrentIndex(0)
        self.date_from.clear()
        self.date_to.clear()
        self.load_documents()

    def open_student(self) -> None:
        record = self.selected_record()
        if record is not None:
            self.studentOpenRequested.emit(int(record["student_id"]))

    def open_document(self) -> None:
        document_id = self.selected_document_id()
        if document_id is not None:
            self.documentOpenRequested.emit(document_id)

    def edit_details(self) -> None:
        record = self.selected_record()
        if record is None:
            return
        dialog = DocumentDetailsDialog(record, self)
        if dialog.exec() != int(QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted):
            return
        try:
            self.database.update_issued_document_details(
                int(record["id"]), dialog.values()
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Реквизиты документа", str(exc))
            return
        self.load_documents()

    def set_issued(self, issued: bool) -> None:
        document_id = self.selected_document_id()
        if document_id is None:
            return
        try:
            self.database.set_issued_document_issued(document_id, issued)
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Журнал документов", str(exc))
            return
        self.load_documents()

    def create_revision(self, revision_kind: str) -> None:
        document_id = self.selected_document_id()
        if document_id is None:
            return
        answer = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            revision_kind,
            f"Создать запись «{revision_kind}» на основании выбранного документа?",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
        )
        if answer != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        try:
            new_id = self.database.create_issued_document_revision(
                document_id, revision_kind
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, revision_kind, str(exc))
            return
        self.load_documents()
        for row in range(self.table.rowCount()):
            item = self.table.item(row, self.COL_ID)
            if item is not None and int(item.text()) == new_id:
                self.table.selectRow(row)
                self.table.scrollToItem(item)
                break
        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            revision_kind,
            "Запись создана. Укажите новый номер бланка и откройте документ для печати.",
        )

    def annul_document(self) -> None:
        document_id = self.selected_document_id()
        if document_id is None:
            return
        reason, accepted = QInputDialog.getMultiLineText(
            self,
            "Аннулирование документа",
            "Причина аннулирования:",
        )
        if not accepted:
            return
        try:
            self.database.annul_issued_document(document_id, reason)
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Аннулирование документа", str(exc))
            return
        self.load_documents()

    def export_excel(self) -> None:
        try:
            date_from, date_to = self._filters()
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Экспорт журнала", str(exc))
            return
        rows = self.database.list_issued_documents(
            query=self.search.text(),
            document_kind=str(self.document_type.currentData() or ""),
            status=str(self.status.currentData() or ""),
            date_from=date_from,
            date_to=date_to,
        )
        if not rows:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self, "Экспорт журнала", "По выбранным фильтрам нет записей."
            )
            return
        default_name = f"Журнал_выданных_документов_{datetime.now():%Y-%m-%d}.xlsx"
        path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Экспорт журнала выданных документов",
            str(Path.home() / "Documents" / default_name),
            "Excel (*.xlsx)",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        if not path.lower().endswith(".xlsx"):
            path += ".xlsx"

        workbook = Workbook()
        sheet = workbook.active
        sheet.title = "Журнал документов"
        headers = (
            "№", "Дата выдачи", "Обучающийся", "Курс", "Часы",
            "Регистрационный номер", "Номер бланка",
            "Вид документа", "Экземпляр", "Статус",
            "Дата направления обучающемуся", "Аннулирован",
            "Причина аннулирования", "Примечание",
        )
        sheet.append(headers)
        for cell in sheet[1]:
            cell.font = Font(bold=True)
            cell.fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="D9EAF7")
            cell.alignment = Alignment(
                horizontal="center", vertical="center", wrap_text=True
            )
        for row_number, record in enumerate(rows, start=1):
            full_name = " ".join(
                part for part in (
                    str(record["last_name"] or "").strip(),
                    str(record["first_name"] or "").strip(),
                    str(record["middle_name"] or "").strip(),
                ) if part
            )
            revision = str(record["revision_kind"] or "Оригинал")
            if revision != "Оригинал":
                revision = f"{revision} № {int(record['revision_number'] or 0)}"
            postal_sent_at = self.database.postal_acceptance_datetime(record)
            sheet.append((
                row_number,
                self._display_date(str(record["issue_date"] or "")),
                full_name,
                str(record["course_name"] or ""),
                int(record["duration_hours"] or 0),
                str(record["registration_number"] or ""),
                str(record["blank_number"] or ""),
                DOCUMENT_KIND_LABELS.get(
                    str(record["document_kind"]),
                    str(record["document_title"] or ""),
                ),
                revision,
                str(record["status"] or ""),
                self._display_datetime(postal_sent_at),
                self._display_datetime(str(record["annulled_at"] or "")),
                str(record["annulment_reason"] or ""),
                str(record["notes"] or ""),
            ))
        sheet.freeze_panes = "A2"
        sheet.auto_filter.ref = sheet.dimensions
        widths = (7, 15, 36, 52, 9, 23, 19, 20, 18, 15, 27, 20, 34, 40)
        for index, width in enumerate(widths, start=1):
            sheet.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(index)].width = width
        for row in sheet.iter_rows(min_row=2):
            for cell in row:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
        workbook.save(path)
        QMessageBox.information(
            self, "Экспорт журнала", f"Журнал сохранён:\n{path}"
        )

class ThickBottomHeaderView(QHeaderView):
    """Native-looking header with a clear separator below the headings."""

    def paintSection(self, painter: QPainter, rect: QRect, logical_index: int) -> None:
        super().paintSection(painter, rect, logical_index)
        painter.save()
        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(75, 75, 75), 3))
        painter.drawLine(rect.bottomLeft(), rect.bottomRight())
        painter.restore()


class PersistentItemColorDelegate(QStyledItemDelegate):

        self,
        painter: QPainter,
        option: QStyleOptionViewItem,
        index: QModelIndex,
    ) -> None:
        super().paint(painter, option, index)


class CenteredCheckBoxDelegate(QStyledItemDelegate):
    """Paint and toggle a check box exactly in the centre of its table cell."""

    @staticmethod
    def _indicator_rect(option: QStyleOptionViewItem) -> QRect:
        style = option.widget.style() if option.widget else QApplication.style()
        width = style.pixelMetric(
            QStyle.PixelMetric.PM_IndicatorWidth, None, option.widget
        )
        height = style.pixelMetric(
            QStyle.PixelMetric.PM_IndicatorHeight, None, option.widget
        )
        return QRect(
            option.rect.x() + (option.rect.width() - width) // 2,
            option.rect.y() + (option.rect.height() - height) // 2,
            width,
            height,
        )

    def paint(
        self,
        painter: QPainter,
        option: QStyleOptionViewItem,
        index: QModelIndex,
    ) -> None:
        styled = QStyleOptionViewItem(option)
        self.initStyleOption(styled, index)
        style = styled.widget.style() if styled.widget else QApplication.style()

        # Draw the complete cell background, selection and focus without the
        # platform's default left-aligned check indicator.
        styled.features &= ~QStyleOptionViewItem.ViewItemFeature.HasCheckIndicator
        styled.text = ""
        style.drawControl(
            QStyle.ControlElement.CE_ItemViewItem, styled, painter, styled.widget
        )

        button = QStyleOptionButton()
        button.rect = self._indicator_rect(styled)
        button.state = QStyle.StateFlag.State_Enabled
        if styled.state & QStyle.StateFlag.State_MouseOver:
            button.state |= QStyle.StateFlag.State_MouseOver
        if styled.state & QStyle.StateFlag.State_HasFocus:
            button.state |= QStyle.StateFlag.State_HasFocus

        check_state = index.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.CheckStateRole)
        if check_state == Qt.CheckState.Checked:
            button.state |= QStyle.StateFlag.State_On
        elif check_state == Qt.CheckState.PartiallyChecked:
            button.state |= QStyle.StateFlag.State_NoChange
        else:
            button.state |= QStyle.StateFlag.State_Off

        style.drawControl(
            QStyle.ControlElement.CE_CheckBox, button, painter, styled.widget
        )

    def editorEvent(self, event, model, option, index) -> bool:
        flags = index.flags()
        if not (
            flags & Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled
            and flags & Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable
        ):
            return False

        should_toggle = False
        if (
            event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonRelease
            and isinstance(event, QMouseEvent)
            and event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton
            and self._indicator_rect(option).contains(event.position().toPoint())
        ):
            should_toggle = True
        elif event.type() == QEvent.Type.KeyPress and event.key() in (
            Qt.Key.Key_Space,
            Qt.Key.Key_Select,
        ):
            should_toggle = True

        if not should_toggle:
            return False

        current = index.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.CheckStateRole)
        new_state = (
            Qt.CheckState.Unchecked
            if current == Qt.CheckState.Checked
            else Qt.CheckState.Checked
        )
        return bool(
            model.setData(index, new_state, Qt.ItemDataRole.CheckStateRole)
        )


class TrackingStatusDelegate(QStyledItemDelegate):
    """Paint a clickable green refresh glyph at the right of each status cell."""

    STUDENT_ID_ROLE = int(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) + 20
    TRACK_NUMBER_ROLE = int(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) + 21
    BUTTON_WIDTH = 30
    refreshRequested = Signal(int, str)

    def _button_rect(self, cell_rect: QRect) -> QRect:
        size = min(24, max(18, cell_rect.height() - 4))
        left = cell_rect.right() - size - 3
        top = cell_rect.top() + (cell_rect.height() - size) // 2
        return QRect(left, top, size, size)

    def paint(
        self,
        painter: QPainter,
        option: QStyleOptionViewItem,
        index: QModelIndex,
    ) -> None:
        styled = QStyleOptionViewItem(option)
        self.initStyleOption(styled, index)
        foreground = index.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.ForegroundRole)
        text = styled.text
        styled.text = ""
        style = styled.widget.style() if styled.widget else QApplication.style()
        style.drawControl(
            QStyle.ControlElement.CE_ItemViewItem, styled, painter, styled.widget
        )

        painter.save()
        text_rect = styled.rect.adjusted(6, 0, -self.BUTTON_WIDTH, 0)
        if styled.state & QStyle.StateFlag.State_Selected:
            color = styled.palette.highlightedText().color()
        elif isinstance(foreground, QBrush):
            color = foreground.color()
        else:
            color = styled.palette.text().color()
        painter.setPen(color)
        elided = styled.fontMetrics.elidedText(
            text, Qt.TextElideMode.ElideRight, max(0, text_rect.width())
        )
        painter.drawText(
            text_rect,
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter,
            elided,
        )

        button_rect = self._button_rect(styled.rect)
        has_track = bool(str(index.data(self.TRACK_NUMBER_ROLE) or "").strip())
        if styled.state & QStyle.StateFlag.State_MouseOver:
            painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
            painter.setBrush(QColor(224, 244, 231))
            painter.drawRoundedRect(button_rect, 6, 6)

        painter.setPen(QColor(24, 145, 72))
        font = painter.font()
        font.setBold(True)
        font.setPointSize(max(font.pointSize(), 14))
        painter.setFont(font)

        # Значок повёрнут по часовой стрелке на 72° относительно исходного
        # положения, чтобы визуально соответствовать пиктограмме Chrome.
        center = button_rect.center()
        painter.translate(center)
        painter.rotate(72)
        rotated_rect = QRect(
            -button_rect.width() // 2,
            -button_rect.height() // 2,
            button_rect.width(),
            button_rect.height(),
        )
        painter.drawText(rotated_rect, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, "↻")
        painter.restore()

    def editorEvent(self, event, model, option, index) -> bool:
        if (
            event.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonRelease
            and isinstance(event, QMouseEvent)
            and event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton
            and self._button_rect(option.rect).contains(event.position().toPoint())
        ):
            student_id = index.data(self.STUDENT_ID_ROLE)
            track_number = str(index.data(self.TRACK_NUMBER_ROLE) or "")
            if student_id is not None:
                self.refreshRequested.emit(int(student_id), track_number)
                return True
        return super().editorEvent(event, model, option, index)

    def helpEvent(self, event, view, option, index) -> bool:
        track_number = str(index.data(self.TRACK_NUMBER_ROLE) or "").strip()
        if self._button_rect(option.rect).contains(event.pos()):
            from PySide6.QtWidgets import QToolTip

            text = (
                "Обновить статус отправления на сайте Почты России"
                if track_number
                else "Трек-номер для этой записи не указан"
            )
            QToolTip.showText(event.globalPos(), text, view)
            return True
        return super().helpEvent(event, view, option, index)


class SortableTableWidgetItem(QTableWidgetItem):
    """Table item that sorts by a typed value instead of formatted text."""

    SORT_ROLE = int(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) + 1

    def __init__(self, text: str, sort_value=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(text)
        self.setData(self.SORT_ROLE, sort_value if sort_value is not None else text)

    def __lt__(self, other) -> bool:
        if not isinstance(other, QTableWidgetItem):
            return super().__lt__(other)
        left = self.data(self.SORT_ROLE)
        right = other.data(self.SORT_ROLE)
        if left is None:
            left = ""
        if right is None:
            right = ""
        if isinstance(left, str) and isinstance(right, str):
            return left.casefold() < right.casefold()
        try:
            return left < right
        except TypeError:
            return str(left).casefold() < str(right).casefold()
