            self._field_table_selection_changed
        )
        self.show_field_boxes.toggled.connect(self.schedule_preview_update)
        self.zoom_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._zoom_combo_changed)
        self.zoom_in_button.clicked.connect(self._zoom_in)
        self.zoom_out_button.clicked.connect(self._zoom_out)
        self.fit_button.clicked.connect(self._fit_preview)
        workspace_splitter.splitterMoved.connect(
            lambda *_args: self._schedule_preview_zoom()
        )

        self._fit_window_to_screen()
        self._connect_preview_signals()
        self._normalize_right_block_left_edges()
        self._update_right_block_width_limits()
        self.update_preview()

    def _normalize_right_block_left_edges(self) -> None:
        """Align the left border of the main right-side text blocks to one vertical line."""
        reference_pair = self.field_spins.get("training_info")
        if reference_pair is None:
            return
        reference_x = reference_pair[0].value()
        for key in ("full_name", "course_name", "duration_hours"):
            pair = self.field_spins.get(key)
            if pair is None:
                continue
            x_spin, _y_spin = pair
            if abs(x_spin.value() - reference_x) > 0.001:
                x_spin.blockSignals(True)
                try:
                    x_spin.setValue(reference_x)
                finally:
                    x_spin.blockSignals(False)

    def _update_right_block_width_limits(self, *_args) -> None:
        """Keep right-side fields inside the printable inner frame."""
        for key in ("full_name", "training_info", "course_name", "duration_hours"):
            pair = self.field_spins.get(key)
            controls = self.field_style_controls.get(key)
            if pair is None or controls is None:
                continue
            x_spin, _y_spin = pair
            width_spin = controls[4]
            base_x, _base_y = FIELD_BASE_POSITIONS_MM[key]
            actual_x = (
                float(base_x)
                + self.offset_x.value()
                + x_spin.value()
            )
            actual_x = max(
                RIGHT_CONTENT_LEFT_MM,
                min(actual_x, RIGHT_TEXT_AREA_RIGHT_MM - 3.0),
            )
            maximum_width = max(3.0, RIGHT_TEXT_AREA_RIGHT_MM - actual_x)
            width_spin.setMaximum(maximum_width)
        self.schedule_preview_update()

    def _connect_preview_signals(self) -> None:
        self.offset_x.valueChanged.connect(self.schedule_preview_update)
        self.offset_x.valueChanged.connect(self._update_right_block_width_limits)
        self.offset_y.valueChanged.connect(self.schedule_preview_update)
        for key, (x_spin, y_spin) in self.field_spins.items():
            x_spin.valueChanged.connect(self.schedule_preview_update)
            if key in {"full_name", "training_info", "course_name", "duration_hours"}:
                x_spin.valueChanged.connect(self._update_right_block_width_limits)
            y_spin.valueChanged.connect(self.schedule_preview_update)
            (
                font_combo,
                size_spin,
                bold_box,
                italic_box,
                width_spin,
                height_spin,
            ) = self.field_style_controls[key]
            font_combo.currentTextChanged.connect(self.schedule_preview_update)
            size_spin.valueChanged.connect(self.schedule_preview_update)
            bold_box.toggled.connect(self.schedule_preview_update)
            italic_box.toggled.connect(self.schedule_preview_update)
            width_spin.valueChanged.connect(self.schedule_preview_update)
            height_spin.valueChanged.connect(self.schedule_preview_update)

        full_name_row_font, full_name_row_size, *_name_rest = (
            self.field_style_controls["full_name"]
        )
        self.full_name_text_editor.textChanged.connect(
            self.schedule_preview_update
        )
        self.full_name_alignment.currentIndexChanged.connect(
            self.schedule_preview_update
        )
        self.full_name_editor_font.currentTextChanged.connect(
            full_name_row_font.setCurrentText
        )
        full_name_row_font.currentTextChanged.connect(
            self.full_name_editor_font.setCurrentText
        )
        self.full_name_editor_font.currentTextChanged.connect(
            self.schedule_preview_update
        )
        self.full_name_editor_size.valueChanged.connect(
            full_name_row_size.setValue
        )
        full_name_row_size.valueChanged.connect(
            self.full_name_editor_size.setValue
        )
        self.full_name_editor_size.valueChanged.connect(
            self.schedule_preview_update
        )

        training_row_font, training_row_size, *_rest = self.field_style_controls[
            "training_info"
        ]
        self.training_text_editor.textChanged.connect(self.schedule_preview_update)
        self.training_alignment.currentIndexChanged.connect(
            self.schedule_preview_update
        )
        self.training_editor_font.currentTextChanged.connect(
            training_row_font.setCurrentText
        )
        training_row_font.currentTextChanged.connect(
            self.training_editor_font.setCurrentText
        )
        self.training_editor_font.currentTextChanged.connect(
            self.schedule_preview_update
        )
        self.training_editor_size.valueChanged.connect(training_row_size.setValue)
        training_row_size.valueChanged.connect(self.training_editor_size.setValue)
        self.training_editor_size.valueChanged.connect(self.schedule_preview_update)

    def schedule_preview_update(self) -> None:
        self._preview_timer.start()

    def _build_preview_data(self) -> CertificateData:
        settings = self.database.get_organization_settings()
        catalog = self.database.list_course_catalog()
        course_name = "Банкротство граждан: искусство создавать практику"
        duration_hours = 32
        if catalog:
            sample_course = catalog[0]
            course_name = str(sample_course["course_name"] or course_name)
            try:
                duration_hours = int(sample_course["duration_hours"] or duration_hours)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                duration_hours = 32
        offset_x, offset_y, field_offsets, field_styles = self.values()
        return CertificateData(
            student_id=0,
            student_course_id=0,
            template_id=int(self.template.get("id", 0) or 0),
            full_name="Тюрина Дарья Вадимовна",
            course_name=course_name,
            duration_hours=duration_hours,
            organization_name=str(settings["short_name"] or "ООО «Учебный центр»"),
            license_number=str(settings["license_number"] or "Л035-01234-77/00000001"),
            license_date=str(settings["license_date"] or "01.01.2024"),
            registration_number="065",
            blank_number="123456789012",
            issue_city=str(settings["issue_city"] or "Москва"),
            issue_date="29.07.2026",
            director_name=str(settings["director_name"] or "К.Н. Постоюк"),
            secretary_name=str(settings["secretary_name"] or "А.Н. Войнова"),
            gender="Женский",
            offset_x_mm=offset_x,
            offset_y_mm=offset_y,
            field_offsets={k: (float(v["x"]), float(v["y"])) for k, v in field_offsets.items()},
            field_styles=field_styles,
        )

    def _fit_window_to_screen(self) -> None:
        screen = self.screen() or QGuiApplication.primaryScreen()
        if screen is None:
            self.resize(1280, 760)
            return
        available = screen.availableGeometry().adjusted(6, 6, -6, -6)
        width = min(1540, max(900, available.width() - 24))
        height = min(920, max(620, available.height() - 24))
        width = min(width, max(1, available.width()))
        height = min(height, max(1, available.height()))
        self.setGeometry(
            available.left() + max(0, (available.width() - width) // 2),
            available.top() + max(0, (available.height() - height) // 2),
            width,
            height,
        )

    def _ensure_window_inside_screen(self) -> None:
        """Keep a restored calibration window entirely in the usable desktop."""

        if self.isMaximized() or self.isFullScreen():
            return
        screen = self.screen() or QGuiApplication.primaryScreen()
        if screen is None:
            return
        available = screen.availableGeometry().adjusted(4, 4, -4, -4)
        width = min(self.width(), available.width())
        height = min(self.height(), available.height())
        x = min(max(self.x(), available.left()), available.right() - width + 1)
        y = min(max(self.y(), available.top()), available.bottom() - height + 1)
        if (x, y, width, height) != (self.x(), self.y(), self.width(), self.height()):
            self.setGeometry(x, y, width, height)

    def _selected_field_key(self) -> str:
        return str(self.field_selector.currentData() or "")

    def _field_selector_changed(self, index: int) -> None:
        if index < 0:
            return
        self.fields_table.blockSignals(True)
        try:
            self.fields_table.setCurrentCell(index, 0)
            self.fields_table.selectRow(index)
            item = self.fields_table.item(index, 0)
            if item is not None:
                self.fields_table.scrollToItem(item)
        finally:
            self.fields_table.blockSignals(False)
        self.schedule_preview_update()

    def _field_table_selection_changed(
        self, current_row: int, _current_column: int, _previous_row: int, _previous_column: int
    ) -> None:
        if current_row < 0 or current_row >= self.field_selector.count():
            return
        self.field_selector.blockSignals(True)
        try:
            self.field_selector.setCurrentIndex(current_row)
        finally:
            self.field_selector.blockSignals(False)
        self.schedule_preview_update()

    def _zoom_combo_changed(self, index: int) -> None:
        value = self.zoom_combo.itemData(index)
        if value is None:
            return
        self._fit_zoom_mode = False
        self._zoom_percent = float(value)
        self._apply_preview_zoom()

    @staticmethod
    def _zoom_label(percent: float) -> str:
        rounded = round(float(percent), 1)
        if abs(rounded - round(rounded)) < 0.05:
            return f"{int(round(rounded))}%"
        return f"{rounded:.1f}%"

    def _show_zoom_percent(self, percent: float) -> None:
        percent = max(1.0, min(300.0, float(percent)))
        rounded = round(percent, 1)
        index = -1
        if abs(rounded - round(rounded)) < 0.05:
            index = self.zoom_combo.findData(int(round(rounded)))
        if index < 0:
            if self._fit_zoom_combo_index is None:
                self.zoom_combo.addItem(self._zoom_label(rounded), rounded)
                self._fit_zoom_combo_index = self.zoom_combo.count() - 1
            else:
                self.zoom_combo.setItemText(
                    self._fit_zoom_combo_index,
                    self._zoom_label(rounded),
                )
                self.zoom_combo.setItemData(
                    self._fit_zoom_combo_index,
                    rounded,
                )
            index = self._fit_zoom_combo_index
        self.zoom_combo.blockSignals(True)
        try:
            self.zoom_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)
        finally:
            self.zoom_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def _set_zoom_percent(self, percent: int) -> None:
        percent = max(25, min(300, int(percent)))
        index = self.zoom_combo.findData(percent)
        if index < 0:
            self.zoom_combo.addItem(f"{percent}%", percent)
            index = self.zoom_combo.findData(percent)
        self.zoom_combo.setCurrentIndex(index)

    def _zoom_in(self) -> None:
        steps = (25, 50, 75, 100, 125, 150, 200, 300)
        current = float(self._zoom_percent)
        next_value = next((value for value in steps if value > current), steps[-1])
        self._set_zoom_percent(next_value)

    def _zoom_out(self) -> None:
        steps = (25, 50, 75, 100, 125, 150, 200, 300)
        current = float(self._zoom_percent)
        previous = [value for value in steps if value < current]
        self._set_zoom_percent(previous[-1] if previous else steps[0])

    def _fit_preview(self) -> None:
        self._fit_zoom_mode = True
        self._apply_preview_zoom()

    def _schedule_preview_zoom(self) -> None:
        # While a manual zoom is selected, refreshing text or field settings
        # must not change the scroll position.  Refit only in «Вписать» mode.
        if self._fit_zoom_mode:
            self._zoom_layout_timer.start()

    @staticmethod
    def _fit_factor(view: QGraphicsView, scene_rect: QRectF) -> float:
        viewport = view.viewport()
        available_width = max(1.0, float(viewport.width()) - 8.0)
        available_height = max(1.0, float(viewport.height()) - 8.0)
        if scene_rect.width() <= 0.0 or scene_rect.height() <= 0.0:
            return 1.0
        return max(0.01, min(
            available_width / float(scene_rect.width()),
            available_height / float(scene_rect.height()),
        ))

    @staticmethod
    def _scene_pixels_per_mm(scene_rect: QRectF) -> float:
        values = []
        if PAGE_WIDTH_MM > 0.0:
            values.append(float(scene_rect.width()) / PAGE_WIDTH_MM)
        if PAGE_HEIGHT_MM > 0.0:
            values.append(float(scene_rect.height()) / PAGE_HEIGHT_MM)
        return max(0.01, sum(values) / len(values)) if values else 1.0

    def _apply_preview_zoom(self) -> None:
        scene_rect = self.preview_scene.sceneRect()
        if scene_rect.isEmpty():
            scene_rect = self.preview_scene.itemsBoundingRect()
        if scene_rect.isEmpty():
            return
        if self.preview_view.viewport().width() <= 1 or self.preview_view.viewport().height() <= 1:
            if self._fit_zoom_mode:
                self._zoom_layout_timer.start()
            return

        scene_pixels_per_mm = self._scene_pixels_per_mm(scene_rect)
        previous_centre = self.preview_view.mapToScene(
            self.preview_view.viewport().rect().center()
        )
        self.preview_view.resetTransform()
        if self._fit_zoom_mode:
            factor = self._fit_factor(self.preview_view, scene_rect)
            self.preview_view.scale(factor, factor)
            self.preview_view.centerOn(scene_rect.center())
            self._zoom_percent = (
                abs(float(self.preview_view.transform().m11()))
                * scene_pixels_per_mm
                / PREVIEW_REFERENCE_PIXELS_PER_MM
                * 100.0
            )
            self._show_zoom_percent(self._zoom_percent)
        else:
            factor = max(
                0.01,
                float(self._zoom_percent)
                / 100.0
                * PREVIEW_REFERENCE_PIXELS_PER_MM
                / scene_pixels_per_mm,
            )
            self.preview_view.scale(factor, factor)
            if scene_rect.contains(previous_centre):
                self.preview_view.centerOn(previous_centre)
            else:
                self.preview_view.centerOn(scene_rect.center())

    def _field_rectangles_mm(
        self,
    ) -> dict[str, tuple[float, float, float, float]]:
        offset_x, offset_y, field_offsets, field_styles = self.values()
        result: dict[str, tuple[float, float, float, float]] = {}
        right_blocks = {
            "full_name",
            "training_info",
            "course_name",
            "duration_hours",
        }
        for key, _label in FIELD_DEFINITIONS:
            base_x, base_y = FIELD_BASE_POSITIONS_MM[key]
            entry = field_offsets.get(key, {})
            field_x = float(entry.get("x", 0.0) or 0.0)
            field_y = float(entry.get("y", 0.0) or 0.0)
            style = dict(FIELD_STYLE_DEFAULTS.get(key, {}))
            style.update(field_styles.get(key, {}))
            x = base_x + float(offset_x) + field_x
            y = base_y + float(offset_y) + field_y
            if key in right_blocks:
                x = max(
                    RIGHT_CONTENT_LEFT_MM,
                    min(x, RIGHT_TEXT_AREA_RIGHT_MM - 3.0),
                )
                requested_width = float(style.get("width_mm", 40.0) or 40.0)
                width = max(
                    3.0,
                    min(requested_width, RIGHT_TEXT_AREA_RIGHT_MM - x),
                )
                height = float(style.get("height_mm", 10.0) or 10.0)
            else:
                width = float(style.get("width_mm", 40.0) or 40.0)
                height = float(style.get("height_mm", 10.0) or 10.0)
            result[key] = (x, y, width, height)
        return result

    def _draw_field_boxes(self, image):
        if image.isNull() or not self.show_field_boxes.isChecked():
            return image
        result = image.copy()
        painter = QPainter(result)
        if not painter.isActive():
            raise RuntimeError("Не удалось начать отрисовку документа.")
        try:
            painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing, True)
            sx = float(result.width()) / PAGE_WIDTH_MM
            sy = float(result.height()) / PAGE_HEIGHT_MM
            selected_key = self._selected_field_key()
            rectangles = self._field_rectangles_mm()
            label_font = QFont("Arial")
            label_font.setPointSizeF(7.5)
            painter.setFont(label_font)
            for key, (x, y, width, height) in rectangles.items():
                selected = key == selected_key
                color = QColor(0, 105, 210, 235) if selected else QColor(210, 45, 45, 210)
                pen = QPen(color, 3.0 if selected else 1.5)
                pen.setStyle(
                    Qt.PenStyle.SolidLine if selected else Qt.PenStyle.DashLine
                )
                painter.setPen(pen)
                rect = QRectF(x * sx, y * sy, width * sx, height * sy)
                painter.drawRect(rect)

                label = FIELD_LABELS.get(key, key)
                metrics = painter.fontMetrics()
                label_width = min(220.0, float(metrics.horizontalAdvance(label) + 10))
                label_height = float(metrics.height() + 4)
                label_rect = QRectF(
                    rect.left(),
                    max(0.0, rect.top() - label_height),
                    label_width,
                    label_height,
                )
                painter.fillRect(label_rect, QColor(255, 255, 255, 215))
                painter.setPen(color)
                painter.drawText(
                    label_rect.adjusted(4, 0, -2, 0),
                    int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter),
                    label,
                )
        finally:
            if painter.isActive():
                painter.end()
        return result

    def update_preview(self) -> None:
        try:
            image = self.renderer.render_preview_image(
                self._build_preview_data(),
                include_background=True,
                pixels_per_mm=5.0,
            )
            self._preview_image = self._draw_field_boxes(image)
        except Exception:
            self._preview_image = None
        self._refresh_preview_scene()

    def _refresh_preview_scene(self) -> None:
        manual_centre = None
        if not self._fit_zoom_mode:
            manual_centre = self.preview_view.mapToScene(
                self.preview_view.viewport().rect().center()
            )

        self.preview_scene.clear()
        if self._preview_image is None or self._preview_image.isNull():
            self.preview_scene.addText(
                "Не удалось сформировать предварительный просмотр."
            )
            self._schedule_preview_zoom()
            return
        pixmap = QPixmap.fromImage(self._preview_image)
        self.preview_scene.addPixmap(pixmap)
        self.preview_scene.setSceneRect(QRectF(pixmap.rect()))
        if self._fit_zoom_mode:
            self._schedule_preview_zoom()
        elif manual_centre is not None:
            QTimer.singleShot(
                0,
                lambda centre=manual_centre: self._restore_manual_centre(
                    centre
                ),
            )

    def _restore_manual_centre(self, centre) -> None:
        if self._fit_zoom_mode or self.preview_scene.sceneRect().isEmpty():
            return
        self.preview_view.centerOn(centre)

    def showEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().showEvent(event)
        QTimer.singleShot(0, self._ensure_window_inside_screen)
        if self._fit_zoom_mode:
            QTimer.singleShot(0, self._apply_preview_zoom)
            self._zoom_layout_timer.start()

    def resizeEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        if self._fit_zoom_mode:
            self._zoom_layout_timer.start()

    def document_control_values(self) -> tuple[int, str]:
        return (
            int(self.registration_number_length.value()),
            self.blank_number_prefix.text().strip(),
        )

    def reset_field_settings(self) -> None:
        for key, (x_spin, y_spin) in self.field_spins.items():
            x_spin.setValue(0.0)
            y_spin.setValue(0.0)
            (
                font_combo,
                size_spin,
                bold_box,
                italic_box,
                width_spin,
                height_spin,
            ) = self.field_style_controls[key]
            default = FIELD_STYLE_DEFAULTS[key]
            font_combo.setCurrentText(str(default["family"]))
            size_spin.setValue(float(default["size"]))
            bold_box.setChecked(bool(default["bold"]))
            italic_box.setChecked(bool(default["italic"]))
            width_spin.setValue(float(default["width_mm"]))
            height_spin.setValue(float(default["height_mm"]))
        full_name_default = FIELD_STYLE_DEFAULTS["full_name"]
        self.full_name_text_editor.setPlainText(
            str(full_name_default.get("text_template", "{full_name}"))
        )
        full_name_alignment_index = self.full_name_alignment.findData(
            str(full_name_default.get("alignment", "center"))
        )
        self.full_name_alignment.setCurrentIndex(
            full_name_alignment_index if full_name_alignment_index >= 0 else 1
        )
        self.full_name_editor_font.setCurrentText(
            str(full_name_default.get("family", "Times New Roman"))
        )
        self.full_name_editor_size.setValue(
            float(full_name_default.get("size", 20.5))
        )

        training_default = FIELD_STYLE_DEFAULTS["training_info"]
        self.training_text_editor.setPlainText(
            str(training_default.get("text_template", ""))
        )
        alignment_index = self.training_alignment.findData(
            str(training_default.get("alignment", "left"))
        )
        self.training_alignment.setCurrentIndex(
            alignment_index if alignment_index >= 0 else 0
        )
        self.training_editor_font.setCurrentText(
            str(training_default.get("family", "Times New Roman"))
        )
        self.training_editor_size.setValue(
            float(training_default.get("size", 12.0))
        )
        self._update_right_block_width_limits()
        self.schedule_preview_update()

    def export_individual_settings(self) -> None:
        offset_x, offset_y, field_offsets, field_styles = self.values()
        payload = {
            "format": "dpo-documents-print-settings",
            "version": 1,
            "template_key": str(self.template.get("template_key", "")),
            "template_name": str(self.template.get("template_name", "")),
            "offset_x_mm": offset_x,
            "offset_y_mm": offset_y,
            "field_offsets": field_offsets,
            "field_styles": field_styles,
        }
        default_name = "Настройки_печати_удостоверения.json"
        default_path = str(Path.home() / "Documents" / default_name)
        path, _selected_filter = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(
            self,
            "Сохранить индивидуальные настройки",
            default_path,
            "Файлы настроек JSON (*.json)",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        if not path.lower().endswith(".json"):
            path += ".json"
        try:
            Path(path).write_text(
                json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
        except OSError as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(
                self,
                "Сохранение настроек",
                f"Не удалось сохранить файл настроек:\n{exc}",
            )
            return
        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Сохранение настроек",
            f"Индивидуальные настройки сохранены:\n{path}",
        )

    def import_individual_settings(self) -> None:
        path, _selected_filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Загрузить индивидуальные настройки",
            str(Path.home() / "Documents"),
            "Файлы настроек JSON (*.json);;Все файлы (*.*)",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        try:
            payload = json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except (OSError, UnicodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Загрузка настроек",
                f"Не удалось прочитать файл настроек:\n{exc}",
            )
            return
        if not isinstance(payload, dict) or payload.get("format") != "dpo-documents-print-settings":
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Загрузка настроек",
                "Выбранный файл не является файлом индивидуальных настроек ДПО Документы.",
            )
            return
        try:
            self._apply_settings_payload(payload)
        except (TypeError, ValueError, KeyError) as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Загрузка настроек",
                f"Файл содержит некорректные значения:\n{exc}",
            )
            return
        self.schedule_preview_update()
        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "Загрузка настроек",
            "Индивидуальные настройки загружены. Нажмите «Сохранить», чтобы записать их в базу.",
        )

    def _apply_settings_payload(self, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        self.reset_field_settings()
        self.offset_x.setValue(float(payload.get("offset_x_mm", 0.0) or 0.0))
        self.offset_y.setValue(float(payload.get("offset_y_mm", 0.0) or 0.0))

        raw_offsets = payload.get("field_offsets", {})
        if isinstance(raw_offsets, dict):
            for key, value in raw_offsets.items():
                if key not in self.field_spins or not isinstance(value, dict):
                    continue
                x_spin, y_spin = self.field_spins[key]
                x_spin.setValue(float(value.get("x", 0.0) or 0.0))
                y_spin.setValue(float(value.get("y", 0.0) or 0.0))

        raw_styles = payload.get("field_styles", {})
        if isinstance(raw_styles, dict):
            for key, value in raw_styles.items():
                if key not in self.field_style_controls or not isinstance(value, dict):
                    continue
                default = FIELD_STYLE_DEFAULTS[key]
                (
                    font_combo,
                    size_spin,
                    bold_box,
                    italic_box,
                    width_spin,
                    height_spin,
                ) = self.field_style_controls[key]
                font_combo.setCurrentText(
                    str(value.get("family", default["family"]) or default["family"])
                )
                size_spin.setValue(
                    float(value.get("size", default["size"]) or default["size"])
                )
                bold_box.setChecked(bool(value.get("bold", default["bold"])))
                italic_box.setChecked(bool(value.get("italic", default["italic"])))
                width_spin.setValue(
                    float(value.get("width_mm", default["width_mm"]) or default["width_mm"])
                )
                height_spin.setValue(
                    float(value.get("height_mm", default["height_mm"]) or default["height_mm"])
                )
                if key == "full_name":
                    self.full_name_text_editor.setPlainText(
                        str(
                            value.get(
                                "text_template",
                                default.get("text_template", "{full_name}"),
                            )
                            or ""
                        )
                    )
                    alignment = str(
                        value.get(
                            "alignment", default.get("alignment", "center")
                        )
                        or "center"
                    )
                    alignment_index = self.full_name_alignment.findData(
                        alignment
                    )
                    self.full_name_alignment.setCurrentIndex(
                        alignment_index if alignment_index >= 0 else 1
                    )
                if key == "training_info":
                    self.training_text_editor.setPlainText(
                        str(value.get("text_template", default.get("text_template", "")) or "")
                    )
                    alignment = str(
                        value.get("alignment", default.get("alignment", "left")) or "left"
                    )
                    alignment_index = self.training_alignment.findData(alignment)
                    self.training_alignment.setCurrentIndex(
                        alignment_index if alignment_index >= 0 else 0
                    )

    def values(
        self,
    ) -> tuple[
        float,
        float,
        dict[str, dict[str, float]],
        dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    ]:
        field_offsets: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
        field_styles: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

        for key, (x_spin, y_spin) in self.field_spins.items():
            x = x_spin.value()
            y = y_spin.value()
            if x or y:
                field_offsets[key] = {"x": x, "y": y}

            (
                font_combo,
                size_spin,
                bold_box,
                italic_box,
                width_spin,
                height_spin,
            ) = self.field_style_controls[key]
            current: dict[str, Any] = {
                "family": font_combo.currentText().strip(),
                "size": size_spin.value(),
                "bold": bold_box.isChecked(),
                "italic": italic_box.isChecked(),
                "width_mm": width_spin.value(),
                "height_mm": height_spin.value(),
            }
            default = FIELD_STYLE_DEFAULTS[key]
            differs = any(
                (
                    current["family"] != default["family"],
                    abs(float(current["size"]) - float(default["size"])) > 0.001,
                    bool(current["bold"]) != bool(default["bold"]),
                    bool(current["italic"]) != bool(default["italic"]),
                    abs(float(current["width_mm"]) - float(default["width_mm"])) > 0.001,
                    abs(float(current["height_mm"]) - float(default["height_mm"])) > 0.001,
                )
            )
            if key == "full_name":
                current["text_template"] = self.full_name_text_editor.toPlainText()
                current["alignment"] = str(
                    self.full_name_alignment.currentData() or "center"
                )
                differs = differs or (
                    current["text_template"]
                    != str(default.get("text_template", "{full_name}"))
                    or current["alignment"]
                    != str(default.get("alignment", "center"))
                )
            if key == "training_info":
                current["text_template"] = self.training_text_editor.toPlainText()
                current["alignment"] = str(
                    self.training_alignment.currentData() or "left"
                )
                differs = differs or (
                    current["text_template"]
                    != str(default.get("text_template", ""))
                    or current["alignment"]
                    != str(default.get("alignment", "left"))
                )
            if differs:
                field_styles[key] = current

        return (
            self.offset_x.value(),
            self.offset_y.value(),
            field_offsets,
            field_styles,
        )


class PrintTemplatesDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, database: Database, parent=None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.database = database
        self.setWindowTitle("Справочник шаблонов")
        self.setModal(True)
        self.resize(980, 440)

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 6)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            [
                "Название",
                "Вид документа",
                "Размер",
                "Общий X",
                "Общий Y",
                "Настроено полей",
            ]
        )
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(
            QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows
        )
        self.table.setSelectionMode(
            QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection
        )
        self.table.setEditTriggers(
            QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers
        )
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setStretchLastSection(False)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        for column in range(1, 6):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(
                column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents
            )

        self.create_button = QPushButton("Создать шаблон")
        self.create_button.setToolTip(
            "Создать копию выбранного шаблона с отдельными настройками"
        )
        self.create_button.clicked.connect(self.create_template)

        self.rename_button = QPushButton("Переименовать")
        self.rename_button.setToolTip(
            "Изменить название выбранного пользовательского шаблона"
        )
        self.rename_button.clicked.connect(self.rename_selected_template)

        self.calibrate_button = QPushButton("Калибровка печатных полей")
        self.calibrate_button.clicked.connect(self.calibrate_selected)
        self.table.doubleClicked.connect(self.calibrate_selected)

        self.delete_button = QPushButton("Удалить")
        self.delete_button.setToolTip("Удалить выбранный пользовательский шаблон")
        self.delete_button.clicked.connect(self.delete_selected_template)

        action_row = QHBoxLayout()
        action_row.addWidget(self.create_button)
        action_row.addWidget(self.rename_button)
        action_row.addWidget(self.calibrate_button)
        action_row.addWidget(self.delete_button)
        action_row.addStretch(1)

        note = QLabel(
            "Для каждого шаблона можно настроить положение, шрифт, размер, "
            "начертание и границы каждого печатаемого элемента. Настройки "
            "применяются к предварительному просмотру, PDF и печати."
        )
        note.setWordWrap(True)

        buttons = QDialogButtonBox(
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Close
        )
        buttons.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Close).setText(
            "Закрыть"
        )
        buttons.rejected.connect(self.reject)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addWidget(note)
        layout.addLayout(action_row)
        layout.addWidget(self.table)
        layout.addWidget(buttons)

        self.load_templates()

    def load_templates(self, selected_template_id: int | None = None) -> None:
        rows = self.database.list_print_templates()
        self.table.setRowCount(len(rows))
        selected_row = 0
        for row_index, record in enumerate(rows):
            if (
                selected_template_id is not None
                and int(record["id"]) == int(selected_template_id)
            ):
                selected_row = row_index
            configured_keys = (
                set(parse_field_offsets(record["field_offsets_json"]).keys())
                | set(parse_field_styles(record["field_styles_json"]).keys())
            )
            configured_keys.difference_update(
                {
                    "__qualification_layouts__",
                    "__selected_qualification__",
                    "__selected_professional_area__",
                }
            )
            configured_count = len(configured_keys)
            values = [
                str(record["template_name"] or ""),
                str(record["document_type"] or ""),
                f'{float(record["page_width_mm"]):g} × '
                f'{float(record["page_height_mm"]):g} мм',
                f'{float(record["offset_x_mm"]):.1f} мм',
                f'{float(record["offset_y_mm"]):.1f} мм',
                str(configured_count),
            ]
            for column, value in enumerate(values):
                item = QTableWidgetItem(value)
                if column == 0:
                    item.setData(
                        Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, int(record["id"])
                    )
                if column >= 2:
                    item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
                self.table.setItem(row_index, column, item)
        if rows:
            self.table.selectRow(selected_row)
            item = self.table.item(selected_row, 0)
            if item is not None:
                self.table.scrollToItem(item)

    def create_template(self) -> None:
        source_template_id = self.selected_template_id()
        if source_template_id is None:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Справочник шаблонов",
                "Выберите шаблон, на основе которого нужно создать новый.",
            )
            return
        source = self.database.get_print_template(source_template_id)
        if source is None:
            return

        suggested_name = f'{str(source["template_name"] or "Шаблон")} — копия'
        template_name, accepted = QInputDialog.getText(
            self,
            "Создать шаблон",
            "Название нового шаблона:",
            text=suggested_name,
        )
        if not accepted:
            return
        template_name = str(template_name or "").strip()
        if not template_name:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Создать шаблон",
                "Введите название шаблона.",
            )
            return
        try:
            new_template_id = self.database.create_print_template_copy(
                source_template_id,
                template_name,
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Создать шаблон", str(exc))
            return
        self.load_templates(new_template_id)

    def rename_selected_template(self) -> None:
        template_id = self.selected_template_id()
        if template_id is None:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Справочник шаблонов",
                "Выберите шаблон, который нужно переименовать.",
            )
            return
        record = self.database.get_print_template(template_id)
        if record is None:
            return
        if bool(record["built_in"]):
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Переименование шаблона",
                "Название встроенного общего шаблона изменить нельзя.",
            )
            return

        current_name = str(record["template_name"] or "Шаблон")
        template_name, accepted = QInputDialog.getText(
            self,
            "Переименовать шаблон",
            "Новое название шаблона:",
            text=current_name,
        )
        if not accepted:
            return
        try:
            self.database.rename_print_template(
                template_id,
                str(template_name or ""),
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Переименование шаблона", str(exc))
            return
        self.load_templates(template_id)

    def delete_selected_template(self) -> None:
        template_id = self.selected_template_id()
        if template_id is None:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Справочник шаблонов",
                "Выберите шаблон, который нужно удалить.",
            )
            return
        record = self.database.get_print_template(template_id)
        if record is None:
            return
        template_name = str(record["template_name"] or "Шаблон")
        if bool(record["built_in"]):
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Удаление шаблона",
                "Встроенный шаблон удалить нельзя.",
            )
            return

        answer = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            "Удаление шаблона",
            f'Удалить шаблон «{template_name}»?\n\n'
            "Это действие нельзя отменить.",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
        )
        if answer != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        try:
            self.database.delete_print_template(template_id)
        except ValueError as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Удаление шаблона", str(exc))
            return
        self.load_templates()

    def selected_template_id(self) -> int | None:
        row = self.table.currentRow()
        if row < 0:
            return None
        item = self.table.item(row, 0)
        if item is None:
            return None
        return int(item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole))

    def calibrate_selected(self) -> None:
        template_id = self.selected_template_id()
        if template_id is None:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Шаблоны", "Выберите шаблон.")
            return
        record = self.database.get_print_template(template_id)
        if record is None:
            return
        if str(record["document_type"] or "").strip() == "Диплом о профессиональной переподготовке":
            show_independent_window(
                ("diploma_calibration", template_id),
                lambda: DiplomaTemplateCalibrationDialog(
                    dict(record),
                    self.database,
                    None,
                ),
                on_closed=lambda: self.load_templates(template_id),
                maximize_on_first_show=True,
            )
            return

        def save_calibration(dialog: TemplateCalibrationDialog, result: int) -> None:
            if result != int(QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted):
                return
            x, y, field_offsets, field_styles = dialog.values()
            registration_length, blank_prefix = dialog.document_control_values()
            try:
                self.database.update_print_template_number_settings(
                    template_id,
                    registration_number_length=registration_length,
                    blank_number_prefix=blank_prefix,
                )
                self.database.update_print_template_calibration(
                    template_id,
                    x,
                    y,
                    field_offsets,
                    field_styles,
                )
            except ValueError as exc:
                QMessageBox.warning(self, "Калибровка", str(exc))
                return
            self.load_templates(template_id)

        show_independent_window(
            ("certificate_calibration", template_id),
            lambda: TemplateCalibrationDialog(dict(record), self.database, None),
            on_finished=save_calibration,
            maximize_on_first_show=True,
        )

    def reset_selected(self) -> None:
        template_id = self.selected_template_id()
        if template_id is None:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Шаблоны", "Выберите шаблон.")
            return
        answer = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            "Сброс калибровки",
            "Сбросить общий сдвиг и все индивидуальные настройки полей?",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes
            | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
        )
        if answer != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        self.database.reset_print_template_calibration(template_id)
        self.load_templates()

        self.hash_label.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse)
        self.hash_label.setWordWrap(True)

        info_form = QFormLayout()
        info_form.addRow("Дата создания", self.created_label)
        info_form.addRow("Версия программы", self.version_label)
        info_form.addRow("Тип копии", self.format_label)
        info_form.addRow("Версия структуры базы", self.schema_label)
        info_form.addRow("Записей обучающихся", self.records_label)
        info_form.addRow("Курсов в справочнике", self.courses_label)
        info_form.addRow("Пройденных курсов", self.student_courses_label)
        info_form.addRow("Документов в журнале", self.documents_label)
        info_form.addRow("Почтовых отправлений", self.shipments_label)
        info_form.addRow("Размер базы", self.size_label)
        info_form.addRow("SHA-256 базы", self.hash_label)

        info_group = QGroupBox("Результат проверки")
        info_layout = QVBoxLayout(info_group)
        info_layout.addWidget(self.state_label)
        info_layout.addLayout(info_form)

        warning = QLabel(
            "Восстановление заменит текущую рабочую базу данными из выбранной "
            "копии и, если они есть в копии нового формата, восстановит шаблон "
            "ФИС ФРДО, пользовательские шрифты и несекретные настройки. "
            "Пароли и токены не заменяются. Защитная копия текущего состояния "
            "будет сохранена в папке DPO_Documents_Data\\Before_Restore_Backups."
        )
        warning.setWordWrap(True)
        warning.setStyleSheet("font-weight: 600;")

        self.buttons = QDialogButtonBox(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel)
        self.restore_button = self.buttons.addButton(
            "Восстановить базу",
            QDialogButtonBox.ButtonRole.AcceptRole,
        )
        self.restore_button.setEnabled(False)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addWidget(intro)
        layout.addWidget(source_group)
        layout.addWidget(info_group)
        layout.addWidget(warning)
        layout.addStretch(1)
        layout.addWidget(self.buttons)

        self.browse_button.clicked.connect(self._browse)
        self.check_button.clicked.connect(self._inspect)
        self.restore_button.clicked.connect(self._restore)
        self.buttons.rejected.connect(self.reject)
        self.show_password.toggled.connect(self._toggle_password)
        self.file_edit.textChanged.connect(self._invalidate_inspection)
        self.password_edit.textChanged.connect(self._invalidate_inspection)

    def _browse(self) -> None:
        start = self.file_edit.text().strip()
        if start:
            start_path = Path(start).expanduser()
            if start_path.is_file():
                start = str(start_path.parent)
        else:
            local_backups = self.manager.data_dir / "Backups"
            start = str(local_backups if local_backups.exists() else Path.home())

        selected, _ = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Выберите резервную копию",
            start,
            "Резервные копии ДПО (*.dpo-backup *.zip);;"
            "Зашифрованные копии (*.dpo-backup);;"
            "Старые ZIP-копии (*.zip);;Все файлы (*.*)",
        )
        if selected:
            self.file_edit.setText(selected)

    def _toggle_password(self, visible: bool) -> None:
        self.password_edit.setEchoMode(
            QLineEdit.EchoMode.Normal if visible else QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password
        )

    def _invalidate_inspection(self) -> None:
        self._inspection = None
        self._inspection_signature = None
        self.restore_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.state_label.setText("Копия ещё не проверена.")
        for label in (
            self.created_label,
            self.version_label,
            self.format_label,
            self.schema_label,
            self.records_label,
            self.courses_label,
            self.student_courses_label,
            self.documents_label,
            self.shipments_label,
            self.size_label,
            self.hash_label,
        ):
            label.setText("—")

    def _inspect(self) -> None:
        source = Path(self.file_edit.text().strip()).expanduser()
        if not self.file_edit.text().strip():
            QMessageBox.information(self, "Проверка копии", "Выберите файл копии.")
            return
        if not source.exists() or not source.is_file():
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Проверка копии", "Выбранный файл не найден.")
            return

        password = self.password_edit.text()
        self._set_busy(True, "Проверяется резервная копия…")
        try:
            inspection = self.manager.inspect_backup(source, password)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.state_label.setText("Проверка не пройдена.")
            QMessageBox.critical(
                self,
                "Резервная копия не прошла проверку",
                str(exc),
            )
            return
        finally:
            self._set_busy(False)

        self._inspection = inspection
        self._inspection_signature = (str(source), password)
        self.restore_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.state_label.setText(
            "Копия успешно расшифрована и проверена. База SQLite целостна."
        )
        self.created_label.setText(self._format_datetime(inspection.created_at))
        self.version_label.setText(inspection.application_version or "Не указана")
        self.format_label.setText(
            "Зашифрованная AES-256-GCM"
            if inspection.encrypted
            else "Старая незашифрованная ZIP-копия"
        )
        self.schema_label.setText(
            str(inspection.database_schema_version)
            if inspection.database_schema_version > 0
            else "Не указана (старая копия)"
        )
        self.records_label.setText(str(inspection.student_count))
        self.courses_label.setText(str(inspection.course_count))
        self.student_courses_label.setText(str(inspection.student_course_count))
        self.documents_label.setText(str(inspection.issued_document_count))
        self.shipments_label.setText(str(inspection.postal_shipment_count))
        self.size_label.setText(self._format_size(inspection.database_size))
        self.hash_label.setText(inspection.database_sha256)

    def _restore(self) -> None:
        source_text = self.file_edit.text().strip()
        password = self.password_edit.text()
        signature = (str(Path(source_text).expanduser()), password)
        if self._inspection is None or self._inspection_signature != signature:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Восстановление",
                "После изменения файла или пароля нужно снова проверить копию.",
            )
            return

        confirmation = QMessageBox(self)
        confirmation.setIcon(QMessageBox.Icon.Warning)
        confirmation.setWindowTitle("Подтверждение восстановления")
        confirmation.setText("Заменить текущие данные выбранной резервной копией?")
        confirmation.setInformativeText(
            f"В копии: {self._inspection.student_count} записей.\n"
            f"Дата копии: {self._format_datetime(self._inspection.created_at)}.\n\n"
            "Перед заменой программа создаст зашифрованную защитную копию "
            "текущей базы и несекретной конфигурации. Пароли и токены останутся "
            "на этом компьютере без изменений. Во время операции не закрывайте "
            "программу и не выключайте компьютер."
        )
        restore_button = confirmation.addButton(
            "Восстановить",
            QMessageBox.ButtonRole.AcceptRole,
        )
        cancel_button = confirmation.addButton(
            "Отмена",
            QMessageBox.ButtonRole.RejectRole,
        )
        confirmation.setDefaultButton(cancel_button)
        confirmation.exec()
        if confirmation.clickedButton() is not restore_button:
            return

        self._set_busy(True, "Восстанавливается база данных…")
        try:
            report = self.manager.restore_database(
                Path(source_text).expanduser(),
                password,
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(
                self,
                "Восстановление не выполнено",
                "Рабочая база не была заменена либо была автоматически возвращена "
                "в исходное состояние.\n\n" + str(exc),
            )
            return
        finally:
            self._set_busy(False)

        self.restore_report = report
        QMessageBox.information(
            self,
            "База данных восстановлена",
            "Восстановление завершено успешно.\n\n"
            f"Записей было: {report.student_count_before}\n"
            f"Записей стало: {report.student_count_after}\n\n"
            "Защитная копия прежней базы:\n"
            f"{report.safety_backup_file}\n\n"
            "Для защитной копии используется тот же пароль, что и для выбранной "
            "зашифрованной копии. При восстановлении старого ZIP используется "
            "пароль из настроек резервного копирования.\n\n"
            "Шаблон ФИС ФРДО и пользовательские шрифты из новой копии восстановлены "
            "в DPO_Documents_Data. Чтобы заново загрузить восстановленные шрифты, "
            "перезапустите программу. Пароли и токены резервная копия не содержит.",
        )
        self.accept()

    def _set_busy(self, busy: bool, status: str = "") -> None:
        for widget in (
            self.file_edit,
            self.browse_button,
            self.password_edit,
            self.show_password,
            self.check_button,
            self.restore_button,
        ):
            widget.setEnabled(not busy)
        if busy:
            QApplication.setOverrideCursor(Qt.CursorShape.WaitCursor)
            if status:
                self.state_label.setText(status)
            QApplication.processEvents()
        else:
            QApplication.restoreOverrideCursor()
            self.restore_button.setEnabled(self._inspection is not None)

    @staticmethod
    def _format_datetime(value: str) -> str:
        if not value:
            return "Не указана"
        try:
            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
            return parsed.astimezone().strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S")
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            return value

    @staticmethod
    def _format_size(value: int) -> str:
        size = float(value)
        units = ("байт", "КБ", "МБ", "ГБ")
        unit = units[0]
        for unit in units:
            if size < 1024 or unit == units[-1]:
                break
            size /= 1024
        if unit == "байт":
            return f"{int(size)} {unit}"
        return f"{size:.2f} {unit}"

from __future__ import annotations

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QCheckBox,
    QDialog,
    QDialogButtonBox,
    QFormLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,

from dpo_app.russian_post import RussianPostError, RussianPostManager
from dpo_app.secret_store import SecretProtectionError


class RussianPostSettingsDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(
        self,
        manager: RussianPostManager,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.manager = manager
        self.setWindowTitle("Доступ к API Почты России")
        self.setMinimumWidth(620)

        intro = QLabel(
            "Для прямой проверки статусов программа использует официальный API "
            "Сервиса отслеживания Почты России. Логин и пароль выдаются после "
            "регистрации на tracking.pochta.ru в разделе «Настройки доступа»."
        )
        intro.setWordWrap(True)

        settings = manager.load_settings()
        self.login = QLineEdit(settings.login)
        self.login.setPlaceholderText("Логин API")
        self.password = QLineEdit()
        self.password.setEchoMode(QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password)
        try:
            has_password = manager.secrets.has("russian_post_tracking_password")
        except SecretProtectionError:
            has_password = False
        self.password.setPlaceholderText(
            "Пароль уже сохранён — оставьте пустым"
            if has_password
            else "Пароль API"
        )
        show = QCheckBox("Показывать пароль")
        show.toggled.connect(
            lambda visible: self.password.setEchoMode(
                QLineEdit.EchoMode.Normal if visible else QLineEdit.EchoMode.Password
            )
        )

        form = QFormLayout()
        form.addRow("Логин", self.login)
        form.addRow("Пароль", self.password)
        form.addRow("", show)

        warning = QLabel(
            "Пароль сохраняется в зашифрованном виде средствами Windows DPAPI и "
            "доступен только текущей учётной записи Windows."
        )
        warning.setWordWrap(True)
        warning.setStyleSheet("color: #555;")

        buttons = QDialogButtonBox(
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Save
            | QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel
        )
        buttons.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Save).setText("Сохранить")
        buttons.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel).setText("Отмена")
        clear = QPushButton("Удалить доступ")
        buttons.addButton(clear, QDialogButtonBox.ButtonRole.DestructiveRole)
        clear.clicked.connect(self._clear)
        buttons.accepted.connect(self._save)
        buttons.rejected.connect(self.reject)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addWidget(intro)
        layout.addLayout(form)
        layout.addWidget(warning)
        layout.addWidget(buttons)

    def _save(self) -> None:
        try:
            self.manager.save_credentials(
                self.login.text(),
                self.password.text() or None,
            )
        except (RussianPostError, SecretProtectionError, OSError) as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "API Почты России", str(exc))
            return
        self.accept()

    def _clear(self) -> None:
        answer = QMessageBox.question(
            self,
            "Удаление доступа",
            "Удалить сохранённые логин и пароль API Почты России?",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
        )
        if answer != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        try:
            self.manager.clear_credentials()
        except (SecretProtectionError, OSError) as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "API Почты России", str(exc))
            return
        self.login.clear()
        self.password.clear()
        self.password.setPlaceholderText("Пароль API")
        QMessageBox.information(self, "API Почты России", "Сохранённый доступ удалён.")

from __future__ import annotations

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QCheckBox,
    QDialog,
    QGridLayout,
    QGroupBox,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)


class SearchDialog(QDialog):
    """Compact search dialog with selectable student registry columns."""

    CRITERIA = [
        ("last_name", "Фамилия"),
        ("first_name", "Имя"),
        ("middle_name", "Отчество"),
        ("birth_date", "Дата рождения"),
        ("snils", "СНИЛС"),
        ("phone", "Телефон"),
        ("email", "E-mail"),
        ("track_number", "Трек-номер"),
        ("created_at", "Дата добавления"),
    ]

    def __init__(
        self,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
        *,
        query: str = "",
        selected_fields: set[str] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle("Поиск обучающихся")
        self.setModal(True)
        self.setMinimumWidth(500)
        self.setMaximumWidth(620)

        chosen = set(selected_fields or {"last_name", "track_number"})
        if not chosen:
            chosen = {"last_name", "track_number"}

        self.query_edit = QLineEdit(str(query or ""))
        self.query_edit.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.query_edit.setPlaceholderText("Введите текст, дату, СНИЛС или другой критерий")

        query_row = QHBoxLayout()
        query_row.addWidget(QLabel("Искать:"))
        query_row.addWidget(self.query_edit, 1)

        criteria_box = QGroupBox("Критерии поиска")
        criteria_layout = QGridLayout(criteria_box)
        self.checkboxes: dict[str, QCheckBox] = {}
        for index, (field_name, label) in enumerate(self.CRITERIA):
            checkbox = QCheckBox(label)
            checkbox.setChecked(field_name in chosen)
            self.checkboxes[field_name] = checkbox
            criteria_layout.addWidget(checkbox, index // 3, index % 3)

        hint = QLabel(
            "Отметьте один или несколько столбцов. Поиск найдёт строки, в которых "
            "введённое значение встречается хотя бы в одном выбранном столбце."
        )
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        hint.setStyleSheet("color: palette(mid);")

        self.find_button = QPushButton("Найти")
        self.find_button.setDefault(True)
        self.clear_button = QPushButton("Сбросить поиск")
        self.cancel_button = QPushButton("Отмена")

        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        buttons.addStretch(1)
        buttons.addWidget(self.clear_button)
        buttons.addWidget(self.find_button)
        buttons.addWidget(self.cancel_button)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addLayout(query_row)
        layout.addWidget(criteria_box)
        layout.addWidget(hint)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)

        self.find_button.clicked.connect(self._accept_search)
        self.clear_button.clicked.connect(self._clear_search)
        self.cancel_button.clicked.connect(self.reject)
        self.query_edit.returnPressed.connect(self._accept_search)

        self.query_edit.setFocus(Qt.FocusReason.ShortcutFocusReason)
        self.query_edit.selectAll()
        self.adjustSize()

    def _accept_search(self) -> None:
        if not self.selected_fields():
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Критерии поиска",
                "Отметьте хотя бы один критерий поиска.",
            )
            return
        self.accept()

    def _clear_search(self) -> None:
        self.query_edit.clear()
        for field_name, checkbox in self.checkboxes.items():
            checkbox.setChecked(field_name in {"last_name", "track_number"})
        self.accept()

    def query(self) -> str:
        return self.query_edit.text().strip()

    def selected_fields(self) -> set[str]:
        return {
            field_name
            for field_name, checkbox in self.checkboxes.items()
            if checkbox.isChecked()
        }

    @classmethod
    def label_for(cls, field_name: str) -> str:
        return dict(cls.CRITERIA).get(field_name, field_name)

from __future__ import annotations

"""Advisory red-wave spelling marks for editable text controls."""

import re
from typing import Iterable

from PySide6.QtCore import QEvent, QObject, QPointF, Qt, QTimer
from PySide6.QtGui import (
    QAction,

    QLineEdit,
