from dpo_app.spellcheck_engine import SpellingRange, WindowsSpellChecker


_NAME_LABEL_PATTERNS = (
    "фио",
    "ф и о",
    "фамилия",
    "отчество",
    "руководитель",
    "секретарь",
    "председатель комиссии",
)
_NAME_OBJECT_NAMES = {
    "last_name",
    "first_name",
    "middle_name",
    "fio",
    "full_name",
    "director_name",
    "secretary_name",
    "chairman_name",
}


def _normalize_label(value: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(re.sub(r"[^0-9a-zа-яё]+", " ", str(value or "").casefold()).split())


def _ancestor_is(widget: QWidget, klass) -> bool:
    parent = widget.parentWidget()
    while parent is not None:
        if isinstance(parent, klass):
            return True
        parent = parent.parentWidget()
    return False


def _form_label(widget: QWidget) -> str:
    current: QWidget | None = widget
    while current is not None:
        parent = current.parentWidget()
        if parent is None:
            break
        layout = parent.layout()
        if isinstance(layout, QFormLayout):
            try:
                label = layout.labelForField(current)
            except Exception:
                label = None
            if label is not None and hasattr(label, "text"):
                return str(label.text() or "")
        current = parent
    return ""


def _is_name_field(widget: QWidget) -> bool:
    if bool(widget.property("spellcheck_exempt")):
        return True
    object_name = str(widget.objectName() or "").strip().casefold()
    if object_name in _NAME_OBJECT_NAMES:
        return True
    label = _normalize_label(_form_label(widget))
    if label == "имя" or label.startswith("имя "):
        return True
    if any(pattern in label for pattern in _NAME_LABEL_PATTERNS):
        return True
    if isinstance(widget, QLineEdit):
        placeholder = _normalize_label(widget.placeholderText())
        if placeholder in {"фио", "ф и о", "фамилия", "имя", "отчество"}:
            return True
        if "фио" in placeholder or "ф и о" in placeholder:
            return True
    return False


def _eligible(widget: QWidget) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(widget, (QLineEdit, QTextEdit, QPlainTextEdit)):
        return False
    if isinstance(widget, QLineEdit):
        if widget.echoMode() != QLineEdit.EchoMode.Normal:
            return False
        if isinstance(widget.parentWidget(), QAbstractSpinBox):
            return False
    if bool(getattr(widget, "isReadOnly", lambda: False)()):
        return False
    if _is_name_field(widget):
        return False
    return True


def _misspelled_word_at(
    engine: WindowsSpellChecker, text: str, position: int
) -> str | None:
    found = engine.word_at(text, position)
    if found is None:
        return None
    word, _word_range = found
    if engine.is_correct(word):
        return None
    return word


def _add_dictionary_action(
    menu: QMenu,
    engine: WindowsSpellChecker,
    word: str,
    on_added,
) -> QAction:
    action = QAction("Добавить в словарь", menu)

    def add_word(_checked: bool = False) -> None:
        if engine.add_to_user_dictionary(word):
            on_added()

    action.triggered.connect(add_word)
    actions = menu.actions()
    if actions:
        first = actions[0]
        menu.insertAction(first, action)
        menu.insertSeparator(first)
    else:
        menu.addAction(action)
    return action


def _show_dictionary_context_menu(
    widget: QWidget,
    event,
    engine: WindowsSpellChecker,
    word: str,
    on_added,
) -> None:
    menu = widget.createStandardContextMenu()
    _add_dictionary_action(menu, engine, word, on_added)
    menu.exec(event.globalPos())
    menu.deleteLater()


class _LineWaveOverlay(QWidget):
    def __init__(self, edit: QLineEdit, engine: WindowsSpellChecker) -> None:
        super().__init__(edit)
        self.edit = edit
        self.engine = engine
        self.ranges: list[SpellingRange] = []
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_NoSystemBackground, True)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TranslucentBackground, True)
        self.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus)
        self.setGeometry(edit.rect())
        self.show()
        self.raise_()

    def set_ranges(self, ranges: Iterable[SpellingRange]) -> None:
        self.ranges = list(ranges)
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - Qt override
        if not self.ranges or not self.edit.text():
            return
        text = self.edit.text()
        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing, True)
        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(220, 0, 0), 1.0))
        metrics = QFontMetrics(self.edit.font())

        try:
            option = QStyleOptionFrame()
            self.edit.initStyleOption(option)
            contents = self.edit.style().subElementRect(
                QStyle.SubElement.SE_LineEditContents, option, self.edit
            )
        except Exception:
            contents = self.edit.rect().adjusted(4, 1, -4, -1)
        margins = self.edit.textMargins()
        contents = contents.adjusted(
            margins.left(), margins.top(), -margins.right(), -margins.bottom()
        )
        total_width = metrics.horizontalAdvance(text)
        alignment = self.edit.alignment()
        if alignment & Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignHCenter:
            text_x = contents.left() + max(0.0, (contents.width() - total_width) / 2.0)
        elif alignment & Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight:
            text_x = contents.right() - total_width
        else:
            text_x = float(contents.left())

        if total_width > contents.width():
            before_cursor = metrics.horizontalAdvance(text[: self.edit.cursorPosition()])
            max_scroll = max(0.0, float(total_width - contents.width() + 3))
            scroll = min(max_scroll, max(0.0, float(before_cursor - contents.width() + 6)))
            text_x -= scroll

        baseline = contents.center().y() + (metrics.ascent() - metrics.descent()) / 2.0
        wave_y = min(float(contents.bottom() - 1), baseline + 2.0)
        left_clip = float(contents.left())
        right_clip = float(contents.right())
        for item in self.ranges:
            start = max(0, min(len(text), int(item.start)))
            end = max(start, min(len(text), start + int(item.length)))
            x1 = text_x + metrics.horizontalAdvance(text[:start])
            x2 = x1 + metrics.horizontalAdvance(text[start:end])
            x1 = max(x1, left_clip)
            x2 = min(x2, right_clip)
            if x2 <= x1:
                continue
            path = QPainterPath(QPointF(x1, wave_y))
            x = x1
            direction = -1.0
            while x < x2:
                x = min(x + 2.0, x2)
                path.lineTo(QPointF(x, wave_y + direction))
                direction *= -1.0
            painter.drawPath(path)
        painter.end()


class _LineSpellController(QObject):
    def __init__(self, edit: QLineEdit, engine: WindowsSpellChecker) -> None:
        super().__init__(edit)
        self.edit = edit
        self.engine = engine
        self.overlay = _LineWaveOverlay(edit, engine)
        self.timer = QTimer(self)
        self.timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self.timer.setInterval(280)
        self.timer.timeout.connect(self.refresh)
        edit.textChanged.connect(self.schedule)
        edit.cursorPositionChanged.connect(lambda *_: self.overlay.update())
        edit.installEventFilter(self)
        self.schedule()

    def schedule(self, *_args) -> None:
        self.timer.start()

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        self.overlay.set_ranges(self.engine.error_ranges(self.edit.text()))
        self.overlay.raise_()

    def eventFilter(self, obj, event):  # noqa: N802 - Qt override
        if event.type() == QEvent.Type.ContextMenu:
            position = self.edit.cursorPositionAt(event.pos())
            word = _misspelled_word_at(self.engine, self.edit.text(), position)
            if word is not None:
                _show_dictionary_context_menu(
                    self.edit, event, self.engine, word, self.refresh
                )
                return True
        if event.type() in {
            QEvent.Type.Resize,
            QEvent.Type.Move,
            QEvent.Type.Show,
            QEvent.Type.FontChange,
            QEvent.Type.StyleChange,
        }:
            self.overlay.setGeometry(self.edit.rect())
            self.overlay.raise_()
            self.overlay.update()
        return False


class _DocumentSpellHighlighter(QSyntaxHighlighter):
    def __init__(self, document, engine: WindowsSpellChecker) -> None:
        super().__init__(document)
        self.engine = engine
        self.error_format = QTextCharFormat()
        self.error_format.setUnderlineStyle(QTextCharFormat.UnderlineStyle.WaveUnderline)
        self.error_format.setUnderlineColor(QColor(220, 0, 0))

    def highlightBlock(self, text: str) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - Qt override
        for item in self.engine.error_ranges(text):
            self.setFormat(item.start, item.length, self.error_format)


class _DocumentSpellController(QObject):
    def __init__(
        self, edit: QTextEdit | QPlainTextEdit, engine: WindowsSpellChecker
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(edit)
        self.edit = edit
        self.engine = engine
        self.highlighter = _DocumentSpellHighlighter(edit.document(), engine)
        edit.viewport().installEventFilter(self)

    def refresh(self) -> None:
        self.highlighter.rehighlight()

    def eventFilter(self, obj, event):  # noqa: N802 - Qt override
        if event.type() != QEvent.Type.ContextMenu:
            return False
        cursor = self.edit.cursorForPosition(event.pos())
        word = _misspelled_word_at(
            self.engine, self.edit.toPlainText(), cursor.position()
        )
        if word is None:
            return False
        _show_dictionary_context_menu(
            self.edit, event, self.engine, word, self.refresh
        )
        return True


class SpellcheckItemDelegate(QStyledItemDelegate):
    """Paint advisory red waves for selected editable table columns."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        parent: QWidget | None = None,
        *,
        columns: set[int] | None = None,
        engine: WindowsSpellChecker | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.columns = set(columns) if columns is not None else None
        self.engine = engine or WindowsSpellChecker()
        self._owns_engine = engine is None
        self._view = parent if isinstance(parent, QAbstractItemView) else None
        if self._view is not None:
            self._view.viewport().installEventFilter(self)
        if self._owns_engine:
            self.destroyed.connect(lambda *_args: self.engine.close())

    @staticmethod
    def _wave_path(x1: float, x2: float, y: float) -> QPainterPath:
        path = QPainterPath(QPointF(x1, y))
        x = x1
        direction = -1.0
        while x < x2:
            x = min(x + 2.0, x2)
            path.lineTo(QPointF(x, y + direction))
            direction *= -1.0
        return path

    def _text_position_at(self, index, point) -> int | None:
        if self._view is None:
            return None
        option = QStyleOptionViewItem()
        option.initFrom(self._view)
        option.rect = self._view.visualRect(index)
        self.initStyleOption(option, index)
        style = self._view.style()
        text_rect = style.subElementRect(
            QStyle.SubElement.SE_ItemViewItemText, option, self._view
        )
        if not text_rect.contains(point):
            return None
        text = str(index.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole) or "")
        if not text:
            return None

        layout = QTextLayout(text, option.font)
        text_option = QTextOption()
        text_option.setAlignment(option.displayAlignment)
        if option.features & QStyleOptionViewItem.ViewItemFeature.WrapText:
            text_option.setWrapMode(QTextOption.WrapMode.WordWrap)
        else:
            text_option.setWrapMode(QTextOption.WrapMode.NoWrap)
        layout.setTextOption(text_option)

        lines = []
        total_height = 0.0
        layout.beginLayout()
        while True:
            line = layout.createLine()
            if not line.isValid():
                break
            line.setLineWidth(float(text_rect.width()))
            line.setPosition(QPointF(0.0, total_height))
            total_height += line.height()
            lines.append(line)
        layout.endLayout()
        if not lines:
            return None

        top = float(text_rect.top())
        if option.displayAlignment & Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter:
            top += max(0.0, (float(text_rect.height()) - total_height) / 2.0)
        elif option.displayAlignment & Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignBottom:
            top += max(0.0, float(text_rect.height()) - total_height)

        local_y = float(point.y()) - top
        chosen = lines[-1]
        for line in lines:
            if float(line.y()) <= local_y <= float(line.y() + line.height()):
                chosen = line
                break
        local_x = max(0.0, float(point.x() - text_rect.left()))
        return int(chosen.xToCursor(local_x))

    def eventFilter(self, obj, event):  # noqa: N802 - Qt override
        if (
            self._view is None
            or obj is not self._view.viewport()
            or event.type() != QEvent.Type.ContextMenu
        ):
            return False
        index = self._view.indexAt(event.pos())
        if not index.isValid():
            return False
        if self.columns is not None and index.column() not in self.columns:
            return False
        text = str(index.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole) or "")
        position = self._text_position_at(index, event.pos())
        if position is None:
            return False
        word = _misspelled_word_at(self.engine, text, position)
        if word is None:
            return False

        menu = QMenu(self._view)
        action = menu.addAction("Добавить в словарь")

        def add_word(_checked: bool = False) -> None:
            if self.engine.add_to_user_dictionary(word):
                self._view.viewport().update()

        action.triggered.connect(add_word)
        menu.exec(event.globalPos())
        menu.deleteLater()
        return True

    def paint(self, painter, option, index) -> None:  # noqa: N802 - Qt override
        super().paint(painter, option, index)
        if self.columns is not None and index.column() not in self.columns:
            return
        text = str(index.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole) or "")
        ranges = self.engine.error_ranges(text)
        if not ranges:
            return

        view_option = QStyleOptionViewItem(option)
        self.initStyleOption(view_option, index)
        style = view_option.widget.style() if view_option.widget is not None else QApplication.style()
        text_rect = style.subElementRect(
            QStyle.SubElement.SE_ItemViewItemText,
            view_option,
            view_option.widget,
        )
        if text_rect.width() <= 0 or text_rect.height() <= 0:
            return

        layout = QTextLayout(text, view_option.font)
        text_option = QTextOption()
        text_option.setAlignment(view_option.displayAlignment)
        if view_option.features & QStyleOptionViewItem.ViewItemFeature.WrapText:
            text_option.setWrapMode(QTextOption.WrapMode.WordWrap)
        else:
            text_option.setWrapMode(QTextOption.WrapMode.NoWrap)
        layout.setTextOption(text_option)

        lines = []
        total_height = 0.0
        layout.beginLayout()
        while True:
            line = layout.createLine()
            if not line.isValid():
                break
            line.setLineWidth(float(text_rect.width()))
            line.setPosition(QPointF(0.0, total_height))
            total_height += line.height()
            lines.append(line)
        layout.endLayout()
        if not lines:
            return

        top = float(text_rect.top())
        alignment = view_option.displayAlignment
        if alignment & Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter:
            top += max(0.0, (float(text_rect.height()) - total_height) / 2.0)
        elif alignment & Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignBottom:
            top += max(0.0, float(text_rect.height()) - total_height)

        painter.save()
        painter.setClipRect(text_rect)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing, True)
        painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(220, 0, 0), 1.0))
        for item in ranges:
            error_start = max(0, int(item.start))
            error_end = min(len(text), error_start + int(item.length))
            for line in lines:
                line_start = int(line.textStart())
                line_end = line_start + int(line.textLength())
                start = max(error_start, line_start)
                end = min(error_end, line_end)
                if end <= start:
                    continue
                x1 = float(text_rect.left()) + float(line.cursorToX(start))
                x2 = float(text_rect.left()) + float(line.cursorToX(end))
                if x2 < x1:
                    x1, x2 = x2, x1
                x1 = max(x1, float(text_rect.left()))
                x2 = min(x2, float(text_rect.right()))
                if x2 <= x1:
                    continue
                y = min(
                    float(text_rect.bottom() - 1),
                    top + float(line.y()) + float(line.ascent()) + 2.0,
                )
                painter.drawPath(self._wave_path(x1, x2, y))
        painter.restore()


class ApplicationSpellcheckManager(QObject):
    """Attach advisory spell checking to text fields created anywhere in the app."""

    def __init__(self, app: QApplication) -> None:
        super().__init__(app)
        self.app = app
        self.engine = WindowsSpellChecker()
        self._attached_ids: set[int] = set()
        self._controllers: dict[int, QObject] = {}
        app.installEventFilter(self)
        app.aboutToQuit.connect(self.engine.close)

    def _attach(self, widget: QWidget) -> None:
        widget_id = id(widget)
        if widget_id in self._attached_ids or not _eligible(widget):
            return
        self._attached_ids.add(widget_id)
        if isinstance(widget, QLineEdit):
            controller: QObject = _LineSpellController(widget, self.engine)
        else:
            controller = _DocumentSpellController(widget, self.engine)
        self._controllers[widget_id] = controller

        def cleanup(*_args, key=widget_id) -> None:
            self._attached_ids.discard(key)
            self._controllers.pop(key, None)

        widget.destroyed.connect(cleanup)

    def eventFilter(self, obj, event):  # noqa: N802 - Qt override
        if isinstance(obj, (QLineEdit, QTextEdit, QPlainTextEdit)) and event.type() in {
            QEvent.Type.Show,
            QEvent.Type.FocusIn,
        }:
            self._attach(obj)
        return False


__all__ = ["ApplicationSpellcheckManager", "SpellcheckItemDelegate"]

def format_date_digits(digits: str) -> str:
    """Format up to eight digits as DD.MM.YYYY while the user types."""
    digits = "".join(character for character in digits if character.isdigit())[:8]
    parts: list[str] = []
    if digits:
        parts.append(digits[:2])
    if len(digits) > 2:
        parts.append(digits[2:4])
    if len(digits) > 4:
        parts.append(digits[4:8])
    return ".".join(parts)


def format_snils_digits(digits: str) -> str:
    """Format up to eleven digits as 000-000-000 00 while the user types."""
    digits = "".join(character for character in digits if character.isdigit())[:11]
    if len(digits) <= 3:
        return digits
    if len(digits) <= 6:
        return f"{digits[:3]}-{digits[3:]}"
    if len(digits) <= 9:
        return f"{digits[:3]}-{digits[3:6]}-{digits[6:]}"
    return f"{digits[:3]}-{digits[3:6]}-{digits[6:9]} {digits[9:]}"


def format_postal_code_digits(digits: str) -> str:
    """Keep no more than six digits for a Russian postal code."""
    return "".join(character for character in digits if character.isdigit())[:6]


class AutoFormattedLineEdit(QLineEdit):
    """A line edit that formats digits without using Qt's input mask."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        formatter: Callable[[str], str],
        max_digits: int,
        parent=None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._formatter = formatter
        self._max_digits = max_digits
        self._return_to_start_after_mouse_release = False
        self.textEdited.connect(self._format_user_input)

    def focusInEvent(self, event) -> None:
        reason = event.reason()
        super().focusInEvent(event)

        if reason in (
            Qt.FocusReason.TabFocusReason,
            Qt.FocusReason.BacktabFocusReason,
            Qt.FocusReason.ShortcutFocusReason,
            Qt.FocusReason.OtherFocusReason,
        ):
            QTimer.singleShot(0, self._move_cursor_to_start)
        elif reason == Qt.FocusReason.MouseFocusReason:
            self._return_to_start_after_mouse_release = True

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event) -> None:
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)
        if self._return_to_start_after_mouse_release:
            self._return_to_start_after_mouse_release = False
            QTimer.singleShot(0, self._move_cursor_to_start)

    def set_formatted_digits(self, value: str) -> None:
        self.setText(self._formatter(value))
        self.setCursorPosition(0)

    def _format_user_input(self, current_text: str) -> None:
        old_cursor_position = self.cursorPosition()
        digits_before_cursor = sum(
            character.isdigit() for character in current_text[:old_cursor_position]
        )
        digits = "".join(
            character for character in current_text if character.isdigit()
        )[: self._max_digits]
        formatted = self._formatter(digits)

        self.setText(formatted)
        self.setCursorPosition(
            self._position_after_digit_count(formatted, digits_before_cursor)
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _position_after_digit_count(text: str, digit_count: int) -> int:
        if digit_count <= 0:
            return 0

        seen = 0
        for index, character in enumerate(text):
            if character.isdigit():
                seen += 1
                if seen == digit_count:
                    return index + 1
        return len(text)

    def _move_cursor_to_start(self) -> None:
        if self.hasFocus():
            self.deselect()
            self.setCursorPosition(0)

        self._update_courses_button()

        self.frdo_button = QPushButton("ФИС ФРДО")
        self.frdo_button.setToolTip(
            "Открыть сведения выбранного удостоверения или диплома для ФИС ФРДО"
        )
        self.frdo_button.setEnabled(bool(self.student_id and self.database))
        if not self.frdo_button.isEnabled():
            self.frdo_button.setToolTip(
                "Сначала сохраните карточку обучающегося."
            )
        self.frdo_button.clicked.connect(self._open_frdo)

        self.postal_shipments_button = QPushButton("Почтовые отправления")
        self.postal_shipments_button.setEnabled(bool(self.student_id and self.database))
        self.postal_shipments_button.setToolTip(
            "Открыть все почтовые отправления документов этого обучающегося"
            if self.postal_shipments_button.isEnabled()
            else "Сначала сохраните карточку обучающегося."
        )
        self.postal_shipments_button.clicked.connect(self._open_postal_shipments)

        self.gar_search = QLineEdit()
        self.gar_search.setPlaceholderText(
            "Например: Москва, ул. Тверская, д. 10"
        )
        self.gar_search.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.gar_search.returnPressed.connect(self._search_gar)

        self.gar_search_button = QPushButton("Найти в ГАР")
        self.gar_search_button.clicked.connect(self._search_gar)

        self.gar_unlink_button = QPushButton("Ручной ввод")
        self.gar_unlink_button.setToolTip(
            "Снять связь с выбранным адресом ГАР, не удаляя введённый адрес"
        )
        self.gar_unlink_button.clicked.connect(self._clear_gar_link)

        search_row = QWidget()
        search_layout = QHBoxLayout(search_row)
        search_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        search_layout.addWidget(self.gar_search, 1)
        search_layout.addWidget(self.gar_search_button)
        search_layout.addWidget(self.gar_unlink_button)

        self.postal_code = AutoFormattedLineEdit(format_postal_code_digits, 6)
        self.postal_code.setPlaceholderText("000000")
        self.postal_code.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.postal_code.setToolTip(
            "Заполняется из ГАР автоматически; при необходимости можно изменить вручную"
        )
        self.postal_code.textEdited.connect(lambda _: self._mark_address_manual())

        self.address = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.address.setPlaceholderText(
            "Выберите адрес из ГАР или введите полный адрес вручную"
        )
        self.address.setMaximumHeight(84)
        self.address.textChanged.connect(self._mark_address_manual)

        self.fias_id = QLineEdit()
        self.fias_id.setReadOnly(True)
        self.fias_id.setPlaceholderText("Появится после выбора адреса из ГАР")
        self.fias_id.setClearButtonEnabled(False)

        self.imported_address = QLineEdit()
        self.imported_address.setReadOnly(True)
        self.imported_address.setClearButtonEnabled(False)
        self.imported_address.setPlaceholderText(
            "Почтовый индекс и адрес из исходного файла Excel"
        )
        self.imported_address.setToolTip(
            "Исходные почтовый индекс и адрес, полученные при импорте. "
            "Поле защищено от изменений."
        )
        imported_palette = self.imported_address.palette()
        imported_palette.setColor(
            QPalette.ColorRole.Text,
            imported_palette.color(QPalette.ColorRole.PlaceholderText),
        )
        self.imported_address.setPalette(imported_palette)

        self.gar_status = QLabel(
            "Введите часть адреса и нажмите «Найти в ГАР». Ручной ввод также доступен."
        )
        self.gar_status.setWordWrap(True)

        address_group = QGroupBox("Адрес по Государственному адресному реестру")
        address_layout = QGridLayout(address_group)
        address_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Поиск"), 0, 0)
        address_layout.addWidget(search_row, 0, 1)
        address_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Почтовый индекс"), 1, 0)
        address_layout.addWidget(self.postal_code, 1, 1)
        address_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Адрес"), 2, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)
        address_layout.addWidget(self.address, 2, 1)
        id_status_widget = QWidget()
        id_status_layout = QVBoxLayout(id_status_widget)
        id_status_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        id_status_layout.setSpacing(3)
        id_status_layout.addWidget(self.fias_id)
        id_status_layout.addWidget(self.gar_status)

        address_layout.addWidget(QLabel("ID ФИАС"), 3, 0, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)
        address_layout.addWidget(id_status_widget, 3, 1)
        address_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Импортированный адрес"), 4, 0)
        address_layout.addWidget(self.imported_address, 4, 1)
        address_layout.setColumnStretch(1, 1)

        self.gar_client = GarClient(self)
        self.gar_client.search_finished.connect(self._show_gar_results)
        self.gar_client.search_failed.connect(self._gar_search_failed)
        self.gar_client.details_finished.connect(self._apply_gar_details)
        self.gar_client.details_failed.connect(self._gar_details_failed)
        self.gar_client.address_item_finished.connect(self._apply_gar_address_item)
        self.gar_client.address_item_failed.connect(self._gar_address_item_failed)

        self.phone = QLineEdit()
        self.email = QLineEdit()
        self.notes = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.notes.setPlaceholderText("Служебные примечания")
        self.notes.setMaximumHeight(86)
        notes_palette = self.notes.palette()
        notes_palette.setColor(QPalette.ColorRole.Text, Qt.GlobalColor.red)
        self.notes.setPalette(notes_palette)
        self.notes.setToolTip("Введённые примечания отображаются красным цветом")

        form = QFormLayout()
        form.addRow("Фамилия *", self.last_name)
        form.addRow("Имя *", self.first_name)
        form.addRow("Отчество", self.middle_name)
        form.addRow("Пол", self.gender)
        form.addRow("Дата рождения", self.birth_date)
        form.addRow("СНИЛС", self.snils)
        form.addRow("Паспорт", self.passport_details_button)
        form.addRow("Пройденные курсы", self.courses_button)
        form.addRow("Данные для выгрузки", self.frdo_button)
        form.addRow("Почта России", self.postal_shipments_button)

        buttons = QDialogButtonBox(
            QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Save
            | QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel
        )
        buttons.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Save).setText("Сохранить")
        buttons.button(QDialogButtonBox.StandardButton.Cancel).setText("Отмена")
        buttons.accepted.connect(self._validate_and_accept)
        buttons.rejected.connect(self.reject)

        lower_form = QFormLayout()
        lower_form.addRow("Телефон", self.phone)
        lower_form.addRow("Электронная почта", self.email)
        lower_form.addRow("Примечания", self.notes)

        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addLayout(form)
        layout.addWidget(address_group)
        layout.addLayout(lower_form)
        layout.addWidget(buttons)

        if student:
            self._load(student)

    def _load(self, student: Mapping[str, object]) -> None:
        self.last_name.setText(str(student.get("last_name", "") or ""))
        self.first_name.setText(str(student.get("first_name", "") or ""))
        self.middle_name.setText(str(student.get("middle_name", "") or ""))
        gender_value = str(student.get("gender", "") or "").strip()
        self._gender_source = str(student.get("gender_source", "") or "").strip()
        gender_index = self.gender.findData(gender_value)
        self._loading_gender = True
        try:
            self.gender.setCurrentIndex(gender_index if gender_index >= 0 else 0)
        finally:
            self._loading_gender = False
        if self._gender_source.startswith("inferred"):
            self.gender.setToolTip(
                "Пол определён автоматически по имени и отчеству. "
                "Вы можете изменить его вручную; ручной выбор не будет перезаписан импортом."
            )
        elif self._gender_source == "uncertain":
            self.gender.setToolTip(
                "Автоматически определить пол не удалось. Выберите значение вручную."
            )
        self.snils.set_formatted_digits(str(student.get("snils", "") or ""))

        self._applying_gar_values = True
        try:
            # Loading a stored address is not a manual edit.  QPlainTextEdit can
            # emit textChanged while its document/layout is being initialised, so
            # block widget signals in addition to the guard flag.  A later delayed
            # notification is also harmless because _mark_address_manual compares
            # the widgets with the authoritative GAR snapshot before unlinking.
            postal_blocker = QSignalBlocker(self.postal_code)
            address_blocker = QSignalBlocker(self.address)
            self.postal_code.set_formatted_digits(
                str(student.get("postal_code", "") or "")
            )
            address = str(student.get("address", "") or "")
            self.address.setPlainText(address)
            del address_blocker
            del postal_blocker
            self.gar_search.clear()
            self.fias_id.setText(str(student.get("fias_id", "") or ""))
            self._fias_object_id = str(student.get("fias_object_id", "") or "")
            stored_sync_status = str(
                student.get("address_sync_status", "") or ""
            ).strip()
            if (
                self.fias_id.text().strip()
                or self._fias_object_id
                or stored_sync_status == "synced"
            ):
                self._gar_address_value = address.strip()
                self._gar_postal_code_value = str(
                    student.get("postal_code", "") or ""
                ).strip()
            else:
                self._gar_address_value = ""
                self._gar_postal_code_value = ""
            self._imported_address_value = str(
                student.get("imported_address", "") or ""
            ).strip()
            self._imported_postal_code_value = str(
                student.get("imported_postal_code", "") or ""
            ).strip()
            self._refresh_imported_address_display()
            self._address_sync_status = str(
                student.get("address_sync_status", "") or ""
            ).strip()
        finally:
            self._applying_gar_values = False

        if self.fias_id.text():
            self._address_sync_status = "synced"
            self._set_gar_status("Адрес синхронизирован с ГАР")
        elif self._fias_object_id:
            self._address_sync_status = "synced"
            self._set_gar_status(
                "Адрес синхронизирован с ГАР; восстанавливается ID ФИАС…"
            )
            QTimer.singleShot(
                0,
                lambda object_id=self._fias_object_id: (
                    self.gar_client.request_address_item(object_id)
                ),
            )
        elif self._address_sync_status == "synced":
            self._set_gar_status(
                "Адрес был синхронизирован с ГАР ранее. ID ФИАС в старой записи отсутствует."
            )
        elif self._address_sync_status == "failed" or self.imported_address.text().strip():
            self._address_sync_status = "failed"
            self._set_gar_status(
                "Синхронизация адреса с ГАР не выполнена", error=True
            )
        elif self.address.toPlainText().strip():
            self._set_gar_status("Адрес сохранён без связи с ГАР.")

        issue_date_storage = str(student.get("passport_issue_date", "") or "").strip()
        issue_date_parsed = QDate.fromString(issue_date_storage, self.DATE_STORAGE_FORMAT)
        issue_date_display = (
            issue_date_parsed.toString(self.DATE_DISPLAY_FORMAT)
            if issue_date_parsed.isValid()
            else issue_date_storage
        )
        self._passport_values = {
            "birth_place": str(student.get("birth_place", "") or "").strip(),
            "passport_series": str(student.get("passport_series", "") or "").strip(),
            "passport_number": str(student.get("passport_number", "") or "").strip(),
            "passport_issue_date": issue_date_display,
            "passport_department_code": str(
                student.get("passport_department_code", "") or ""
            ).strip(),
            "passport_issued_by": str(
                student.get("passport_issued_by", "") or ""
            ).strip(),
        }
        self._update_passport_button()

        self.phone.setText(str(student.get("phone", "") or ""))
        self.email.setText(str(student.get("email", "") or ""))
        self.notes.setPlainText(str(student.get("notes", "") or ""))

        raw_date = str(student.get("birth_date", "") or "")
        parsed = QDate.fromString(raw_date, self.DATE_STORAGE_FORMAT)
        if parsed.isValid():
            self.birth_date.set_formatted_digits(
                parsed.toString(self.DATE_DISPLAY_FORMAT)
            )

    def _gender_selection_changed(self, _index: int) -> None:
        if not self._loading_gender:
            self._gender_changed_by_user = True

    def _refresh_imported_address_display(self) -> None:
        parts: list[str] = []
        if self._imported_postal_code_value:
            parts.append(self._imported_postal_code_value)
        if self._imported_address_value:
            parts.append(self._imported_address_value)
        self.imported_address.setText(", ".join(parts))

    def _update_passport_button(self) -> None:
        series = self._passport_values.get("passport_series", "").strip()
        number = self._passport_values.get("passport_number", "").strip()
        if series or number:
            display = " ".join(part for part in (series, number) if part)
            self.passport_details_button.setText(f"Паспорт {display} (открыть)")
        elif any(value.strip() for value in self._passport_values.values()):
            self.passport_details_button.setText("Паспортные данные (открыть)")
        else:
            self.passport_details_button.setText("Ввести паспортные данные…")

    def _edit_passport_data(self) -> None:
        key = (*self._child_window_key_prefix, "passport")

        def save_passport(dialog: PassportDataDialog, result: int) -> None:
            if result != int(QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted):
                return
            self._passport_values.update(dialog.values())
            self._update_passport_button()

        show_independent_window(
            key,
            lambda: PassportDataDialog(dict(self._passport_values), None),
            on_finished=save_passport,
        )

    def _open_courses(self) -> None:
        if self.database is None:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Курсы",
                "Справочник курсов недоступен: база данных не подключена.",
            )
            return
        key = (*self._child_window_key_prefix, "courses")

        def save_courses(dialog: CoursesDialog, result: int) -> None:
            if result != int(QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted):
                return
            self._courses = dialog.courses()
            self._update_courses_button()

        show_independent_window(
            key,
            lambda: CoursesDialog(self.database, self._courses, None),
            on_finished=save_courses,
        )

    def _open_postal_shipments(self) -> None:
        if self.database is None or not self.student_id:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Почтовые отправления",
                "Сначала сохраните карточку обучающегося.",
            )
            return
        student = self.database.get_student(self.student_id)
        if student is None:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Почтовые отправления",
                "Карточка обучающегося уже не существует.",
            )
            return
        manager = self.russian_post_manager
        if manager is None:
            manager = RussianPostManager(self.database.path.parent)
            self.russian_post_manager = manager
        show_independent_window(
            ("postal_shipments_overview", self.student_id),
            lambda: PostalShipmentsOverviewDialog(
                self.database, manager, dict(student), None
            ),
        )

    def _open_frdo(self) -> None:
        if self.database is None or not self.student_id:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "ФИС ФРДО",
                "Сначала сохраните карточку обучающегося.",
            )
            return

        courses = [
            dict(row)
            for row in self.database.list_student_courses(self.student_id)
            if str(row["program_type"] or "") in {
                "Повышение квалификации",
                "Профессиональная переподготовка",
            }
        ]
        if not courses:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "ФИС ФРДО",
                "У обучающегося нет сохранённых программ повышения квалификации или профессиональной переподготовки.",
            )
            return

        selected_course = courses[0]
        if len(courses) > 1:
            labels = [
                (
                    f'{"Удостоверение" if str(course["program_type"] or "") == "Повышение квалификации" else "Диплом"}: '
                    f'{course["course_name"]} — {int(course["duration_hours"] or 0)} ч.'
                )
                for course in courses
            ]
            selected_label, accepted = QInputDialog.getItem(
                self,
                "ФИС ФРДО",
                "Выберите документ:",
                labels,
                0,
                False,
            )
            if not accepted:
                return
            selected_course = courses[labels.index(selected_label)]

        open_frdo_record_for_course(
            self.database,
            self.student_id,
            int(selected_course["id"]),
            None,
        )

    def done(self, result: int) -> None:
        close_independent_window((*self._child_window_key_prefix, "passport"))
        close_independent_window((*self._child_window_key_prefix, "courses"))
        super().done(result)

    def _update_courses_button(self) -> None:
        count = len(self._courses)
        if count:
            self.courses_button.setText(f"Пройденные курсы — {count} (открыть)")
        else:
            self.courses_button.setText("Добавить сведения о пройденных курсах…")

    def course_values(self) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
        return [dict(course) for course in self._courses]

    def _set_gar_status(self, text: str, error: bool = False) -> None:
        self.gar_status.setText(text)
        self.gar_status.setStyleSheet("color: #b00020;" if error else "")

    def _mark_gar_synced(self) -> None:
        self._address_sync_status = "synced"
        self._set_gar_status("Адрес синхронизирован с ГАР")

    def _mark_gar_failed(self) -> None:
        self._address_sync_status = "failed"
        self._set_gar_status(
            "Синхронизация адреса с ГАР не выполнена", error=True
        )

    def _search_gar(self) -> None:
        query = self.gar_search.text().strip()
        if not query:
            query = self.address.toPlainText().strip()
            self.gar_search.setText(query)
        if len(query) < 3:
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Поиск адреса",
                "Введите не менее трёх символов адреса.",
            )
            self.gar_search.setFocus()
            return

        self.gar_search_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.gar_search_button.setText("Поиск…")
        self.gar_status.setText("Выполняется поиск в Государственном адресном реестре…")
        self.gar_client.search(query)

    def _show_gar_results(self, suggestions: list[GarSuggestion]) -> None:
        self._finish_gar_search_controls()
        if not suggestions:
            self.gar_status.setText(
                "Подходящие адреса в ГАР не найдены. Уточните запрос или введите адрес вручную."
            )
            QMessageBox.information(
                self,
                "Адрес не найден",
                "ГАР не вернул подходящих адресов. Попробуйте добавить регион, город, "
                "улицу или номер дома.",
            )
            return

        selector = GarSelectorDialog(suggestions, self)
        if not selector.exec():
            self.gar_status.setText("Выбор адреса отменён.")
            return

        selected = selector.selected_suggestion()
        if selected is None:
            return
        self._apply_gar_suggestion(selected)

    def _apply_gar_suggestion(self, suggestion: GarSuggestion) -> None:
        self._applying_gar_values = True
        try:
            normalized_address = str(suggestion.address or "").strip()
            normalized_postal_code = str(suggestion.postal_code or "").strip()
            self.address.setPlainText(normalized_address)
            self.gar_search.clear()
            self.fias_id.setText(suggestion.fias_id)
            self._fias_object_id = suggestion.object_id
            self._address_sync_status = (
                "synced" if (suggestion.fias_id or suggestion.object_id) else ""
            )
            self._gar_address_value = normalized_address
            self._gar_postal_code_value = normalized_postal_code
            self._gar_link_action = "set"
            if normalized_postal_code:
                self.postal_code.set_formatted_digits(normalized_postal_code)
            else:
                # Do not retain the index from the previously selected/manual
                # address while GAR details for the new address are still loading.
                self.postal_code.clear()
        finally:
            self._applying_gar_values = False

        if suggestion.object_id:
            if suggestion.fias_id:
                self.gar_status.setText(
                    "Адрес синхронизирован с ГАР. Загружается почтовый индекс…"
                )
            else:
                self.gar_status.setText(
                    "Адрес синхронизирован с ГАР. Восстанавливаются ID ФИАС и почтовый индекс…"
                )
            self.gar_client.request_details(suggestion.object_id)
            if not suggestion.fias_id:
                self.gar_client.request_address_item(suggestion.object_id)
        else:
            self.gar_status.setText(
                "Адрес выбран из ГАР, но сервис не вернул внутренний ID объекта."
            )

    def _apply_gar_details(self, details: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        postal_code = self._extract_postal_code(details)
        if postal_code:
            self._applying_gar_values = True
            try:
                self.postal_code.set_formatted_digits(postal_code)
                if self._fias_object_id or self.fias_id.text().strip():
                    self._gar_postal_code_value = postal_code
            finally:
                self._applying_gar_values = False
            if self.fias_id.text().strip():
                self._mark_gar_synced()
            else:
                self.gar_status.setText(
                    "Почтовый индекс получен; ожидается ID ФИАС…"
                )
        else:
            if self.fias_id.text().strip():
                self._mark_gar_synced()
            else:
                self.gar_status.setText(
                    "Адрес выбран из ГАР, но почтовый индекс для него не указан; "
                    "ожидается ID ФИАС."
                )

    def _apply_gar_address_item(self, object_id: str, fias_id: str) -> None:
        if object_id != self._fias_object_id or not fias_id:
            return
        self.fias_id.setText(fias_id)
        self._gar_link_action = "set"
        self._mark_gar_synced()

    def _gar_address_item_failed(self, object_id: str, message: str) -> None:
        if object_id != self._fias_object_id:
            return
        if self._fias_object_id and self._gar_address_value:
            # Preserve the selected GAR object. Failure to resolve the stable GUID
            # must not erase a valid normalized address or downgrade the link.
            self._address_sync_status = "synced"
            self._set_gar_status(
                "Адрес синхронизирован с ГАР. ID ФИАС временно не получен; "
                "программа повторит попытку при следующем открытии карточки."
            )
        elif self.imported_address.text().strip():
            self._mark_gar_failed()
        else:
            self._set_gar_status(
                "ID ФИАС получить не удалось. Повторите поиск адреса.", error=True
            )
        QMessageBox.information(self, "ID ФИАС", message)

    def _gar_search_failed(self, message: str) -> None:
        self._finish_gar_search_controls()
        if self.imported_address.text().strip():
            self._mark_gar_failed()
        else:
            self._set_gar_status(
                "Сервис ГАР сейчас недоступен. Адрес можно ввести вручную.",
                error=True,
            )
        QMessageBox.warning(self, "Ошибка поиска в ГАР", message)

    def _gar_details_failed(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.gar_status.setText(
            "Адрес выбран из ГАР, но индекс получить не удалось. "
            "Индекс можно ввести вручную."
        )
        QMessageBox.information(self, "Почтовый индекс", message)

    def _finish_gar_search_controls(self) -> None:
        self.gar_search_button.setEnabled(True)
        self.gar_search_button.setText("Найти в ГАР")
        self.gar_search.clear()

    def _mark_address_manual(self) -> None:
        if self._applying_gar_values:
            return

        # QPlainTextEdit.textChanged is not a user-only signal.  It may fire for
        # programmatic/document-layout changes after _load() has finished.  Never
        # interpret such a notification as an explicit unlink when the visible
        # values still match the address selected from GAR.  This also intentionally
        # allows a user to type a postal code manually when GAR did not provide one:
        # the normalized GAR address remains authoritative in that case.
        current_address = self.address.toPlainText().strip()
        current_postal_code = self.postal_code.text().strip()
        if self._gar_address_value and current_address == self._gar_address_value:
            if (
                not self._gar_postal_code_value
                or current_postal_code == self._gar_postal_code_value
            ):
                return

        had_gar_link = bool(
            self.fias_id.text().strip()
            or self._fias_object_id
            or self._address_sync_status == "synced"
        )
        if self.fias_id.text() or self._fias_object_id:
            self.fias_id.clear()
            self._fias_object_id = ""
        self._gar_address_value = ""
        self._gar_postal_code_value = ""
        if had_gar_link:
            self._gar_link_action = "clear"
        if self.imported_address.text().strip():
            self._mark_gar_failed()
        elif self.address.toPlainText().strip() or self.postal_code.text().strip():
            self._address_sync_status = ""
            self._set_gar_status("Адрес вводится вручную.")

    def _clear_gar_link(self) -> None:
        self.fias_id.clear()
        self._fias_object_id = ""
        self._gar_address_value = ""
        self._gar_postal_code_value = ""
        self._gar_link_action = "clear"
        if self.imported_address.text().strip():
            self._mark_gar_failed()
        else:
            self._address_sync_status = ""
            self._set_gar_status(
                "Включён ручной ввод. Сохранённые адрес и индекс не удалены."
            )
        self.address.setFocus()

    @classmethod
    def _extract_postal_code(cls, data: Any) -> str:
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            for key in ("postal_code", "postalCode", "index", "postIndex"):
                value = data.get(key)
                if value is not None:
                    digits = format_postal_code_digits(str(value))
                    if len(digits) == 6:
                        return digits
            for value in data.values():
                result = cls._extract_postal_code(value)
                if result:
                    return result
        elif isinstance(data, list):
            for value in data:
                result = cls._extract_postal_code(value)
                if result:
                    return result
        return ""

    def _validate_and_accept(self) -> None:
        if not self.last_name.text().strip() or not self.first_name.text().strip():
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Не заполнены обязательные поля",
                "Укажите фамилию и имя обучающегося.",
            )
            return


        date_text = self._date_text()
        if date_text:
            parsed_date = QDate.fromString(date_text, self.DATE_DISPLAY_FORMAT)
            if len(date_text) != 10 or not parsed_date.isValid():
                QMessageBox.warning(
                    self,
                    "Некорректная дата",
                    "Введите существующую дату рождения в формате ДД.ММ.ГГГГ.",
                )
                self.birth_date.setFocus()
                self.birth_date.selectAll()
                return
            if parsed_date > QDate.currentDate():
                QMessageBox.warning(
                    self,
                    "Некорректная дата",
                    "Дата рождения не может быть позднее сегодняшней даты.",
                )
                self.birth_date.setFocus()
                self.birth_date.selectAll()
                return

        snils_digits = self._snils_digits()
        if snils_digits and len(snils_digits) != 11:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Некорректный СНИЛС",
                "Введите СНИЛС полностью: 11 цифр в формате 000-000-000 00.",
            )
            self.snils.setFocus()
            self.snils.selectAll()
            return

        if snils_digits:
            is_valid, expected_checksum = self._validate_snils_checksum(snils_digits)
            if not is_valid:
                QMessageBox.warning(
                    self,
                    "Некорректный СНИЛС",
                    "Контрольная сумма СНИЛС не совпадает.\n\n"
                    f"Для первых девяти цифр контрольное число должно быть "
                    f"{expected_checksum:02d}. Проверьте введённый номер.",
                )
                self.snils.setFocus()
                self.snils.selectAll()
                return

        if snils_digits and self._duplicate_snils_checker is not None:
            formatted_snils = format_snils_digits(snils_digits)
            duplicate = self._duplicate_snils_checker(formatted_snils)
            if duplicate is not None:
                duplicate_name = " ".join(
                    str(duplicate.get(field, "") or "").strip()
                    for field in ("last_name", "first_name", "middle_name")
                    if str(duplicate.get(field, "") or "").strip()
                )
                QMessageBox.warning(
                    self,
                    "Дубликат СНИЛС",
                    f"СНИЛС {formatted_snils} уже указан у обучающегося "
                    f"«{duplicate_name or 'без Ф.И.О.'}».\n\n"
                    "Один СНИЛС нельзя сохранить у разных обучающихся.",
                )
                self.snils.setFocus()
                self.snils.selectAll()
                return

        passport_series = "".join(
            character
            for character in self._passport_values.get("passport_series", "")
            if character.isdigit()
        )
        if passport_series and len(passport_series) != 4:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Некорректная серия паспорта",
                "Серия паспорта должна содержать 4 цифры.",
            )
            self._edit_passport_data()
            return

        passport_number = "".join(
            character
            for character in self._passport_values.get("passport_number", "")
            if character.isdigit()
        )
        if passport_number and len(passport_number) != 6:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Некорректный номер паспорта",
                "Номер паспорта должен содержать 6 цифр.",
            )
            self._edit_passport_data()
            return

        passport_issue_date = self._passport_values.get(
            "passport_issue_date", ""
        ).strip()
        if passport_issue_date:
            parsed_issue_date = QDate.fromString(
                passport_issue_date,
                self.DATE_DISPLAY_FORMAT,
            )
            if len(passport_issue_date) != 10 or not parsed_issue_date.isValid():
                QMessageBox.warning(
                    self,
                    "Некорректная дата выдачи паспорта",
                    "Введите дату выдачи паспорта в формате ДД.ММ.ГГГГ.",
                )
                self._edit_passport_data()
                return
            if parsed_issue_date > QDate.currentDate():
                QMessageBox.warning(
                    self,
                    "Некорректная дата выдачи паспорта",
                    "Дата выдачи паспорта не может быть позднее сегодняшней даты.",
                )
                self._edit_passport_data()
                return

        department_digits = "".join(
            character
            for character in self._passport_values.get(
                "passport_department_code", ""
            )
            if character.isdigit()
        )
        if department_digits and len(department_digits) != 6:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Некорректный код подразделения",
                "Код подразделения должен содержать 6 цифр в формате 000-000.",
            )
            self._edit_passport_data()
            return
        if department_digits:
            self._passport_values["passport_department_code"] = (
                f"{department_digits[:3]}-{department_digits[3:]}"
            )

        postal_code = self.postal_code.text().strip()
        if postal_code and len(postal_code) != 6:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Некорректный почтовый индекс",
                "Введите почтовый индекс полностью: 6 цифр.",
            )
            self.postal_code.setFocus()
            self.postal_code.selectAll()
            return

        if self.fias_id.text().strip() and not self.address.toPlainText().strip():
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self,
                "Некорректный адрес",
                "Для выбранного ID ФИАС отсутствует адресная строка. "
                "Выберите адрес повторно.",
            )
            return

        self.accept()

    def values(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        birth_date = ""
        date_text = self._date_text()
        if date_text:
            parsed_date = QDate.fromString(date_text, self.DATE_DISPLAY_FORMAT)
            if parsed_date.isValid():
                birth_date = parsed_date.toString(self.DATE_STORAGE_FORMAT)

        snils_digits = self._snils_digits()
        formatted_snils = ""
        if len(snils_digits) == 11:
            formatted_snils = format_snils_digits(snils_digits)

        gender_value = str(self.gender.currentData() or "").strip()
        if self._gender_changed_by_user:
            gender_source = "manual" if gender_value in ("Мужской", "Женский") else ""
        else:
            gender_source = self._gender_source
            if gender_value in ("Мужской", "Женский") and not gender_source:
                gender_source = "manual"

        current_fias_id = self.fias_id.text().strip()
        has_gar_link = bool(
            current_fias_id
            or self._fias_object_id
            or self._address_sync_status == "synced"
        )
        if has_gar_link and self._gar_address_value:
            saved_address = self._gar_address_value
            saved_postal_code = (
                self._gar_postal_code_value or self.postal_code.text().strip()
            )
        else:
            saved_address = self.address.toPlainText().strip()
            saved_postal_code = self.postal_code.text().strip()

        return {
            "last_name": self.last_name.text(),
            "first_name": self.first_name.text(),
            "middle_name": self.middle_name.text(),
            "gender": gender_value,
            "gender_source": gender_source,
            "birth_date": birth_date,
            "snils": formatted_snils,
            "postal_code": saved_postal_code,
            "address": saved_address,
            "imported_address": self._imported_address_value,
            "imported_postal_code": self._imported_postal_code_value,
            "address_sync_status": (
                "synced" if has_gar_link else
                "failed" if self.imported_address.text().strip() else ""
            ),
            "fias_id": current_fias_id,
            "fias_object_id": self._fias_object_id,
            "_gar_link_action": self._gar_link_action,
            "birth_place": self._passport_values.get("birth_place", "").strip(),
            "passport_series": "".join(
                character
                for character in self._passport_values.get("passport_series", "")
                if character.isdigit()
            )[:4],
            "passport_number": "".join(
                character
                for character in self._passport_values.get("passport_number", "")
                if character.isdigit()
            )[:6],
            "passport_issue_date": self._passport_issue_date_storage(),
            "passport_department_code": self._passport_values.get(
                "passport_department_code", ""
            ).strip(),
            "passport_issued_by": self._passport_values.get(
                "passport_issued_by", ""
            ).strip(),
            "phone": self.phone.text(),
            "email": self.email.text(),
            "notes": self.notes.toPlainText(),
        }

    def _passport_issue_date_storage(self) -> str:
        value = self._passport_values.get("passport_issue_date", "").strip()
        parsed = QDate.fromString(value, self.DATE_DISPLAY_FORMAT)
        if parsed.isValid():
            return parsed.toString(self.DATE_STORAGE_FORMAT)
        return value

    def _date_text(self) -> str:
        return self.birth_date.text().strip()

    def _snils_digits(self) -> str:
        return "".join(
            character for character in self.snils.text() if character.isdigit()
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _validate_snils_checksum(snils_digits: str) -> tuple[bool, int]:
        """Check the two-digit SNILS checksum."""
        if len(snils_digits) != 11 or not snils_digits.isdigit():
            return False, 0

        insurance_number = int(snils_digits[:9])
        actual_checksum = int(snils_digits[9:])

        if insurance_number <= 1_001_998:
            return True, actual_checksum

        weighted_sum = sum(
            int(digit) * weight
            for digit, weight in zip(snils_digits[:9], range(9, 0, -1))
        )
        remainder = weighted_sum % 101
        expected_checksum = remainder if remainder < 100 else 0
        return actual_checksum == expected_checksum, expected_checksum

from __future__ import annotations

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Signal


class TemplateEvents(QObject):
    """Application-wide notifications for print-template changes."""

    template_saved = Signal(int)


_template_events: TemplateEvents | None = None


def get_template_events() -> TemplateEvents:
    """Create the Qt event object lazily, after QApplication has started."""
    global _template_events
    if _template_events is None:
        _template_events = TemplateEvents()
    return _template_events

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
from collections.abc import Callable, Hashable
from typing import Any, TypeVar

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QWidget
from shiboken6 import isValid

WindowT = TypeVar("WindowT", bound=QWidget)

_LOGGER = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _iter_callback_objects(callback: Callable[..., Any]):
    """Yield Qt objects directly retained by a callback.

    Independent windows can outlive the window that opened them.  A closure or
    bound method may therefore still retain a Python wrapper whose underlying
    C++ widget has already been deleted.  Invoking such a callback causes the
    libshiboken ``Internal C++ object already deleted`` runtime error.
    """

    owner = getattr(callback, "__self__", None)
    if owner is not None:
        yield owner

    for cell in getattr(callback, "__closure__", None) or ():
        try:
            yield cell.cell_contents
        except ValueError:
            # An empty closure cell is harmless.
            continue

    for value in getattr(callback, "__defaults__", None) or ():
        yield value

    keyword_defaults = getattr(callback, "__kwdefaults__", None) or {}
    yield from keyword_defaults.values()


def _callback_owner_is_alive(callback: Callable[..., Any]) -> bool:
    """Return False when a callback belongs to an already deleted Qt object."""

    for value in _iter_callback_objects(callback):
        if isinstance(value, QObject) and not isValid(value):
            return False
    return True


def _is_deleted_qt_object_error(exc: RuntimeError) -> bool:
    message = str(exc).lower()
    return (
        "internal c++ object" in message
        and "already deleted" in message
    )


def _invoke_callback_safely(
    callback: Callable[..., Any] | None,
    *args: Any,
) -> None:
    """Invoke a window callback only while its receiving Qt window is alive."""

    if callback is None or not _callback_owner_is_alive(callback):
        return
    try:
        callback(*args)
    except RuntimeError as exc:
        # A Qt object can be deleted between the validity check and invocation
        # while several top-level windows are closing at nearly the same time.
        if _is_deleted_qt_object_error(exc):
            _LOGGER.debug(
                "Skipped callback for an already deleted Qt object",
                exc_info=True,
            )
            return
        raise


class IndependentWindowRegistry:
    """Keep independent top-level work windows alive and reuse open instances."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._windows: dict[Hashable, QWidget] = {}

    def show(
        self,
        key: Hashable,
        factory: Callable[[], WindowT],
        *,
        on_finished: Callable[[WindowT, int], None] | None = None,
        on_closed: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
        maximize_on_first_show: bool = False,
    ) -> WindowT:
        existing = self._windows.get(key)
        if existing is not None:
            try:
                # Reopening an existing window must not register the same
                # save/accept handler again: that could duplicate database writes.
                # Close listeners are safe and allow all callers to refresh when
                # the shared window is eventually closed.  The guarded invocation
                # prevents a listener from touching an opener that was closed first.
                if on_closed is not None:
                    existing.destroyed.connect(
                        lambda *_args, callback=on_closed: (
                            _invoke_callback_safely(callback)
                        )
                    )
                state = existing.windowState()
                if state & Qt.WindowState.WindowMinimized:
                    existing.setWindowState(
                        (state & ~Qt.WindowState.WindowMinimized)
                        | Qt.WindowState.WindowActive
                    )
                existing.show()
                existing.raise_()
                existing.activateWindow()
                return existing  # type: ignore[return-value]
            except RuntimeError:
                self._windows.pop(key, None)

        window = factory()
        window.setParent(None)
        window.setWindowFlags(
            Qt.WindowType.Window
            | Qt.WindowType.WindowTitleHint
            | Qt.WindowType.WindowSystemMenuHint
            | Qt.WindowType.WindowMinimizeButtonHint
            | Qt.WindowType.WindowMaximizeButtonHint
            | Qt.WindowType.WindowCloseButtonHint
        )
        window.setWindowModality(Qt.WindowModality.NonModal)
        if isinstance(window, QDialog):
            window.setModal(False)
        window.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_DeleteOnClose, True)
        self._windows[key] = window

        finished_called = False

        def handle_finished(result: int) -> None:
            nonlocal finished_called
            if finished_called:
                return
            finished_called = True
            _invoke_callback_safely(on_finished, window, int(result))

        if isinstance(window, QDialog):
            window.finished.connect(handle_finished)

        def cleanup(*_args: Any) -> None:
            current = self._windows.get(key)
            if current is window:
                self._windows.pop(key, None)
            _invoke_callback_safely(on_closed)

        window.destroyed.connect(cleanup)
        if maximize_on_first_show:
            window.showMaximized()
        else:
            window.show()
        window.raise_()
        window.activateWindow()
        return window

    def close(self, key: Hashable) -> None:
        window = self._windows.get(key)
        if window is None:
            return
        try:
            window.close()
        except RuntimeError:
            self._windows.pop(key, None)

    def close_all(self) -> None:
        for window in list(self._windows.values()):
            try:
                window.close()
            except RuntimeError:
                pass
        self._windows.clear()

    def count(self) -> int:
        return len(self._windows)


_registry = IndependentWindowRegistry()


def show_independent_window(
    key: Hashable,
    factory: Callable[[], WindowT],
    *,
    on_finished: Callable[[WindowT, int], None] | None = None,
    on_closed: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
    maximize_on_first_show: bool = False,
) -> WindowT:
    return _registry.show(
        key,
        factory,
        on_finished=on_finished,
        on_closed=on_closed,
        maximize_on_first_show=maximize_on_first_show,
    )


def close_independent_window(key: Hashable) -> None:
    _registry.close(key)


def close_all_independent_windows() -> None:
    _registry.close_all()


def independent_window_count() -> int:
    return _registry.count()
