from __future__ import annotations

import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from dpo_app.db import Database


DIPLOMA_DIALOG_SOURCE = Path("dpo_app/ui/diploma_print_dialog.py")
JOURNAL_DIALOG_SOURCE = Path("dpo_app/ui/issued_documents_journal_dialog.py")


class DiplomaCurriculumLiveSyncTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.database = Database(Path(self.temp_dir.name) / "test.sqlite3")
        self.database.initialize()
        self.catalog_id = self.database.create_catalog_course(
            "Корпоративное право",
            500,
            "Профессиональная переподготовка",
            "Юрист",
            "Правовая деятельность",
            [
                {"name": "Дисциплина А", "hours": 200, "grade": "Зачтено"},
                {"name": "Дисциплина Б", "hours": 300, "grade": "Зачтено"},
            ],
        )
        self.student_id = self.database.create_student(
            {"last_name": "Иванов", "first_name": "Иван", "middle_name": "Иванович"}
        )
        self.database.replace_student_courses(
            self.student_id,
            [
                {
                    "catalog_course_id": self.catalog_id,
                    "course_name": "Корпоративное право",
                    "duration_hours": 500,
                    "program_type": "Профессиональная переподготовка",
                }
            ],
        )
        self.course_id = int(self.database.list_student_courses(self.student_id)[0]["id"])
        template = next(
            dict(row)
            for row in self.database.list_print_templates()
            if row["document_type"] == "Диплом о профессиональной переподготовке"
        )
        self.template_id = int(template["id"])

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.temp_dir.cleanup()

    def _save_diploma(self, curriculum=None) -> int:
        self.database.save_diploma_print_data(
            self.student_id,
            self.course_id,
            {
                "template_id": self.template_id,
                "blank_number": "Д-001",
                "registration_number": "Р-001",
                "issue_date": "2026-08-07",
                "appendix_sheet_count": 1,
                "appendix_second_sheet_from": 0,
                "appendix_split_manual": False,
            },
            curriculum or [{"name": "Устаревшая строка", "hours": 1, "grade": ""}],
            {},
        )
        return int(self.database.list_issued_documents(document_kind="diploma")[0]["id"])

    def _update_catalog(self, rows) -> None:
        self.database.update_catalog_course(
            self.catalog_id,
            "Корпоративное право",
            500,
            "Профессиональная переподготовка",
            "Юрист",
            "Правовая деятельность",
            rows,
        )

    def test_stale_diploma_editor_rows_cannot_override_live_catalog_before_issue(self) -> None:
        document_id = self._save_diploma()
        expected = [
            {"name": "Дисциплина А", "hours": 200, "grade": "Зачтено"},
            {"name": "Дисциплина Б", "hours": 300, "grade": "Зачтено"},
        ]
        _data, curriculum, _layout = self.database.get_diploma_print_data(
            self.student_id, self.course_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(curriculum, expected)
        _data, journal_curriculum, _layout = self.database.get_issued_document_payload(
            document_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(journal_curriculum, expected)

    def test_catalog_change_propagates_to_unissued_diploma_snapshots(self) -> None:
        document_id = self._save_diploma()
        updated = [
            {"name": "Новая дисциплина", "hours": 500, "grade": "Отлично"}
        ]
        self._update_catalog(updated)

        _data, curriculum, _layout = self.database.get_diploma_print_data(
            self.student_id, self.course_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(curriculum, updated)
        _data, journal_curriculum, _layout = self.database.get_issued_document_payload(
            document_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(journal_curriculum, updated)
        course = next(
            row
            for row in self.database.list_student_courses(self.student_id)
            if int(row["id"]) == self.course_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            Database.decode_catalog_curriculum(course["catalog_curriculum_json"]),
            updated,
        )

    def test_live_sync_preserves_saved_two_sheet_boundary_and_full_order(self) -> None:
        self.database.save_diploma_print_data(
            self.student_id,
            self.course_id,
            {
                "template_id": self.template_id,
                "appendix_sheet_count": 2,
                "appendix_second_sheet_from": 2,
                "appendix_split_manual": True,
            },
            [{"name": "Старая", "hours": 1, "grade": ""}],
            {},
        )
        updated = [
            {"name": "Первая", "hours": 100, "grade": "Зачтено"},
            {"name": "Вторая", "hours": 150, "grade": "Зачтено"},
            {"name": "Третья", "hours": 250, "grade": "Отлично"},
        ]
        self._update_catalog(updated)
        data, first, _layout = self.database.get_diploma_print_data(
            self.student_id, self.course_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(first, updated[:1])
        self.assertEqual(data["sheet2_curriculum"], updated[1:])
        self.assertEqual(data["appendix_second_sheet_from"], 2)

    def test_manual_issue_freezes_curriculum_against_later_catalog_edits(self) -> None:
        document_id = self._save_diploma()
        frozen = [{"name": "До выдачи", "hours": 500, "grade": "Зачтено"}]
        self._update_catalog(frozen)
        self.database.set_issued_document_issued(document_id, True)
        self.assertTrue(self.database.is_primary_diploma_curriculum_frozen(self.course_id))

        self._update_catalog(
            [{"name": "После выдачи", "hours": 500, "grade": "Отлично"}]
        )
        _data, curriculum, _layout = self.database.get_diploma_print_data(
            self.student_id, self.course_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(curriculum, frozen)
        _data, journal_curriculum, _layout = self.database.get_issued_document_payload(
            document_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(journal_curriculum, frozen)

    def test_unmarking_manual_issue_resumes_live_catalog_sync(self) -> None:
        document_id = self._save_diploma()
        self.database.set_issued_document_issued(document_id, True)
        latest = [{"name": "После снятия", "hours": 500, "grade": "Зачтено"}]
        self._update_catalog(latest)
        self.database.set_issued_document_issued(document_id, False)
        _data, curriculum, _layout = self.database.get_diploma_print_data(
            self.student_id, self.course_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(curriculum, latest)

    def test_postal_delivery_automatically_freezes_current_catalog_curriculum(self) -> None:
        document_id = self._save_diploma()
        delivered_curriculum = [
            {"name": "Актуально к вручению", "hours": 500, "grade": "Зачтено"}
        ]
        self._update_catalog(delivered_curriculum)
        delivery_time = "2026-08-10T14:25:00"
        self.database.update_document_postal_tracking(
            document_id,
            track_number="80000000000000",
            current_status="Вручено адресату",
            status_date=delivery_time,
            status_location="Москва",
            last_checked_at=delivery_time,
            history=[
                {
                    "operation_date": "2026-08-08T10:00:00",
                    "operation_name": "Прием",
                    "operation_attribute": "Единичный",
                },
                {
                    "operation_date": delivery_time,
                    "operation_name": "Вручение",
                    "operation_attribute": "Адресату",
                },
            ],
        )
        row = self.database.get_issued_document(document_id)
        self.assertIsNotNone(row)
        assert row is not None
        self.assertEqual(row["status"], "Выдан")
        self.assertEqual(row["issued_at"], delivery_time)

        self._update_catalog(
            [{"name": "Изменено после вручения", "hours": 500, "grade": "Отлично"}]
        )
        _data, curriculum, _layout = self.database.get_diploma_print_data(
            self.student_id, self.course_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(curriculum, delivered_curriculum)

    def test_failed_delivery_attempt_does_not_mark_document_issued(self) -> None:
        document_id = self._save_diploma()
        self.database.update_document_postal_tracking(
            document_id,
            track_number="80000000000000",
            current_status="Неудачная попытка вручения",
            status_date="2026-08-10T14:25:00",
            status_location="Москва",
            last_checked_at="2026-08-10T14:25:00",
            history=[
                {
                    "operation_date": "2026-08-08T10:00:00",
                    "operation_name": "Прием",
                    "operation_attribute": "Единичный",
                },
                {
                    "operation_date": "2026-08-10T14:25:00",
                    "operation_name": "Неудачная попытка вручения",
                    "operation_attribute": "Иная",
                },
            ],
        )
        row = self.database.get_issued_document(document_id)
        self.assertIsNotNone(row)
        assert row is not None
        self.assertEqual(row["status"], "Отправлен")
        self.assertEqual(str(row["issued_at"] or ""), "")

    def test_print_window_contains_live_and_frozen_curriculum_indicators(self) -> None:
        text = DIPLOMA_DIALOG_SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("Учебный план синхронизируется со справочником курса", text)
        self.assertIn("Учебный план зафиксирован", text)
        self.assertIn("_sync_live_catalog_curriculum", text)
        self.assertIn("is_primary_diploma_curriculum_frozen", text)

    def test_journal_manual_issue_is_personal_and_delivery_is_automatic(self) -> None:
        text = JOURNAL_DIALOG_SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("Отметить документ выданным лично", text)
        self.assertIn("после операции «Вручение»", text)
        self.assertIn("issued_document_postal_delivery_datetime", text)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from dpo_app.document_dates import normalize_document_date


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DIPLOMA_RENDERER_SOURCE = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "diploma_printing.py"


class DiplomaLicenseDateFormatTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_storage_iso_date_is_printed_as_day_month_year(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(normalize_document_date("2020-11-10"), "10.11.2020")

    def test_legacy_dotted_iso_date_is_printed_as_day_month_year(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(normalize_document_date("2020.11.10"), "10.11.2020")

    def test_already_formatted_date_is_unchanged(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(normalize_document_date("10.11.2020"), "10.11.2020")

    def test_diploma_context_and_fallback_use_normalized_license_date(self) -> None:
        source = DIPLOMA_RENDERER_SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("from dpo_app.document_dates import normalize_document_date", source)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(
            source.count("normalize_document_date(data.license_date)"),
            2,
        )
        self.assertNotIn(
            '"license_date": str(data.license_date or "")',
            source,
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

ФАЙЛ 088/137: tests/test_diploma_physical_print_device_feed_correction.py
Исходная кодировка при чтении архива: utf-8-sig

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DIALOG = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "ui" / "diploma_print_dialog.py"
FORMS = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "windows_print_forms.py"
RENDERER = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "diploma_printing.py"


def _method_body(
    source: str, method_name: str, next_method_name: str | None = None
) -> str:
    start = source.index(f"    def {method_name}(")
    if next_method_name is None:
        return source[start:]
    end = source.index(f"    def {next_method_name}(", start)
    return source[start:end]


def test_only_physical_diploma_print_receives_feed_correction() -> None:
    dialog = DIALOG.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    forms = FORMS.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    renderer = RENDERER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    ast.parse(dialog)
    ast.parse(forms)
    ast.parse(renderer)

    assert "DIPLOMA_PRINT_FEED_OFFSET_X_MM = -0.4" in dialog
    assert "DIPLOMA_PRINT_FEED_OFFSET_Y_MM = 4.0" in dialog
    assert "landscape_offset_x_mm=DIPLOMA_PRINT_FEED_OFFSET_X_MM" in dialog
    assert "landscape_offset_y_mm=DIPLOMA_PRINT_FEED_OFFSET_Y_MM" in dialog

    preview = _method_body(dialog, "refresh_preview", "save_data")
    save_pdf = _method_body(dialog, "_save_pdf", "_configure_printer")
    print_selection = _method_body(dialog, "_print_selection")
    assert "DIPLOMA_PRINT_FEED_OFFSET" not in preview
    assert "DIPLOMA_PRINT_FEED_OFFSET" not in save_pdf
    assert "DIPLOMA_PRINT_FEED_OFFSET" in print_selection
    assert "DIPLOMA_PRINT_FEED_OFFSET" not in renderer


def test_shared_printer_helper_defaults_to_no_correction() -> None:
    forms = FORMS.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "landscape_offset_x_mm: float = 0.0" in forms
    assert "landscape_offset_y_mm: float = 0.0" in forms
    assert "pixels_per_mm_x = target.height() / DOCUMENT_FORM_HEIGHT_MM" in forms
    assert "pixels_per_mm_y = target.width() / DOCUMENT_FORM_WIDTH_MM" in forms
    assert "offset_x_mm * pixels_per_mm_x" in forms
    assert "offset_y_mm * pixels_per_mm_y" in forms

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DIALOG_PATH = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "ui" / "diploma_print_dialog.py"
RENDERER_PATH = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "diploma_printing.py"


def _method_body(source: str, method_name: str, next_method_name: str) -> str:
    start = source.index(f"    def {method_name}(")
    end = source.index(f"    def {next_method_name}(", start)
    return source[start:end]


def test_physical_field_offsets_do_not_change_preview_or_pdf() -> None:
    dialog = DIALOG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    renderer = RENDERER_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    ast.parse(dialog)
    ast.parse(renderer)

    preview = _method_body(dialog, "refresh_preview", "save_data")
    save_pdf = _method_body(dialog, "_save_pdf", "_configure_printer")
    print_pages = _method_body(dialog, "_print_pages", "_print_selection")

    assert "field_x_offsets_mm" not in preview
    assert "field_y_offsets_mm" not in preview
    assert "field_x_offsets_mm" not in save_pdf
    assert "field_y_offsets_mm" not in save_pdf
    assert "_render_diploma_for_physical_print" in print_pages
    assert "field_x_offsets_mm=DIPLOMA_PRINT_FIELD_X_OFFSETS_MM" in dialog
    assert "field_y_offsets_mm=DIPLOMA_PRINT_FIELD_Y_OFFSETS_MM" in dialog


def test_renderer_changes_only_explicit_x_and_y_coordinates() -> None:
    renderer = RENDERER_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert 'overrides["x"] = float(calibrated["x"]) + offset_x' in renderer
    assert 'overrides["y"] = float(calibrated["y"]) + offset_y' in renderer
    assert "if offset_x or offset_y:" in renderer

ФАЙЛ 090/137: tests/test_diploma_physical_print_preview_alignment.py
Исходная кодировка при чтении архива: utf-8-sig

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RENDERER = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "diploma_printing.py"
DIALOG = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "ui" / "diploma_print_dialog.py"
CALIBRATION = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "ui" / "diploma_template_calibration_dialog.py"


class DiplomaPhysicalPrintPreviewAlignmentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
        cls.renderer_text = RENDERER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        cls.dialog_text = DIALOG.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        cls.calibration_text = CALIBRATION.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        ast.parse(cls.renderer_text)
        ast.parse(cls.dialog_text)
        ast.parse(cls.calibration_text)

    def test_calibration_coordinates_are_the_single_document_geometry(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("DIPLOMA_COORDINATE_SYSTEM_KEY", self.calibration_text)
        self.assertNotIn("emulate_physical_print=True", self.dialog_text)
        self.assertNotIn("emulate_physical_print=True", self.calibration_text)

    def test_real_printer_uses_only_explicit_physical_corrections(self) -> None:
        self.assertNotIn("compensate_physical_printer", self.dialog_text)
        self.assertNotIn("DIPLOMA_PRINTER_COMPENSATION", self.renderer_text)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(
            self.dialog_text.count("self.renderer.render_diploma(data1, background)"),
            2,
        )
        self.assertIn("DIPLOMA_PRINT_FEED_OFFSET_X_MM", self.dialog_text)
        self.assertIn("DIPLOMA_PRINT_FEED_OFFSET_Y_MM", self.dialog_text)
        self.assertIn("DIPLOMA_PRINT_FIELD_X_OFFSETS_MM", self.dialog_text)

    def test_calibration_text_and_field_boxes_use_same_layout(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("self.renderer.render_diploma(data, True)", self.calibration_text)
        self.assertIn("effective_field_layout(data, key)", self.calibration_text)

    def test_calibration_uses_gizzatullin_reference_diploma(self) -> None:
        for expected in (
            'full_name="Гиззатуллин Саид Тагирович"',
            'registration_number="055"',
            'issue_date="13.07.2026"',
            'organization_name="ООО «Лексториум»"',
            'decision_date="13 июля 2026 года"',
            'CALIBRATION_REFERENCE_QUALIFICATION = (',
            'CALIBRATION_REFERENCE_PROFESSIONAL_AREA = "гражданско-правовых отношений"',
            'qualification=CALIBRATION_REFERENCE_QUALIFICATION',
            'chairman_name="А.В. Егоров"',
        ):
            self.assertIn(expected, self.calibration_text)

    def test_calibration_boxes_use_renderer_effective_layout(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn(
            "value = self.renderer.effective_field_layout(data, key)",
            self.calibration_text,
        )
        self.assertIn(
            "marked = self._draw_field_boxes(image, page, data)",
            self.calibration_text,
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

Исходная кодировка при чтении архива: utf-8-sig

from __future__ import annotations

import unittest

try:
    from PySide6.QtGui import QFont, QFontMetricsF

    from dpo_app.diploma_printing import (
        DIPLOMA_SIZE,
        PRINT_DPI,
        DiplomaRenderer,
    )
except ModuleNotFoundError:  # Allows source-only CI without the optional GUI runtime.
    QFont = QFontMetricsF = None  # type: ignore[assignment]
    DIPLOMA_SIZE = None  # type: ignore[assignment]
    PRINT_DPI = None  # type: ignore[assignment]
    DiplomaRenderer = None  # type: ignore[assignment]


@unittest.skipUnless(DiplomaRenderer is not None, "PySide6 is not installed")
class DiplomaRenderResolutionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.renderer = DiplomaRenderer()

    @staticmethod
    def _dpi_from_dots_per_meter(value: int) -> float:
        return value * 0.0254

    def test_blank_diploma_canvas_has_300_dpi(self) -> None:
        image = self.renderer._image(
            self.renderer.backgrounds["diploma"],
            DIPLOMA_SIZE,
            include_background=False,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self._dpi_from_dots_per_meter(image.dotsPerMeterX()),
            PRINT_DPI,
            delta=0.1,
        )
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self._dpi_from_dots_per_meter(image.dotsPerMeterY()),
            PRINT_DPI,
            delta=0.1,
        )

    def test_background_diploma_canvas_keeps_300_dpi_after_conversion(self) -> None:
        image = self.renderer._image(
            self.renderer.backgrounds["diploma"],
            DIPLOMA_SIZE,
            include_background=True,
        )
        self.assertFalse(image.isNull())
        self.assertAlmostEqual(
            self._dpi_from_dots_per_meter(image.dotsPerMeterX()),
            PRINT_DPI,
            delta=0.1,
        )

    def test_point_font_is_rasterized_for_300_dpi_canvas(self) -> None:
        image = self.renderer._image(
            self.renderer.backgrounds["diploma"],
            DIPLOMA_SIZE,
            include_background=False,
        )
        font = QFont("Times New Roman")
        font.setPointSizeF(14.0)
        metrics = QFontMetricsF(font, image)
        # At 300 DPI a 14 pt em is about 58 pixels. The exact font height is
        # platform-dependent, but it must be far above the ~19 px produced by
        # an accidental 96-DPI canvas.
        self.assertGreater(metrics.height(), 35.0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from contextlib import closing
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from dpo_app.db import Database
from dpo_app.diploma_template_logic import (
    LAYOUT_VARIANT_AUTO,
    LAYOUT_VARIANT_COMMON,
    QUALIFICATION_LAYOUTS_KEY,
    available_qualification_variants,
    canonical_appendix_front_values,
    matching_qualification_variant,
    merged_field_layout,
    selected_qualification_variant,
    sparse_layout_overrides,
    validate_template_layout,
)


class DiplomaTemplateLogicTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.layout = {
            "field": {
                "page": "diploma",
                "x": 1.0,
                "y": 2.0,
                "w": 30.0,
                "h": 8.0,
                "family": "Times New Roman",
                "size": 12.0,
            },
            QUALIFICATION_LAYOUTS_KEY: {
                "Юрист в сфере корпоративного права": {
                    "field": {"x": 5.0, "family": "Lazurski"}
                },
            },
        }

    def test_legacy_qualification_variants_are_not_available(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(available_qualification_variants(self.layout), [])
        self.assertEqual(
            matching_qualification_variant(
                self.layout, "Юрист в сфере корпоративного права"
            ),
            "",
        )

    def test_all_variant_selections_resolve_to_common_settings(self) -> None:
        qualification = "Юрист в сфере корпоративного права"
        for selection in (LAYOUT_VARIANT_AUTO, LAYOUT_VARIANT_COMMON, qualification):
            self.assertEqual(
                selected_qualification_variant(
                    self.layout, qualification, selection
                ),
                "",
            )

    def test_field_merging_ignores_legacy_variant_overrides(self) -> None:
        result = merged_field_layout(
            {"x": 0.0, "y": 0.0, "family": "Arial", "size": 10.0},
            self.layout,
            "field",
            qualification="Юрист в сфере корпоративного права",
            selection=LAYOUT_VARIANT_AUTO,
        )
        self.assertEqual(result["x"], 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(result["y"], 2.0)
        self.assertEqual(result["family"], "Times New Roman")
        self.assertEqual(result["size"], 12.0)

    def test_sparse_overrides_store_only_differences(self) -> None:
        base = {
            "field": {"x": 1.0, "y": 2.0, "family": "Arial"},
            "other": {"x": 3.0},
        }
        candidate = {
            "field": {"x": 1.0, "y": 4.0, "family": "Arial"},
            "other": {"x": 3.0},
        }
        self.assertEqual(
            sparse_layout_overrides(base, candidate),
            {"field": {"y": 4.0}},
        )

    def test_appendix_front_uses_sheet1_then_legacy_sheet2(self) -> None:
        result = canonical_appendix_front_values(
            {"study_start": "01 августа 2026 года", "internship": ""},
            {"study_start": "02 августа 2026 года", "internship": "нет"},
            ("study_start", "internship", "thesis"),
        )
        self.assertEqual(result["study_start"], "01 августа 2026 года")
        self.assertEqual(result["internship"], "нет")
        self.assertEqual(result["thesis"], "")

    def test_validator_ignores_obsolete_variant_payload(self) -> None:
        issues = validate_template_layout(self.layout, required_fields=("field",))
        self.assertFalse(any("вариант" in issue.casefold() for issue in issues))


class DiplomaTemplateDatabaseTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_used_diploma_template_cannot_be_deleted(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            database = Database(Path(directory) / "test.sqlite3")
            database.initialize()
            diploma_template = next(
                row
                for row in database.list_print_templates()
                if str(row["document_type"])
                == "Диплом о профессиональной переподготовке"
            )
            custom_id = database.create_print_template_copy(
                int(diploma_template["id"]),
                "Тестовый шаблон диплома",
            )
            # sqlite3.Connection.__exit__ commits or rolls back, but does not
            # close the file handle. Close it explicitly so Windows can remove
            # the TemporaryDirectory after the test.
            with closing(database.connect()) as connection:
                with connection:
                    student_id = int(
                        connection.execute(
                            """
                            INSERT INTO students(last_name, first_name)
                            VALUES ('Тестов', 'Тест')
                            """
                        ).lastrowid
                    )
                    connection.execute(
                        """
                        INSERT INTO student_courses(
                            student_id, course_name, duration_hours, program_type,
                            diploma_data_json
                        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                        """,
                        (
                            student_id,
                            "Тестовый курс",
                            250,
                            "Профессиональная переподготовка",
                            json.dumps({"template_id": custom_id}),
                        ),
                    )

            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "диплом"):
                database.delete_print_template(custom_id)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from dpo_app.db import Database


class ExcelImportDatabaseTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.database = Database(Path(self.temp_dir.name) / "test.sqlite3")
        self.database.initialize()

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.temp_dir.cleanup()

    def test_repeated_student_import_updates_missing_fields_and_adds_course(self) -> None:
        first = self.database.import_students(
            [
                {
                    "_source_row": 2,
                    "last_name": "Иванов",
                    "first_name": "Иван",
                    "middle_name": "Иванович",
                    "snils": "123-456-789 00",
                    "course_name": "Первый курс",
                    "duration_hours": 72,
                    "program_type": "Повышение квалификации",
                }
            ]
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(first), 1)
        self.assertTrue(first[0].success)
        self.assertTrue(first[0].created_student)

        second = self.database.import_students(
            [
                {
                    "_source_row": 3,
                    "last_name": "Иванов",
                    "first_name": "Иван",
                    "middle_name": "Иванович",
                    "snils": "12345678900",
                    "phone": "79990000000",
                    "course_name": "Второй курс",
                    "duration_hours": 96,
                    "program_type": "Повышение квалификации",
                }
            ]
        )

        self.assertEqual(len(second), 1)
        self.assertTrue(second[0].success)
        self.assertTrue(second[0].reused_student)
        self.assertTrue(second[0].course_added)

        student = self.database.get_student(int(first[0].student_id))
        self.assertIsNotNone(student)
        assert student is not None
        self.assertEqual(student["phone"], "79990000000")
        courses = self.database.list_student_courses(int(first[0].student_id))
        self.assertEqual(len(courses), 2)


    def test_unsupported_program_does_not_create_training_reference_document(self) -> None:
        results = self.database.import_students(
            [
                {
                    "_source_row": 2,
                    "last_name": "Орлов",
                    "first_name": "Олег",
                    "middle_name": "Олегович",
                    "snils": "555-666-777 88",
                    "course_name": "Иная образовательная программа",
                    "duration_hours": 40,
                    "program_type": "Иная программа",
                    "track_number": "80000000000099",
                }
            ]
        )

        self.assertEqual(len(results), 1)
        self.assertTrue(results[0].success)
        self.assertIn("трек-номер не сохранён", results[0].warning)
        self.assertEqual(self.database.list_issued_documents(), [])
        student_id = int(results[0].student_id)
        self.assertEqual(
            list(self.database.list_student_postal_documents(student_id)),
            [],
        )

    def test_imported_track_numbers_are_linked_to_their_exact_courses(self) -> None:
        results = self.database.import_students(
            [
                {
                    "_source_row": 2,
                    "last_name": "Сидоров",
                    "first_name": "Сидор",
                    "middle_name": "Сидорович",
                    "snils": "111-222-333 44",
                    "course_name": "Курс А",
                    "duration_hours": 72,
                    "program_type": "Повышение квалификации",
                    "track_number": "80000000000011",
                },
                {
                    "_source_row": 3,
                    "last_name": "Сидоров",
                    "first_name": "Сидор",
                    "middle_name": "Сидорович",
                    "snils": "11122233344",
                    "course_name": "Курс Б",
                    "duration_hours": 96,
                    "program_type": "Повышение квалификации",
                    "track_number": "80000000000012",
                },
            ]
        )
        self.assertTrue(all(result.success for result in results))
        student_id = int(results[0].student_id)
        rows = [
            dict(row)
            for row in self.database.list_student_postal_documents(student_id)
        ]
        tracks_by_course = {
            str(row["course_name"]): str(row["track_number"] or "")
            for row in rows
        }
        self.assertEqual(tracks_by_course["Курс А"], "80000000000011")
        self.assertEqual(tracks_by_course["Курс Б"], "80000000000012")

    def test_imported_track_number_does_not_overwrite_existing_document_payload(self) -> None:
        first = self.database.import_students(
            [
                {
                    "_source_row": 2,
                    "last_name": "Петров",
                    "first_name": "Пётр",
                    "middle_name": "Петрович",
                    "snils": "222-333-444 55",
                    "course_name": "Курс сохранения документа",
                    "duration_hours": 72,
                    "program_type": "Повышение квалификации",
                    "registration_number": "REG-77",
                    "issue_date": "2026-08-01",
                }
            ]
        )
        student_id = int(first[0].student_id)
        course_id = int(self.database.list_student_courses(student_id)[0]["id"])
        with self.database.connect() as connection:
            document_id = self.database._upsert_primary_issued_document(
                connection,
                student_id=student_id,
                student_course_id=course_id,
                document_kind="certificate",
                template_id=None,
                blank_number="772400000001",
                registration_number="REG-77",
                issue_date="2026-08-01",
                data={"marker": "keep"},
            )

        second = self.database.import_students(
            [
                {
                    "_source_row": 3,
                    "last_name": "Петров",
                    "first_name": "Пётр",
                    "middle_name": "Петрович",
                    "snils": "22233344455",
                    "course_name": "Курс сохранения документа",
                    "duration_hours": 72,
                    "program_type": "Повышение квалификации",
                    "track_number": "80000000000123",
                }
            ]
        )
        self.assertTrue(second[0].success)
        document = self.database.get_issued_document(document_id)
        self.assertIsNotNone(document)
        assert document is not None
        self.assertIsNone(document["template_id"])
        self.assertEqual(str(document["blank_number"]), "772400000001")
        payload, _curriculum, _layout = self.database.get_issued_document_payload(document_id)
        self.assertEqual(payload.get("marker"), "keep")
        shipment = self.database.get_document_postal_shipment(document_id)
        self.assertIsNotNone(shipment)
        assert shipment is not None
        self.assertEqual(str(shipment["track_number"]), "80000000000123")

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


SOURCE = (
    Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    / "dpo_app"
    / "ui"
    / "frdo_export_dialog.py"
)


class FrdoAsyncExportLayoutTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
        cls.tree = ast.parse(SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        cls.classes = {
            node.name: node
            for node in cls.tree.body
            if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)
        }

    @staticmethod
    def _method(class_node: ast.ClassDef, name: str) -> ast.FunctionDef:
        for node in class_node.body:
            if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == name:
                return node
        raise AssertionError(f"Method {name!r} not found")

    @staticmethod
    def _called_names(node: ast.AST) -> list[str]:
        names: list[str] = []
        for child in ast.walk(node):
            if not isinstance(child, ast.Call):
                continue
            function = child.func
            if isinstance(function, ast.Name):
                names.append(function.id)
            elif isinstance(function, ast.Attribute):
                names.append(function.attr)
        return names

    def test_worker_performs_xlsx_generation(self) -> None:
        worker = self.classes["FrdoExportWorker"]
        run = self._method(worker, "run")
        self.assertIn("export_records", self._called_names(run))
        self.assertIn("save_frdo_export", self._called_names(run))

    def test_dialog_does_not_generate_xlsx_in_gui_slot(self) -> None:
        dialog = self.classes["FrdoExportDialog"]
        export_selected = self._method(dialog, "export_selected")
        called = self._called_names(export_selected)
        self.assertNotIn("export_records", called)
        self.assertIn("start", called)
        self.assertIn("_set_loading", called)

    def test_export_result_handlers_exist(self) -> None:
        dialog = self.classes["FrdoExportDialog"]
        method_names = {
            node.name
            for node in dialog.body
            if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
        }
        self.assertIn("_export_finished", method_names)
        self.assertIn("_export_failed", method_names)
        self.assertIn("_export_thread_finished", method_names)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from dpo_app.db import Database


class IssuedDocumentsJournalTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.database = Database(Path(self.temp_dir.name) / "test.sqlite3")
        self.database.initialize()
        self.student_id = self.database.create_student(
            {
                "last_name": "Иванов",
                "first_name": "Иван",
                "middle_name": "Иванович",
                "gender": "Мужской",
                "gender_source": "manual",
            }
        )
        self.database.replace_student_courses(
            self.student_id,
            [
                {
                    "course_name": "Охрана труда",
                    "duration_hours": 72,
                    "program_type": "Повышение квалификации",
                },
                {
                    "course_name": "Корпоративное право",
                    "duration_hours": 520,
                    "program_type": "Профессиональная переподготовка",
                },
            ],
        )
        courses = [dict(row) for row in self.database.list_student_courses(self.student_id)]
        self.certificate_course_id = next(
            int(row["id"])
            for row in courses
            if row["program_type"] == "Повышение квалификации"
        )
        self.diploma_course_id = next(
            int(row["id"])
            for row in courses
            if row["program_type"] == "Профессиональная переподготовка"
        )
        templates = [dict(row) for row in self.database.list_print_templates()]
        self.certificate_template_id = next(
            int(row["id"])
            for row in templates
            if row["document_type"] == "Удостоверение о повышении квалификации"
        )
        self.diploma_template_id = next(
            int(row["id"])
            for row in templates
            if row["document_type"] == "Диплом о профессиональной переподготовке"
        )

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.temp_dir.cleanup()

    def _save_certificate(self) -> int:
        return self.database.save_issued_certificate(
            {
                "student_id": self.student_id,
                "student_course_id": self.certificate_course_id,
                "template_id": self.certificate_template_id,
                "blank_number": "БЛ-001",
                "registration_number": "Р-001",
                "issue_city": "Москва",
                "issue_date": "2026-08-02",
                "organization_name": "ООО Тест",
                "license_number": "123",

    def test_certificate_issue_dates_migrate_from_iso(self) -> None:
        self._save_certificate()
        document_id = int(self.database.list_issued_documents()[0]["id"])
        with self.database.connect() as connection:
            connection.execute(
                "UPDATE issued_certificates SET issue_date = '2026-08-02'"
            )
            connection.execute(
                "UPDATE student_courses SET issue_date = '2026-08-02' "
                "WHERE id = ?",
                (self.certificate_course_id,),
            )
            connection.execute(
                "UPDATE issued_documents "
                "SET issue_date = '2026-08-02', document_data_json = ? "
                "WHERE id = ?",
                ('{"issue_date": "2026-08-02"}', document_id),
            )
            connection.execute(
                "DELETE FROM app_migrations "
                "WHERE migration_key = 'certificate_issue_dates_ddmmyyyy_v1'"
            )

        self.database.initialize()

        certificate = self.database.get_issued_certificate(
            self.student_id, self.certificate_course_id
        )
        assert certificate is not None
        self.assertEqual(certificate["issue_date"], "02.08.2026")
        course = next(
            row
            for row in self.database.list_student_courses(self.student_id)
            if int(row["id"]) == self.certificate_course_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(course["issue_date"], "02.08.2026")
        document = self.database.get_issued_document(document_id)
        assert document is not None
        self.assertEqual(document["issue_date"], "02.08.2026")
        payload, _curriculum, _layout = self.database.get_issued_document_payload(
            document_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(payload["issue_date"], "02.08.2026")

            self.database.issued_document_postal_delivery_datetime(document_id),
            delivery,
        )
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "подтвердила вручение"):
            self.database.set_issued_document_issued(document_id, False)

    def test_existing_postal_acceptance_sets_sent_status_on_initialization(self) -> None:
        self._save_certificate()
        document_id = int(self.database.list_issued_documents()[0]["id"])
        with self.database.connect() as connection:
            connection.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO postal_shipments(
                    student_id, student_course_id, issued_document_id,
                    track_number, history_json, is_active, legacy_unassigned
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 0)
                ON CONFLICT(issued_document_id) WHERE issued_document_id IS NOT NULL AND is_active = 1
                DO UPDATE SET
                    track_number = excluded.track_number,
                    history_json = excluded.history_json
                """,
                (
                    self.student_id,
                    self.certificate_course_id,
                    document_id,
                    "80000000000000",
                    '[{"operation_date":"2026-08-03T12:30:00",'
                    '"operation_name":"Прием",'
                    '"operation_attribute":"Единичный"}]',
                ),
            )
            connection.execute(
                "UPDATE issued_documents SET status = 'Напечатан' WHERE id = ?",
                (document_id,),
            )

        self.database.initialize()

        row = self.database.get_issued_document(document_id)
        self.assertIsNotNone(row)
        assert row is not None
        self.assertEqual(row["status"], "Отправлен")

from __future__ import annotations

import unittest
from pathlib import Path


class JournalGridLayoutTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Protect the cell-local journal grid from viewport-line regressions."""

    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
        cls.source = (
            Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
            / "dpo_app"
            / "ui"
            / "issued_documents_journal_dialog.py"
        ).read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    def test_vertical_borders_are_cell_local(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("class JournalCellBorderDelegate", self.source)
        self.assertIn("self.table.setShowGrid(False)", self.source)
        self.assertIn("self.table.setItemDelegate(self._cell_border_delegate)", self.source)
        self.assertNotIn("_draw_vertical_boundaries", self.source)
        self.assertNotIn("class JournalTableWidget", self.source)
        self.assertIn('QColor("#D8D8D8")', self.source)

    def test_student_and_postal_date_have_three_pixel_edges(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn(
            "VERTICAL_BOUNDARY_WIDTHS = {1: 3, 3: 3, 11: 3, 13: 3}",
            self.source,
        )
        self.assertIn("return VERTICAL_BOUNDARY_WIDTHS.get(logical_index, 1)", self.source)

    def test_lines_stop_at_last_data_row(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("option.rect.bottom()", self.source)
        self.assertIn("option.rect.height()", self.source)
        self.assertNotIn("self.viewport().height())", self.source)

    def test_legacy_separator_columns_are_hidden(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("self.table.setColumnHidden(separator_column, True)", self.source)
        self.assertIn("QHeaderView::section { border: 0px; }", self.source)
        self.assertIn("self.table.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.Box)", self.source)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import unittest

from dpo_app.journal_sort import sort_journal_records


class JournalSortTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_issue_date_is_primary_and_name_is_alphabetical_secondary(self) -> None:
        rows = [
            {"id": 1, "issue_date": "30.11.2025", "last_name": "Терентьева", "first_name": "А", "middle_name": ""},
            {"id": 2, "issue_date": "2025-10-07", "last_name": "Яковлев", "first_name": "А", "middle_name": ""},
            {"id": 3, "issue_date": "30.11.2025", "last_name": "Кочкин", "first_name": "А", "middle_name": ""},
            {"id": 4, "issue_date": "", "last_name": "Абрамов", "first_name": "А", "middle_name": ""},
            {"id": 5, "issue_date": "30.11.2025", "last_name": "Ляхова", "first_name": "А", "middle_name": ""},
        ]

        ascending = sort_journal_records(rows, 1, descending=False)
        self.assertEqual(
            [(row["issue_date"], row["last_name"]) for row in ascending],
            [
                ("2025-10-07", "Яковлев"),
                ("30.11.2025", "Кочкин"),
                ("30.11.2025", "Ляхова"),
                ("30.11.2025", "Терентьева"),
                ("", "Абрамов"),
            ],
        )

        descending = sort_journal_records(rows, 1, descending=True)
        self.assertEqual(
            [(row["issue_date"], row["last_name"]) for row in descending],
            [
                ("30.11.2025", "Кочкин"),
                ("30.11.2025", "Ляхова"),
                ("30.11.2025", "Терентьева"),
                ("2025-10-07", "Яковлев"),
                ("", "Абрамов"),
            ],
        )


    def test_mixed_storage_formats_sort_across_month_boundary(self) -> None:
        rows = [
            {"id": 1, "issue_date": "01.08.2026", "last_name": "Аксенова", "first_name": "А", "middle_name": ""},
            {"id": 2, "issue_date": "2026-07-29", "last_name": "Борисов", "first_name": "А", "middle_name": ""},
            {"id": 3, "issue_date": "14.07.2026", "last_name": "Волков", "first_name": "А", "middle_name": ""},
            {"id": 4, "issue_date": "2026-07-10", "last_name": "Громов", "first_name": "А", "middle_name": ""},
        ]

        sorted_rows = sort_journal_records(rows, 1, descending=False)
        self.assertEqual(
            [row["issue_date"] for row in sorted_rows],
            ["2026-07-10", "14.07.2026", "2026-07-29", "01.08.2026"],
        )



if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FORM_HELPER = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "windows_print_forms.py"
CERTIFICATE_DIALOG = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "ui" / "certificate_print_dialog.py"
CERTIFICATE_PRINTING = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "certificate_printing.py"
DIPLOMA_DIALOG = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "ui" / "diploma_print_dialog.py"


class NamedWindowsPrintFormTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
        cls.helper_text = FORM_HELPER.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        cls.certificate_text = CERTIFICATE_DIALOG.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        cls.certificate_printing_text = CERTIFICATE_PRINTING.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        cls.diploma_text = DIPLOMA_DIALOG.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        ast.parse(cls.helper_text)
        ast.parse(cls.certificate_text)
        ast.parse(cls.certificate_printing_text)
        ast.parse(cls.diploma_text)

    def test_exact_driver_form_name_is_used(self) -> None:

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import unittest
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OVERVIEW_SOURCE = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "ui" / "postal_shipments_overview_dialog.py"
MAIN_SOURCE = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "ui" / "main_window.py"


class PostalOverviewUiLayoutTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
        cls.overview_text = OVERVIEW_SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        cls.main_text = MAIN_SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        cls.overview_tree = ast.parse(cls.overview_text)
        cls.main_tree = ast.parse(cls.main_text)

    @staticmethod
    def _class(tree: ast.Module, name: str) -> ast.ClassDef:
        for node in tree.body:
            if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == name:
                return node
        raise AssertionError(f"Class {name!r} not found")

    @staticmethod
    def _method(class_node: ast.ClassDef, name: str) -> ast.FunctionDef:
        for node in class_node.body:
            if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == name:
                return node
        raise AssertionError(f"Method {name!r} not found")

    def test_redundant_open_button_removed(self) -> None:
        self.assertNotIn("Открыть отправление выбранного документа", self.overview_text)
        self.assertIn("doubleClicked.connect", self.overview_text)

    def test_header_is_bold_and_has_permanent_bottom_separator(self) -> None:
        header = self._class(self.overview_tree, "PostalShipmentsHeaderView")
        self._method(header, "paintSection")
        self.assertIn("header_font.setBold(True)", self.overview_text)
        self.assertIn("QPen(QColor(75, 75, 75), 3)", self.overview_text)

    def test_status_column_has_refresh_delegate(self) -> None:
        delegate = self._class(self.overview_tree, "ShipmentStatusDelegate")
        self._method(delegate, "editorEvent")
        dialog = self._class(self.overview_tree, "PostalShipmentsOverviewDialog")
        self._method(dialog, "_refresh_document_status")
        self.assertIn("setItemDelegateForColumn(6", self.overview_text)
        self.assertIn('painter.drawText(rotated_rect, Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter, "↻")', self.overview_text)

    def test_main_register_restores_selected_student_after_reload(self) -> None:
        window = self._class(self.main_tree, "MainWindow")
        self._method(window, "_restore_student_selection")
        load_students = self._method(window, "load_students")
        calls = [
            node.func.attr
            for node in ast.walk(load_students)
            if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute)
        ]
        self.assertIn("_restore_student_selection", calls)

    def test_fixed_width_columns_are_frozen_after_initial_layout(self) -> None:
        self.assertIn("_fixed_width_columns", self.overview_text)
        self.assertIn("_freeze_initial_column_widths", self.overview_text)

    def test_initial_visible_layout_is_applied_after_show(self) -> None:

ФАЙЛ 101/137: tests/test_postal_refresh_policy.py
Исходная кодировка при чтении архива: utf-8-sig

from __future__ import annotations

import unittest
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

from dpo_app.postal_refresh_policy import (
    AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_HOURS,
    automatic_refresh_attempt_timestamp,
    is_auto_refresh_due,
)


class PostalRefreshPolicyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.now = datetime(2026, 8, 7, 20, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=3)))

    def test_first_automatic_refresh_is_due(self) -> None:
        self.assertTrue(is_auto_refresh_due("", now=self.now))

    def test_repeat_before_six_hours_is_skipped(self) -> None:
        previous = (self.now - timedelta(hours=5, minutes=59)).isoformat()
        self.assertFalse(is_auto_refresh_due(previous, now=self.now))

    def test_repeat_at_six_hours_is_allowed(self) -> None:
        previous = (self.now - timedelta(hours=6)).isoformat()
        self.assertTrue(is_auto_refresh_due(previous, now=self.now))

    def test_timezone_offsets_are_compared_by_instant(self) -> None:
        previous = "2026-08-07T11:00:00+00:00"
        self.assertTrue(is_auto_refresh_due(previous, now=self.now))

    def test_bad_saved_timestamp_does_not_block_refresh(self) -> None:
        self.assertTrue(is_auto_refresh_due("broken", now=self.now))

    def test_attempt_timestamp_is_iso_seconds(self) -> None:
        value = automatic_refresh_attempt_timestamp(self.now)
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
        self.assertIsNotNone(parsed.tzinfo)
        self.assertEqual(parsed.microsecond, 0)

    def test_interval_is_six_hours(self) -> None:
        self.assertEqual(AUTO_REFRESH_INTERVAL_HOURS, 6)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from dpo_app.db import Database


class PostalShipmentsPerDocumentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.path = Path(self.temp_dir.name) / "test.sqlite3"
        self.database = Database(self.path)
        self.database.initialize()
        self.student_id = self.database.create_student(
            {
                "last_name": "Петров",
                "first_name": "Пётр",
                "middle_name": "Петрович",
                "gender": "Мужской",
                "gender_source": "manual",
            }
        )
        self.database.replace_student_courses(
            self.student_id,
            [
                {
                    "course_name": "Охрана труда",
                    "duration_hours": 72,
                    "program_type": "Повышение квалификации",
                },
                {
                    "course_name": "Управление организацией",
                    "duration_hours": 520,
                    "program_type": "Профессиональная переподготовка",
                },
            ],
        )
        courses = [
            dict(row)
            for row in self.database.list_student_courses(self.student_id)
        ]
        self.certificate_course_id = next(
            int(row["id"])
            for row in courses
            if row["program_type"] == "Повышение квалификации"
        )
        self.diploma_course_id = next(
            int(row["id"])
            for row in courses
            if row["program_type"] == "Профессиональная переподготовка"
        )
        templates = [dict(row) for row in self.database.list_print_templates()]
        certificate_template_id = next(
            int(row["id"])
            for row in templates
            if row["document_type"] == "Удостоверение о повышении квалификации"
        )
        self.database.save_issued_certificate(
            {
                "student_id": self.student_id,
                "student_course_id": self.certificate_course_id,
                "template_id": certificate_template_id,
                "blank_number": "УД-001",
                "registration_number": "Р-УД-001",
                "issue_city": "Москва",
                "issue_date": "04.08.2026",
                "organization_name": "ООО Тест",
                "license_number": "123",
                "license_date": "01.01.2020",
                "director_name": "Директор",
                "secretary_name": "Секретарь",
            }
        )
        self.database.save_diploma_print_data(
            self.student_id,
            self.diploma_course_id,
            {
                "blank_number": "ДП-001",
                "registration_number": "Р-ДП-001",
                "issue_date": "04.08.2026",
            },
            [],
            {},
        )
        documents = [dict(row) for row in self.database.list_issued_documents()]
        self.certificate_document_id = next(
            int(row["id"])
            for row in documents
            if row["document_kind"] == "certificate"
        )
        self.diploma_document_id = next(
            int(row["id"])
            for row in documents
            if row["document_kind"] == "diploma"
        )

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.temp_dir.cleanup()

    @staticmethod
    def _acceptance_history(value: str = "2026-08-04T12:30:00") -> list[dict]:
        return [
            {
                "operation_date": value,
                "operation_name": "Прием",
                "operation_attribute": "Единичный",
                "location": "Москва",
                "index": "101000",
            }
        ]

    def test_each_document_has_its_own_track_number_and_status(self) -> None:
        self.database.update_document_postal_tracking(
            self.certificate_document_id,
            track_number="80000000000001",
            current_status="Принято в отделении связи",
            status_date="2026-08-04T12:30:00",
            status_location="Москва",
            last_checked_at="2026-08-04T13:00:00",
            history=self._acceptance_history(),
        )
        self.database.save_document_postal_track_number(
            self.diploma_document_id, "80000000000002"
        )

        certificate = self.database.get_issued_document(
            self.certificate_document_id
        )
        diploma = self.database.get_issued_document(self.diploma_document_id)
        assert certificate is not None
        assert diploma is not None
        self.assertEqual(certificate["status"], "Отправлен")
        self.assertNotEqual(diploma["status"], "Отправлен")
        self.assertEqual(
            self.database.issued_document_postal_acceptance_datetime(
                self.certificate_document_id
            ),
            "2026-08-04T12:30:00",
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            self.database.issued_document_postal_acceptance_datetime(
                self.diploma_document_id
            ),
            "",
        )

        rows = [
            dict(row)
            for row in self.database.list_student_postal_documents(
                self.student_id
            )
        ]
        tracks = {
            int(row["document_id"]): str(row["track_number"] or "")
            for row in rows
        }
        self.assertEqual(
            tracks[self.certificate_document_id], "80000000000001"
        )
        self.assertEqual(tracks[self.diploma_document_id], "80000000000002")

    def test_main_registry_returns_postal_summary_counts(self) -> None:
        self.database.save_document_postal_track_number(
            self.certificate_document_id, "80000000000001"
        )
        self.database.save_document_postal_track_number(
            self.diploma_document_id, "80000000000002"
        )
        row = dict(self.database.list_students()[0])
        self.assertEqual(int(row["postal_document_count"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(int(row["shipment_count"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(int(row["unassigned_shipment_count"]), 0)

    def test_track_number_can_be_cleared_and_restored_for_same_document(self) -> None:
        self.database.save_document_postal_track_number(
            self.certificate_document_id, "80000000000005"
        )
        self.database.save_document_postal_track_number(
            self.certificate_document_id, ""
        )
        self.assertIsNone(
            self.database.get_document_postal_shipment(
                self.certificate_document_id
            )
        )
        self.database.save_document_postal_track_number(
            self.certificate_document_id, "80000000000005"
        )
        shipment = self.database.get_document_postal_shipment(
            self.certificate_document_id
        )
        self.assertIsNotNone(shipment)
        assert shipment is not None
        self.assertEqual(shipment["track_number"], "80000000000005")

    def test_legacy_shipment_with_multiple_documents_stays_unassigned(self) -> None:
        with self.database.connect() as connection:
            connection.execute(
                "UPDATE issued_documents SET status = 'Отправлен' WHERE id = ?",
                (self.certificate_document_id,),
            )
            connection.execute(
                """
                UPDATE issued_documents
                SET status = 'Выдан', issued_at = '2026-08-04T12:30:00'
                WHERE id = ?
                """,
                (self.diploma_document_id,),
            )
        with sqlite3.connect(self.path) as connection:
            connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF")
            connection.execute(
                "DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_postal_shipments_track_unique"
            )
            connection.execute(
                "DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_postal_shipments_active_document"
            )
            connection.execute(
                "DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_postal_shipments_student"
            )
            connection.execute(
                "DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_postal_shipments_course"
            )
            connection.execute("DROP TABLE postal_shipments")
            connection.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE postal_shipments (
                    student_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                    track_number TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    current_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    status_date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    status_location TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    last_checked_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    history_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )
                """
            )
            connection.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO postal_shipments(
                    student_id, track_number, current_status, history_json
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    self.student_id,
                    "80000000000003",
                    "Принято",
                    '[{"operation_date":"2026-08-04T12:30:00",'
                    '"operation_name":"Прием",'
                    '"operation_attribute":"Единичный"}]',
                ),
            )
            connection.execute("PRAGMA user_version = 2")
            connection.commit()

        self.database.initialize()

        unassigned = self.database.list_unassigned_postal_shipments(
            self.student_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(unassigned), 1)
        self.assertEqual(unassigned[0]["track_number"], "80000000000003")
        self.assertIsNone(unassigned[0]["issued_document_id"])
        certificate = self.database.get_issued_document(
            self.certificate_document_id
        )
        diploma = self.database.get_issued_document(self.diploma_document_id)
        assert certificate is not None
        assert diploma is not None
        self.assertEqual(certificate["status"], "Отправлен")
        self.assertEqual(diploma["status"], "Выдан")

        self.database.assign_unassigned_postal_shipment(
            int(unassigned[0]["id"]), self.diploma_document_id
        )
        diploma = self.database.get_issued_document(self.diploma_document_id)
        certificate = self.database.get_issued_document(
            self.certificate_document_id
        )
        assert diploma is not None
        assert certificate is not None
        self.assertEqual(diploma["status"], "Выдан")
        self.assertNotEqual(certificate["status"], "Отправлен")
        self.assertEqual(str(certificate["issued_at"] or ""), "")

    def test_legacy_shipment_with_one_document_is_assigned_automatically(self) -> None:
        # Remove the diploma and its course so the legacy shipment has one
        # unambiguous destination during migration.
        with self.database.connect() as connection:
            connection.execute(
                "DELETE FROM issued_documents WHERE id = ?",
                (self.diploma_document_id,),
            )
            connection.execute(
                "DELETE FROM student_courses WHERE id = ?",
                (self.diploma_course_id,),
            )
        with sqlite3.connect(self.path) as connection:
            connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF")
            for index_name in (
                "idx_postal_shipments_track_unique",
                "idx_postal_shipments_active_document",
                "idx_postal_shipments_student",
                "idx_postal_shipments_course",
            ):
                connection.execute(f"DROP INDEX IF EXISTS {index_name}")
            connection.execute("DROP TABLE postal_shipments")
            connection.execute(
                """
                CREATE TABLE postal_shipments (
                    student_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
                    track_number TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    current_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    status_date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    status_location TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    last_checked_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    history_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
                    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )
                """
            )
            connection.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO postal_shipments(
                    student_id, track_number, current_status, history_json
                ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
                """,
                (
                    self.student_id,
                    "80000000000004",
                    "Принято",
                    '[{"operation_date":"2026-08-04T12:30:00",'
                    '"operation_name":"Прием",'
                    '"operation_attribute":"Единичный"}]',
                ),
            )
            connection.commit()

        self.database.initialize()
        shipment = self.database.get_document_postal_shipment(
            self.certificate_document_id
        )
        self.assertIsNotNone(shipment)
        assert shipment is not None
        self.assertEqual(shipment["track_number"], "80000000000004")
        self.assertEqual(int(shipment["legacy_unassigned"]), 0)
        certificate = self.database.get_issued_document(
            self.certificate_document_id
        )
        assert certificate is not None
        self.assertEqual(certificate["status"], "Отправлен")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

class PostalStartupAutoRefreshDatabaseTests(unittest.TestCase):

    def _set_history(self, operation_name: str, operation_attribute: str = "") -> None:
        shipment = self.database.get_document_postal_shipment(self.document_id)

        self.database.update_postal_shipment_tracking_by_id(

    def test_delivery_operation_is_excluded_from_startup_refresh(self) -> None:

            status_date="2026-08-07T14:19:15+03:00",
            status_location="115446, Москва 446",
            last_checked_at="2026-08-07T14:20:00+03:00",
            history=[
                {
                    "operation_date": "2026-08-07T14:19:15+03:00",
                    "operation_name": "Прием",
                    "operation_attribute": "Упрощенный предзаполненный",
                    "location": "Москва 446",
                    "index": "115446",
                }
            ],
        )
        saved = self.database.get_document_postal_shipment(self.document_id)
        assert saved is not None
        self.assertEqual(saved["current_status"], "Прием: Упрощенный предзаполненный")
        self.assertEqual(saved["status_location"], "115446, Москва 446")

class ProgramDiagnosticsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_new_database_passes_core_integrity_checks(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            data_dir = Path(temp)
            database = Database(data_dir / "dpo_documents.sqlite3")
            database.initialize()
            report = ProgramDiagnostics(
                database,
                data_dir,
                BackupManager(database, data_dir),
                RussianPostManager(data_dir),
            ).run()
            self.assertEqual(report.error_count, 0)
            titles = {check.title for check in report.checks}
            self.assertIn("Целостность SQLite", titles)
            self.assertIn("Связи записей", titles)
            self.assertIn("Встроенные печатные шаблоны", titles)
            self.assertIn("Файлы бланков и экспорта", titles)
            self.assertIn("Журнал ошибок", titles)

    def test_report_text_contains_summary_and_recommendations(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            data_dir = Path(temp)
            database = Database(data_dir / "dpo_documents.sqlite3")
            database.initialize()
            report = ProgramDiagnostics(
                database,
                data_dir,
                BackupManager(database, data_dir),
                RussianPostManager(data_dir),
            ).run()
            text = report.to_text()
            self.assertIn("Диагностика:", text)
            self.assertIn("Резервное копирование", text)
            self.assertIn("Рекомендация:", text)

    def test_error_log_is_separate_and_can_be_cleared(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            data_dir = Path(temp)
            _application_path, errors_path = configure_logging(data_dir)
            logging.getLogger("diagnostics-test").error("test error record")
            for handler in logging.getLogger().handlers:
                try:
                    handler.flush()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            self.assertEqual(errors_path, error_log_path(data_dir))
            self.assertIn("test error record", read_recent_errors(data_dir))
            clear_error_log(data_dir)
            self.assertEqual(read_recent_errors(data_dir), "Журнал ошибок пока пуст.")

    def test_main_window_has_diagnostics_button_and_action(self) -> None:
        text = MAIN_SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        tree = ast.parse(text)
        self.assertIn('QPushButton("Диагностика")', text)
        self.assertIn("open_program_diagnostics", text)
        self.assertIn("ProgramDiagnosticsDialog", text)
        classes = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef)]
        main_window = next(node for node in classes if node.name == "MainWindow")
        methods = {
            node.name for node in main_window.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)
        }
        self.assertIn("open_program_diagnostics", methods)

    def test_diagnostics_dialog_has_checks_and_error_log_tabs(self) -> None:
        text = DIALOG_SOURCE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("Результаты проверки", text)
        self.assertIn("Журнал ошибок", text)
        self.assertIn("Повторить проверку", text)
        self.assertIn("Копировать отчёт", text)
        self.assertIn("Открыть папку журналов", text)
        self.assertIn("Очистить журнал ошибок", text)

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path


def test_calibration_dialog_imports_legacy_keys_from_logic_module() -> None:
    source_path = (
        Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        / "dpo_app"
        / "ui"
        / "diploma_template_calibration_dialog.py"
    )
    tree = ast.parse(source_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    imports: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module:
            imports[node.module] = {alias.name for alias in node.names}

    expected = {
        "SELECTED_PROFESSIONAL_AREA_KEY",
        "SELECTED_QUALIFICATION_KEY",
    }
    assert expected <= imports.get("dpo_app.diploma_template_logic", set())
    assert expected.isdisjoint(imports.get("dpo_app.diploma_printing", set()))

ФАЙЛ 108/137: tests/test_rc32_physical_print_offsets_contract.py
Исходная кодировка при чтении архива: utf-8-sig

from __future__ import annotations

import ast
from pathlib import Path


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DIALOG_PATH = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "ui" / "diploma_print_dialog.py"
RENDERER_PATH = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "diploma_printing.py"
VERSION_PATH = ROOT / "dpo_app" / "version.py"


def _mapping(source: str, name: str) -> dict[str, float]:
    module = ast.parse(source)
    for node in module.body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
            for target in node.targets:
                if isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == name:
                    value = ast.literal_eval(node.value)
                    return {str(key): float(number) for key, number in value.items()}
    raise AssertionError(f"Mapping {name} was not found")


def _method_body(source: str, method_name: str, next_method_name: str) -> str:
    start = source.index(f"    def {method_name}(")
    end = source.index(f"    def {next_method_name}(", start)
    return source[start:end]


def test_version_keeps_0311_release_candidate_line() -> None:
    version = VERSION_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert 'APP_VERSION = "0.31.1 RC' in version


def test_exact_printer_only_offsets_match_rc32_request() -> None:
    dialog = DIALOG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    renderer = RENDERER_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    ast.parse(dialog)
    ast.parse(renderer)

    # RC32 is intentionally based on the already obtained RC31 print result.
    # Only the requested horizontal corrections are changed; RC31 vertical
    # corrections remain exactly as they were.
    assert _mapping(dialog, "DIPLOMA_PRINT_FIELD_X_OFFSETS_MM") == {
        "diploma_registration_number": 2.0,
        "diploma_issue_city": 2.0,
        "diploma_issue_date": 2.0,
        "diploma_full_name": 1.0,
        "diploma_organization": 1.5,
        "diploma_decision_date": 1.5,
        "diploma_qualification": 1.5,
        "diploma_professional_area": 1.0,
    }
    assert _mapping(dialog, "DIPLOMA_PRINT_FIELD_Y_OFFSETS_MM") == {
        "diploma_registration_number": -1.0,
        "diploma_issue_city": -1.0,
        "diploma_issue_date": -1.0,
        "diploma_decision_date": -0.5,
        "diploma_qualification": -0.7,
        "diploma_professional_area": -0.5,
    }

    for unchanged in (
        "diploma_chairman",
        "diploma_director",
        "diploma_secretary",
    ):
        assert unchanged not in _mapping(dialog, "DIPLOMA_PRINT_FIELD_X_OFFSETS_MM")
        assert unchanged not in _mapping(dialog, "DIPLOMA_PRINT_FIELD_Y_OFFSETS_MM")


def test_offsets_are_confined_to_physical_diploma_rendering() -> None:
    dialog = DIALOG_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    renderer = RENDERER_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    preview = _method_body(dialog, "refresh_preview", "save_data")
    save_pdf = _method_body(dialog, "_save_pdf", "_configure_printer")
    print_pages = _method_body(dialog, "_print_pages", "_print_selection")

    for body in (preview, save_pdf):
        assert "field_x_offsets_mm" not in body
        assert "field_y_offsets_mm" not in body

    assert "_render_diploma_for_physical_print" in print_pages
    assert "field_x_offsets_mm=DIPLOMA_PRINT_FIELD_X_OFFSETS_MM" in dialog
    assert "field_y_offsets_mm=DIPLOMA_PRINT_FIELD_Y_OFFSETS_MM" in dialog
    assert "field_x_offsets_mm: Mapping[str, float] | None = None" in renderer
    assert "field_y_offsets_mm: Mapping[str, float] | None = None" in renderer

class Rc45CourseCatalogDatabaseTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.database = Database(Path(self.temp_dir.name) / "test.sqlite3")
        self.database.initialize()

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.temp_dir.cleanup()

    def test_advanced_training_never_stores_disciplines(self) -> None:
        course_id = self.database.create_catalog_course(
            "Повышение квалификации",
            72,
            "Повышение квалификации",
            curriculum=[
                {"name": "Лишняя дисциплина", "hours": 72, "grade": "Зачтено"}
            ],
        )
        row = next(
            row
            for row in self.database.list_course_catalog()
            if int(row["id"]) == course_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(Database.decode_catalog_curriculum(row["curriculum_json"]), [])

    def test_switching_retraining_to_advanced_training_clears_disciplines(self) -> None:
        course_id = self.database.create_catalog_course(
            "Исходная переподготовка",
            500,
            "Профессиональная переподготовка",
            "Юрист",
            "Правовая деятельность",
            [{"name": "Право", "hours": 500, "grade": "Зачтено"}],
        )
        self.database.update_catalog_course(
            course_id,
            "Теперь повышение квалификации",
            72,
            "Повышение квалификации",
            curriculum=None,
        )
        row = next(
            row
            for row in self.database.list_course_catalog()
            if int(row["id"]) == course_id
        )
        self.assertEqual(Database.decode_catalog_curriculum(row["curriculum_json"]), [])
        self.assertEqual(row["qualification"], "")
        self.assertEqual(row["professional_area"], "")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
